title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**Project Role :** Full Stack Engineer  

**Project Role Description :** Responsible for developing and/or engineering the end\-to\-end features of a system, from user experience to backend code. Use development skills to deliver innovative solutions that help our clients improve the services they provide. Leverage new technologies that can be applied to solve challenging business problems with a cloud first and agile mindset.
  

**Must have skills :** Java Full Stack Development, Spring Boot, React.js  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **7\.5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As a Full Stack Engineer, a typical day involves taking ownership of the complete development lifecycle of system features, ensuring seamless integration from the user interface to backend services. The role requires actively contributing to the design and implementation of innovative solutions that enhance client service delivery. The engineer collaborates with cross\-functional teams to adopt emerging technologies and applies an agile approach to address complex business challenges within a cloud\-first environment. This position demands a proactive mindset to continuously improve system performance and user experience through thoughtful engineering practices.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance development processes and product quality.
* Mentor junior team members to support their professional growth and skill development.


  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Java Full Stack Development, React.js, Spring Boot.
* Strong knowledge of front\-end technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript frameworks.
* Experience in designing and developing RESTful APIs and microservices architecture.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms and deployment strategies in a cloud\-first environment.
* Ability to write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following best practices.
* Experience with version control systems and collaborative development workflows.


  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 7\.5 years of experience in Java Full Stack Development.
* This position is based at our Mumbai office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

  

15 years full time education

description:
We are looking for an experienced
 **Senior .NET Full Stack Developer (React)** 
 to join our engineering team. In this role, you will design, develop, and support scalable enterprise applications with a strong focus on backend engineering while contributing to modern React\-based user interfaces. Our ideal candidate has strong experience building secure, cloud\-native microservices, enjoys solving production challenges, and thrives in Agile teams.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable enterprise applications using C\#, ASP.NET Core, React, and SQL Server following modern software architecture principles.
* Build and enhance secure RESTful APIs and microservices while ensuring high performance, scalability, and maintainability.
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, implement preventive measures, and collaborate with DevOps teams to improve application reliability.
* Implement authentication and authorization using Keycloak (preferable) or similar tools like OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and JWT, ensuring enterprise\-grade security.
* Collaborate with frontend developers, QA engineers, architects, and business stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle using Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Participate in technical design discussions, code reviews, mentoring junior developers, and driving engineering best practices across the team.


**Minimum Requirements (Mandatory)**
* 6 years of experience in software development using C\#, ASP.NET Core/.NET Core, and enterprise application development.
* Strong experience with React, TypeScript/JavaScript, RESTful API development, Microservices Architecture, Entity Framework Core, and SQL Server.
* Hands\-on experience implementing authentication and authorization using Keycloak (preferable) or similar tools like JWT, OAuth2, and, OpenID Connect.
* Good understanding of application architecture, dependency injection, middleware, API versioning, logging, exception handling, and secure coding practices.
* Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure), Docker, Kubernetes, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Strong analytical and debugging skills with proven experience in production support, performance optimization, API troubleshooting, and database query optimization.


**Preferred Qualifications (Good To Have)**
* Experience working in Automotive, Connected Vehicles, Industry 4\.0, IoT, or Manufacturing domains.
* Hands\-on experience with messaging technologies such as MQTT, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or other event\-driven architectures.
* Exposure to GraphQL, Terraform, Protobuf, container orchestration, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Knowledge of cloud monitoring, distributed tracing, observability, and production monitoring tools.
* Experience with performance tuning, high\-volume messaging systems, and distributed application design.
* Prior experience mentoring developers, leading technical discussions, and contributing to architectural decisions.


**About Reply**
 Reply specializes in the design and implementation of solutions based on new communication channels and digital media. Reply is a network of highly specialized companies supporting global industrial groups operating in the telecom and media, industry and services, banking, insurance and public administration sectors in the definition and development of business models enabled for the new paradigms of AI, cloud computing, digital media and the Internet of Things. Reply services include Consulting, System Integration and Digital Services.

description:
**Job Role \- Full Stack Developer (Backend heavy \+ lending)** 




**Job location \- Mumbai (Full\-Time)** 




  





**About the Role** 




 Join a fast\-growing company as a Full Stack Developer in Mumbai, where you will be part of a dynamic team focused on building innovative solutions. In this role, you will take ownership of the entire development cycle, impacting both web and mobile applications. This position offers significant opportunities for personal and professional growth in a vibrant startup environment, allowing you to learn and collaborate with diverse teams.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Design and implement scalable architectures for web and mobile applications.
* Develop, test, and maintain clean and reusable code using Python (Django) and React Native/React.
* Deploy cloud\-native solutions utilizing AWS services, ensuring optimal performance.
* Collaborate with product, design, and business teams to rapidly ship new features.
* Troubleshoot and debug applications in production, taking ownership of issues.
* Utilize SQL and NoSQL databases effectively to ensure data integrity and access.
* Regularly iterate on features and improvements based on user feedback.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* A minimum of 1\-3 years of experience in full\-stack development is essential.
* Proficiency in Python (Django) is required for developing backend services.
* Solid knowledge of React Native/React and JavaScript is a must.
* Experience with AWS services such as serverless, EC2, and S3 is necessary.
* Hands\-on experience with Docker or Kubernetes is important for deployment.
* Familiarity with databases, specifically PostgreSQL and DynamoDB, is needed.
* Strong understanding of data structures, design patterns, and microservices architecture is required.
* Proficiency with Git and version control workflows is essential for collaborative development.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience in AI development is a plus, showcasing innovative problem\-solving.
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools will enhance your capability in deployment processes.
* Knowledge of testing frameworks for frontend and backend will be beneficial.



  





**Why Join** 



* Be a key player in a fast\-paced environment where your contributions have direct impact.
* Enjoy a culture of innovation that encourages learning and experimentation.
* Work with a talented and diverse team, fostering collaboration and growth.
* Benefit from flexible work arrangements conducive to work\-life balance.
* Access to resources for continuous learning and professional development.

description:
The Developer Platforms team builds the tools, portals, and infrastructure that empower Adobe's engineers to do their best work. We are responsible for the internal developer portal. This hub helps thousands of Adobe engineers discover services, access documentation, onboard to platforms, and manage daily workflows. Additionally, we maintain the organizational knowledge repository that makes Adobe's engineering knowledge searchable, discoverable, and actionable.
   

  

 AI is changing how software is built. We are investing in intelligent internal developer experiences that use LLM\-powered tools to surface knowledge, answer questions, coordinate tasks across systems, and ease daily challenges for Adobe engineers. We're building the platform capabilities that make agentic workflows and intelligent search first\-class citizens of the internal developer experience, from multi\-agent orchestration to memory and planning primitives.
   

  

 We are looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer with strong AI proficiencies to join the Developer Platforms team and contribute to these committed, agent\-powered experiences. You'll work across the stack — building React\-based interfaces, Node.js and Python services, and the orchestration layers that connect LLMs, tools, and internal APIs. You'll partner with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to bring brand new agentic capabilities to Adobe's engineering community at scale.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Design, develop, and test full\-stack features end\-to\-end for the internal developer portal and enterprise knowledge hub, spanning React frontends, Node.js and Python backend services, and AI orchestration layers.
* Build LLM\-powered capabilities including agent planning, tool/function calling, memory management, and multi\-agent workflow orchestration to help engineers find knowledge and get work done.
* Develop and integrate APIs that allow agents to discover and act across Adobe's internal services and knowledge sources, with a focus on reliability and correctness.
* Design orchestration patterns that coordinate multiple agents, tools, and data sources to accomplish complex engineering tasks and answer knowledge queries.
* Collaborate with product management and design to translate emerging AI use cases into well\-architected, production\-ready solutions.
* Participate in build reviews and code reviews, promoting engineering guidelines across both traditional and machine learning systems.
* Investigate and resolve production issues across the stack, contributing to operational excellence, evaluation, and monitoring of AI systems.


 What You Need To Succeed
   

  

**Required**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field with 4\- 6 years of professional software development experience.
* Strong full\-stack proficiency with JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and Node.js.
* Solid backend engineering experience with Python and designing/consuming REST APIs.
* Hands\-on experience building with LLMs, including prompt design, function/tool calling, and integrating model APIs into applications.
* Experience with agentic concepts such as LLM\-based planning, memory management (short\- and long\-term context), and multi\-agent workflow design.
* Familiarity with API orchestration — coordinating multiple services, tools, and data sources into coherent workflows.
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and modern deployment practices.
* Strong problem\-solving ability, good communication skills, and comfort operating across the full stack in a fast\-moving environment.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with agent frameworks and protocols (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, Model Context Protocol / MCP, A2A, or similar).
* Familiarity with RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search — especially applied to knowledge bases and documentation.
* Experience evaluating and testing non\-deterministic AI systems (evals, guardrails, observability).
* Experience building internal developer portals, knowledge bases, or developer productivity tooling.
* Exposure to Adobe's React Spectrum design system or similar component libraries.
* Experience with serverless runtimes, microservices, or event\-driven architectures.


**About Adobe**
 Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry\-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
   

  

 Our 30,000\+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.
   

  

**Let’s Adobe together**
 At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
   

  

 Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.  Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com or call \+1 408\-536\-3015\.
   

  

**AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:**
 Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.

**Job Title:** R\&D Senior Member of Technical Staff, Product Development


**Location:** Bangalore

**Employment Type:** Full time, regular, hybrid work arrangement

 **The job**


The Senior Member of Technical Staff will be a hands\-on software engineer responsible for designing, developing, and delivering high\-quality, scalable, and secure cloud\-based solutions for AVEVA CONNECT. The role requires strong expertise in C\#, .NET, Angular, Microsoft Azure, SQL Server, and modern software engineering practices. Working closely with Product Owners, stakeholders, Scrum teams, and cross\-functional R\&D teams, the successful candidate will contribute to technical design and delivery, mentor engineers, support design and code reviews, resolve customer issues, and drive continuous improvements in engineering quality, security, and development practices.

 **Key responsibilities**

* Work closely with the Product Owner, stakeholders, and Scrum Team to understand, define, design, and implement software solutions that meet business and customer needs.
* Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning and estimation, backlog refinement, daily Scrum meetings, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Collaborate with Customer Support to troubleshoot customer\-reported issues, identify root causes, and drive them to timely resolution.
* Develop high\-quality, maintainable, and scalable code that is fully reviewed, unit tested, documented, and delivered in accordance with agreed quality standards.
* Analyze, design, implement, and validate security requirements in alignment with industry\-standard cybersecurity practices.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering practices, development processes, and overall product quality.
**Essential requirements**

* 8\+ years of software engineering experience.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in C\#, .NET / ASP.NET Core, and enterprise cloud\-based application development.
* Good understanding and hands\-on experience with modern front\-end frameworks, particularly Angular.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure and cloud\-native architecture.
* Strong software design fundamentals, including OOP, SOLID principles, design patterns, and reusable framework/component design.
* Strong knowledge of SQL Server, database design, data access patterns, and application performance considerations.
* Strong engineering quality and security mindset, including automated testing, secure coding, authentication/authorization, dependency risk, and vulnerability remediation.
* Strong technical leadership skills, including mentoring engineers, conducting design/code reviews, defining engineering standards, and collaborating across Development, DevOps, Security, Product, and R\&D teams.
* Strong awareness of cybersecurity principles and their importance throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Ability to translate business and product requirements into technical designs, executable backlogs, dependencies, estimates, and realistic delivery plans.

**Desired skills and competencies**

* Good understanding of Azure DevOps, CI/CD practices, Infrastructure\-as\-Code, and Azure automation using PowerShell / Azure CLI.
* Strong operational awareness, including observability, logging, monitoring, troubleshooting, performance diagnostics, and production support.
* Experience with technical discovery, prototypes/POCs, architecture documentation, and communicating technical decisions across teams.
* Knowledge or practical experience with AI, Generative AI, AI\-enabled applications, and AI\-assisted software development.
 **R\&D at AVEVA**


Our global team of 2000\+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.


Our track record of innovation is no fluke – it’s the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.

We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on\-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Join us as a Fullstack Engineer where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a FullstackEngineer you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Back\-end technologies \- Java, SpringBoot, Junit, Rest, MicroServices TDD (test driven development).
* Database Technologies SQL and NoSQL – Oracle / Mongo.
* DevSecOps \- PaaS Openshift / K8S, GitLab, JIRA, SonarQube, Prisma and Wiz
* Maven or Gradle.
* Working knowledge of message queue like Apache Kafka, IBM MQ, etc.
* Experience of Rapid Application Development using AI models like Claude, GitLab Duo.
* Computer Science degree or equivalent understanding of Computer Science, Object Oriented Design and Data Structures.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Development and delivery of high\-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross\-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. description:
**Role Overview**  

We are seeking a talented Full Stack Data Engineer to join our growing Data \& Analytics team.


This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys building data solutions end\-to\-end—from ingesting and transforming raw data through to modelling, visualization, and delivering actionable business insights. You will work closely with stakeholders across Commercial, Operations, Finance, and Corporate Functions to translate business requirements into scalable data products built on the Microsoft Fabric ecosystem.


The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with a business\-oriented mindset and enjoys owning solutions throughout their lifecycle.

**Note: Role will require supporting EU/US time zones. Flexibility in working hours is to be expected**

**About Role**

**1\. End\-to\-End BI Solution Development**

* Design, develop, and implement full\-stack BI solutions from data ingestion through to user\-facing reports and apps.
* Take ambiguous business questions and translate them into well\-defined BI products, including data models, semantic layers, dashboards, and supporting documentation.
* Manage delivery from discovery and prototyping through validation and production support.
* Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and reliability across all BI solutions.

**2\. Data Pipelines, Modelling, and ETL**

* Develop and maintain ingestion and transformation pipelines using Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory pipelines, dataflows Gen2, copy activities).
* Land, organize, and structure data using Fabric Lakehouse and/or Data Warehouse patterns.
* Implement layered data architectures (e.g. bronze / silver / gold) to ensure modular, reusable, and testable transformations.
* Partner with Data Engineers to align on ETL standards, performance optimization, and scalable design.
* Apply data quality checks, validation rules, and monitoring to proactively identify issues.

**3\. Semantic Models, Reporting, and Visualization**

* Design dimensional and star schemas optimized for BI use cases (facts, dimensions, SCDs, conformed dimensions).
* Build and maintain Power BI semantic models (datasets) with clear, consistent business logic using DAX measures and calculated columns.
* Develop high\-quality Power BI reports, dashboards, and apps that are intuitive, performant, and aligned to real business workflows.
* Implement navigation, drill\-through, parameterized views, and security (row\-level and object\-level) as required.
* Optimize models and reports for performance, maintainability, and scalability.

**4\. Data Analysis and Insights**

* Perform data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities that support decision\-making.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand analytical needs and deliver actionable insights.
* Support advanced analytics use cases where appropriate, including predictive or statistical models in partnership with other specialists.

**5\. Data Governance, Documentation, and Support**

* Ensure BI solutions comply with data governance policies, security standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Contribute to and follow standards for naming, workspace structure, environments, and deployment flows in Fabric.
* Document BI products clearly, including purpose, data sources, refresh cadence, ownership, lineage, and known limitations.
* Contribute to shared libraries of reusable calculations, templates, and visual standards.
* Provide structured handovers, user support, and occasional training or knowledge\-sharing sessions.

**6\. Collaboration and Continuous Improvement**

* Work closely with business stakeholders to priorities work and agree success measures for BI products.
* Collaborate with data engineering, architecture, governance, and security teams to align on standards and patterns.
* Participate in peer reviews of SQL, DAX, data models, and report designs.
* Support continuous improvement of BI delivery practices, promoting full\-stack ownership and reduced hand\-offs.

**About You**

* Strong proficiency in SQL for data transformation, modelling, and performance tuning.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric components, including:
* *Data Factory (pipelines, dataflows Gen2\)*
* *Lakehouse and/or Data Warehouse*
* *Power BI datasets, reports, and apps*
* Strong Power BI skills, including DAX, semantic modelling, and performance optimization.
* Solid understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modelling concepts.
* Experience implementing BI security models (e.g. RLS).
* Familiarity with Git\-based source control and CI/CD practices for BI and analytics assets.
* Experience working with enterprise source systems (e.g. ERP, CRM, finance systems).

**Analytical and Professional Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Clear communication skills, able to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Strong attention to detail, documentation, and data quality.
* Ability to work effectively in a cross\-functional, collaborative environment.
* Comfortable working in regulated or compliance\-driven environments.

**Education/ Qualifications**

* Bachelor/Master in relevant field (e.g. Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering), or equivalent practical experience.
* Proven experience (typically 3\+ years) in a BI, analytics, or data engineering role delivering end\-to\-end BI solutions.
* Demonstrated experience working across the full BI stack, from data ingestion and modelling to reporting and user adoption.

description:
**Level Up Your Career!**
 At Kwalee, you’ll join a gaming powerhouse that boasts a mobile empire with 1\.5 billion\+ downloads alongside a thriving PC \& Console division that has achieved numerous global chart\-topping releases across Steam, Consoles, and Amazon, driving millions of Wishlists. Most recently publishing breakout hits such as The Precinct and Town to City. It’s a unique chance to bring your expertise to a global studio that dominates both the mobile, and the indie PC and Console space.
   

  

 At Kwalee, as well as a competitive salary we also offer; Private Medical Insurance, door\-to\-door transport scheme, free food \& drinks, free game codes \& merch, LinkedIn Learning, 20 annual leave days \+ bank holidays, and 1 day extra day for each year of service capped at 5\.
   

  

**Join the team!**
 As we continue to grow, we are now looking for a
 **Senior Fullstack Developer** 
 to join our AI \& Technology team.
   

  

 As a Senior Fullstack Developer, you will be responsible for building and shipping fullstack applications end to end. This role expands our senior depth to support our AI and Infrastructure work. You'll help fellow engineers get unblocked, lend a hand with DevOps and deployments, and deliver features acoss the stack that move the wider business forwatds.
   

  

 This is a permanent role based in our Bangalore studio, where our daily in\-office collaboration fuels creativity and innovation.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Design, build, and ship complete features across Python/FastAPI backends and React frontends.
* Build and maintain asynchronous APIs in Python and FastAPI, backed by sensible database design and secure server\-side logic.
* Deploy and harden containerised microservices with Docker so they hold up in production.
* Build frontends using Next.js, Vite, and TypeScript, with Tailwind CSS, Shadcn, and TanStack (React Query) for state.
* Integrate third\-party AI services such as the OpenAI APIs into live web applications.
* Make effective use of agentic coding tools like GitHub Copilot in VS Code to work faster without cutting corners on quality.
* Track down architectural issues and performance bottlenecks across the stack and fix them.
* Write and maintain tests to keep the codebase reliable as it grows.
* Review other developers' code and give clear, constructive feedback.
* Keep technical documentation up to date so the team can find what they need.
* Write clean, maintainable code that others on the team can build on.
* Work with our AI Engineers to stand up and stabilise the infrastructure behind new tools in the PCC and Mobile space.
* Support the DevOps team, helping keep our AWS environments and deployment pipelines in good shape as demand grows.
* Mentor fellow developers and share what you know as the team grows.
* Pitch in within a flat team structure, unblocking others and keeping delivery moving.
* Weigh in on decisions about scalability and how our systems should grow, without carrying formal management responsibility.
* Report to the Head of Engineering all relevant matters that affect your job and work.
* Fully comply with the companies procedures, processes, strategies and tactics as may be issued from time to time.
* Ad\-hoc other tasks which may arise from time to time and be assigned to you by the business.


**Fullstack Technical Expertise:**
* At least 5 years building asynchronous APIs with Python and FastAPI.
* A solid grasp of database design, secure server\-side logic, and keeping data intact.
* Experience deploying and running containerised microservices with Docker in production.
* Familiarity with Cloud hosting, deployment, and cloud infrastructure, AWS desirable.
* Comfortable working with Git in a collaborative, review\-based workflow.
* Hands\-on with agentic coding tools such as GitHub Copilot in VS Code as part of your day\-to\-day workflow.
* Strong React skills, specifically Next.js, Vite, and TypeScript.
* Comfortable with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn, and managing state with TanStack (React Query).
* Hands\-on experience wiring third\-party AI services like the OpenAI APIs into live applications


**Ownership \& Delivery:**
* You can dig into architectural issues and performance bottlenecks and sort them out.
* You write tests and review others' code as a matter of habit, not an afterthought.
* You deliver steadily and to a good standard while working across time zones with the rest of the team.
* You've shipped features end to end across both Python and React, not just one side of the stack.


**Mentorship and Cross\-Team Collaboration:**
* You enjoy coaching other developers and levelling up the people around you, without needing to be their manager.
* You're happy to help out with DevOps and infrastructure alongside your own work.
* You can talk through trade\-offs on scalability and design clearly, with both engineers and leadership.
* You care about clean, maintainable code and work in a way that lifts the whole team.


**Why Kwalee?**
* Generous Holiday: Start with 20 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays. You'll also earn an extra day for every year of service, up to 5 years!
* Flexible Working: We offer core hours that allow you to work flexibly around your life, and a bank of 'Work From Home' days to use when you need them.
* Health Cover: Private Medical Insurance covering you and your family
* Free Food \& Drink: Fuel your day with unlimited free snacks and drinks.
* Gaming Goodies: Receive Steam codes for all our game releases!
* Transport: Save on your commute with our budget\-friendly, door\-to\-door transport facility.
* Office Location: Work from our Bangalore office immersing yourself in the dynamic heart of India's Silicon Valley, where explosive career opportunities seamlessly blend with a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle and fantastic year\-round weather.
* Professional Development: Take advantage of our corporate LinkedIn Learning subscription to enhance your skill set
* Merch \& Events: Get exclusive Kwalee merch, enjoy fun seasonal events, and stay informed with regular town halls.


**Our Commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion**
 At Kwalee, we take pride in being an equal opportunity employer, where we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to driving creativity. We are committed to creating a safe, welcoming, and supportive environment where everyone can thrive.
   

  

 Our culture is built on celebrating the diverse voices of our team members, fuelling innovation and strengthening our connection to our players. We are dedicated to advancing equity, diversity, and inclusion across all areas of life, including age, disability, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, and sexual orientation.
   

  

 We recognise the importance of self\-development, career progression, and well\-being in retaining our talented team. At Kwalee, we celebrate individuality and encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

description:
**Fullstack Engineer (AI)** 




**Bangalore** 




**Full\-Time** 




  





**Job Description** 




 At Mareana, we build enterprise\-scale AI products for Supply Chain and Unstructured Data. With the rapidly changing business landscape, we need Fullstack AI Developers who can evolve our products to stay ahead of the curve — engineers who are equally comfortable shipping polished front\-end experiences, building robust backend services, and integrating AI/ML and agentic capabilities directly into our product roadmap.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Stay abreast of the latest modern trends to build an intuitive and simplistic design, in alignment with client requirements
* Build solutions that can apply to a large audience, increasing scalability and high performance
* Increase the appeal of the application and product through effective and engaging designs
* Interact with other developer teams and design teams to discuss UI ideas
* Thoroughly review application needs and interfacing elements
* Follow proper documentation for changes in application and further updates
* **Contribute to the product roadmap** 
 by researching and integrating AI/ML initiatives, including multi\-agent applications, into scalable, production\-ready features
* **Collaborate on deployment and performance tracking** 
 of AI\-driven features in both real\-time and batch processes, systematically analyzing metrics to ensure optimal system functioning



  





**Requirements** 




**Backend Requirements** 



* **Proficient in FastAPI** 
 — routing, dependency injection, background tasks, middleware
* **Async Python** 
 — async/await, asyncio, concurrent request handling
* **Pydantic** 
 — data validation, serialisation, settings management
* **PostgreSQL** 
 — schema design, indexing, query optimisation, migrations using Alembic
* **Redis** 
 — caching, pub/sub, session storage, rate limiting
* Experience with PySpark and big data technologies is an advantage
* Exposure to enterprise\-scale SaaS architecture using Micro\-services and cloud platforms like AWS and Azure is a plus



  





**UI / Front\-End Requirements** 



* **Strong proficiency in React.js \& Next.js** 
 (JSX, Hooks, Context API, SSR/SSG, Virtual DOM, component lifecycle)
* **TypeScript** 
 expertise with ES6\+ (variables, scoping, array methods, DOM manipulation, event handlers)
* **State management** 
 using Redux Toolkit / Zustand / React Query (Flux architecture understanding)
* **Styling** 
 with Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, shadcn/ui, Radix UI
* **Build tools:** 
 Vite / Webpack, Babel, Create React App
* **Performance:** 
 Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, code splitting
* **Unit \& E2E testing:** 
 Vitest / Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Playwright
* RESTful APIs \& GraphQL consumption from the frontend
* HTML5, CSS3, responsive design fundamentals



  





**AI/ML \& Agentic Development** 



* **Ability to build multi\-agent applications** 
 and contribute to AI/ML\-driven features as part of the product roadmap
* Proficient in AI\-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude, or GitHub Copilot for faster coding, debugging, and code review
* Ability to use AI to generate applications, write tests, refactor code, and document APIs
* Comfortable working on large\-scale product development and data science\-driven projects



  





**Other** 



* Bachelor's / Master's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
* Strong communication and presentation skills



  





**About Mareana** 




 Founded in 2015, Mareana is an AI\-powered software company with the mission of accelerating digital transformation in manufacturing, supply chain, and sustainability via our connected intelligence platform.
 



  





 Mareana's platform uses AI/ML to rapidly connect disparate, siloed data across the entire business process, allowing our customers to shift their time and effort from data preparation to making complex business decisions intuitively, in real time.
 



  





 Our customers are market leaders in life sciences, chemicals, and general manufacturing who have realized over a billion dollars in business value by leveraging our platform.
 



 Our ethos of continuous innovation has been recognized by Gartner, who named us a "Cool Vendor in AI". We have also been featured as a thought leader in Silicon Review and Manufacturing Insights magazine.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Title:** 
 AI/GenAI– Manager
   

  

**Educational qualification:** 
 BTech/Masters/PhD
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are seeking an experienced GenAI Manager with 10\+ years of overall experience, including significant hands\-on expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG architectures, Conversational AI, and enterprise AI platforms. The ideal candidate will lead the design, delivery, governance, and scaling of AI solutions while managing cross\-functional teams of AI engineers, data scientists, architects, and business stakeholders.
   

  

 The role requires a strong blend of technical leadership, solution architecture, AI strategy, delivery management, and stakeholder engagement to drive enterprise\-wide adoption of GenAI capabilities. The candidate should have proven experience delivering AI\-powered solutions such as RAG applications, AI agents, copilots, knowledge management platforms, AI automation workflows, and multi\-agent systems, while ensuring Responsible AI, quality, security, and scalability standards are met.
   

  

 The individual will lead AI quality, validation, and governance initiatives to ensure the reliability, security, performance, and scalability of enterprise AI and GenAI solutions while partnering with technical and business teams.
   

  

**Important:** 
 Hands\-on experience delivering AI solutions in enterprise or production environments is required. Certifications, personal projects, and demos alone are not sufficient.
   

  

**Application Guidance:** 
 Candidates should be able to explain at least two AI/GenAI implementations, including the business use case, their contribution, technical approach, and measurable outcomes.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the design, development, and delivery of enterprise AI, GenAI, Agentic AI, and RAG\-based solutions aligned with business objectives.
* Define AI strategy, roadmaps, governance frameworks, and operating models to enable scalable AI adoption across the organization.
* Drive the architecture and implementation of AI platforms, copilots, multi\-agent systems, conversational AI solutions, and intelligent automation initiatives.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify high\-value AI use cases, establish success metrics, and realize business value.
* Oversee the end\-to\-end AI solution lifecycle, including ideation, architecture, development, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Lead and mentor cross\-functional teams of AI engineers, data scientists, architects, and developers, fostering innovation and delivery excellence.
* Establish best practices for Responsible AI, security, privacy, compliance, and risk management across AI implementations.
* Drive adoption of enterprise AI capabilities leveraging Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI, Databricks, vector databases, and modern AI frameworks.
* Ensure AI solutions are scalable, reliable, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture and governance standards.
* Partner with engineering and business teams to define evaluation frameworks, quality standards, and performance metrics for AI systems.
* Guide the implementation of RAG architectures, knowledge management solutions, and agentic workflows to enhance business productivity and decision\-making.
* Manage stakeholder communication, executive reporting, budgeting, resource planning, and delivery governance for AI programs.
* Stay current with emerging trends in GenAI, Agentic AI, multimodal AI, AI agents, and enterprise AI platforms to drive innovation and competitive advantage.
* Contribute to capability building, reusable accelerators, reference architectures, and thought leadership across the AI practice.


**Skills and Attributes:**
**Professional Experience**
* 10\+ years of overall experience, including 5\+ years leading AI/ML, GenAI, or data\-driven transformation initiatives in enterprise environments.
* Proven experience delivering and scaling production\-grade AI, GenAI, Agentic AI, Copilot, and RAG\-based solutions from concept through deployment and adoption.
+ Strong understanding of enterprise AI architecture and hands\-on exposure to multiple areas, including:
+ LLM and GenAI application development
+ RAG architectures and knowledge management solutions
+ Agentic AI and multi\-agent systems
+ Conversational AI and Copilot solutions
+ AI evaluation, governance, and Responsible AI
+ AI platform engineering and cloud\-based deployments
+ MLOps / LLMOps and operationalization of AI solutions
+ Data engineering, vector databases, and retrieval pipelines

* Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional teams of AI engineers, architects, data scientists, and developers.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with experience translating business needs into scalable AI solutions and measurable business outcomes.
* Experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI, Databricks, Microsoft Copilot, and related AI ecosystems.


**Educational Background**
* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field.


**Technical Skills**
* Strong understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, Agentic AI, Multi\-Agent Systems, and RAG architectures.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise\-scale GenAI, Copilot, Conversational AI, and AI Agent solutions.
* Experience defining AI strategy, solution roadmaps, architecture standards, and operating models.
* Strong knowledge of AI platform ecosystems including Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Databricks, Vector Databases, and Enterprise Search platforms.
* Experience leading the design and implementation of RAG pipelines, knowledge management solutions, and AI\-powered business applications.
* Understanding of AI evaluation, guardrails, observability, quality metrics, and Responsible AI practices.
* Experience establishing governance frameworks covering AI security, privacy, compliance, safety, and risk management.
* Strong knowledge of prompt engineering, agent orchestration frameworks, tool integrations, and workflow automation.
* Experience managing the end\-to\-end AI lifecycle, including ideation, development, deployment, monitoring, and adoption.
* Proven ability to lead and mentor AI engineers, architects, data scientists, and cross\-functional delivery teams.
* Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, cloud platforms, and business processes.
* Strong understanding of MLOps, LLMOps, model monitoring, performance optimization, and operationalization of AI solutions.
* Ability to work with executive stakeholders to identify AI opportunities, define business value, and drive adoption.
* Experience with enterprise architecture, software engineering best practices, scalability, reliability, and secure solution design.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills.


**Soft Skills**
* Excellent problem\-solving and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to translate AI capabilities into measurable business outcomes and enterprise value.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills, with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences.


**Other Responsibilities:**
* Lead the delivery of enterprise GenAI, Agentic AI, and RAG solutions, from ideation through deployment and business adoption.
* Define AI strategy, solution roadmaps, governance frameworks, and best practices to drive scalable AI adoption.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to identify opportunities, prioritize use cases, and deliver measurable business value.
* Mentor and lead cross\-functional teams of AI engineers, architects, and data scientists, ensuring delivery excellence and innovation.
* Drive AI governance, Responsible AI, security, compliance, and operational readiness across all AI initiatives.


**Why Join Us**
* Be at the forefront of AI\-driven innovation across multiple client sectors.
* Work with global clients to drive real business impact.
* Collaborate with a team of AI experts, analytics leaders, and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Engineer, IAM
description:
**Who Are We?**
 Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million\+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500\. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API\-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.
   

  

 The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore \- where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.
   

  

 P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API\-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Identity and Access Management team is responsible for building a secure, reliable, and seamless identity platform for all Postman users. This team owns the systems behind authentication, session management, access control, service accounts, invites, and other foundational identity capabilities that power the product.
   

  

 Postman’s identity layer is a critical part of the product experience. It sits on the path of every authenticated request and enables users, teams, and systems to access Postman securely and collaborate effectively. The team works on a mix of core platform improvements, new product capabilities, and reliability/security investments.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Design, build, and evolve backend systems that power Postman’s identity and authentication platform.
* Own projects end to end: clarify requirements, drive technical design, implement solutions, manage rollout, and support production.
* Work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to scope, build, test, and launch new features and platform improvements.
* Improve system reliability, scalability, observability, and operational readiness for services owned by the team.
* Make sound technical trade\-offs between speed, quality, and long\-term maintainability in a fast\-moving environment.
* Lead execution for projects involving 2–3 engineers when needed, including task breakdown, technical guidance, and code reviews.
* Participate in debugging, incident response, root cause analysis, and long\-term production fixes.
* Raise engineering quality by improving test coverage, reviewing designs and code, and advocating for strong software engineering practices.
* Partner with your manager on roadmap, prioritization, and SLAs for the services you own.
* Help create a team culture of ownership, reliability, and continuous improvement.


**About You**
* You have 5\+ years of experience building complex backend or distributed systems at scale.
* You have experience designing and operating production systems with strong reliability requirements.
* You are comfortable owning ambiguous problems and driving them from idea to production with minimal supervision.
* You have experience leading or guiding small groups of engineers on execution.
* You have strong engineering fundamentals in areas like distributed systems, networking, data modeling, and system design.
* You write code that is testable, maintainable, and easy to understand.
* You are comfortable making architectural and implementation trade\-offs, and can explain the reasoning clearly.
* You collaborate well with cross\-functional stakeholders and are comfortable respectfully challenging PMs, EMs, and peers when needed.
* You care about production quality, observability, and operational excellence, not just feature delivery.
* You have good written and verbal communication skills.


**Technical Experience We Value**
* Experience with backend technologies such as Node.js, Java, Python, Go, or Ruby
* Strong understanding of distributed systems and cloud infrastructure
* Experience building or operating microservices at scale
* Experience with databases, caching, queues, and event\-driven systems
* Experience with testing, monitoring, and incident response
* Familiarity with authentication, authorization, identity, RBAC, access control, or security\-sensitive systems is a plus, but not required


**What Else?**
 In addition to Postman's pay\-on\-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team\-building events will keep you connected, while our donation\-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long\-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.
   

  

 At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in\-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.
   

  

**Our Values**
 At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.
   

  

**Equal opportunity**
 Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC302347
description:
**Description**
**About the Role \& Team**
 We are seeking a Forward\-Deployed AI Architect to help our enterprise customers radically accelerate and modernize their software delivery lifecycle. In this elite, high\-impact role, you will embed directly with customer engineering teams to prove the value of AI\-led engineering through hands\-on architecture, agentic workflows, and measurable delivery outcomes.
   

  

 This role is designed for senior architects and builders who sit at the intersection of core enterprise software architecture and cutting\-edge AI engineering. You will help customers transition from traditional, ticket\-bound Scrum cycles toward intent\-driven, increasingly autonomous delivery models where AI tools, agents, and human governance seamlessly turn business intent into production\-ready software.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Candidate Profile: Qualifications \& Experience**
**Must\-Have Attributes**
 – Experience: 12\+ years of proven experience across software engineering, architecture, product/platform engineering, or solution architecture, backed by a strong track record of product\-side delivery.
   

  

 – SDLC Mastery: Deep, foundational understanding of enterprise software architecture, DevSecOps pipelines, Agile/Scrum frameworks, and the broader product lifecycle.
   

  

 – Hands\-on AI Fluency: Direct, practical fluency with AI development tools, IDE\-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI\-enabled software delivery. You must possess the ability to build, evaluate, and deeply explain working AI solutions.
   

  

 – Modern AI Tech Stack: Experience leveraging tools and frameworks such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG, and vector databases.
   

  

 – Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi\-agent orchestration, AI Observability
   

  

**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
 – Customer\-Facing Excellence: Prior experience in high\-touch, customer\-facing technical roles (e.g., Forward\-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, Field Engineer, or Pre\-Sales Engineering Leader).
   

  

 – AI Governance \& Security: A strong grasp of AI governance models, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, responsible AI frameworks, observability, and production readiness for AI\-enabled enterprise systems.
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Client Engagement \& Strategic Architecture


 – Identify AI Opportunities: Work directly with customer engineering, product, architecture, and executive teams to diagnose SDLC bottlenecks and map out high\-value areas for AI\-led acceleration.
   

  

 – Design \& Build Proofs of Concept: Act as a hands\-on builder to design, develop, and deliver working proofs utilizing modern AI engineering tools, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks.
   

  

 – Lead the Intent\-Driven Transition: Guide clients away from rigid, manual sprint mechanics toward fluid, intent\-driven delivery loops capable of autonomously generating plans, code, tests, documentation, and validation artifacts.
   

  

  

* Value Measurement \& Executive Alignment


 – Quantify AI Impact: Define, measure, and report on hard engineering acceleration outcomes, including reduced cycle times, faster story\-to\-code conversion, improved automated testing, and accelerated code reviews.
   

  

 – Technical \& Executive Presentation: Communicate complex technical approaches, agentic architectures, proof results, and long\-term adoption strategies to both engineering teams and C\-level stakeholders.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:** 
 We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
   

  

**About GlobalLogic**
 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward\-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

**Description**
 AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3\) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2\), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.
   

  

 Are you interested in building hyper\-scale database services in the cloud? Do you want to revolutionize the way databases are built for the cloud ? Do you want to have direct and immediate impact on hundreds of thousands of users who use AWS database services?
   

  

 Amazon Aurora is a MySQL and Postgres compatible, relational database service that combines the speed and availability of high\-end commercial databases with the simplicity and cost\-effectiveness of open source databases. It provides up to five times better performance than MySQL at a price point one tenth that of a commercial database while delivering similar performance and availability. Amazon Aurora is powered by an auto\-scaling, auto\-healing, distributed storage cluster of massive world\-wide scale.
   

  

 Amazon Aurora Storage platform team is looking for experienced software engineers who are excited about building large scale systems spanning tens of thousands of servers, across multiple data\-centers worldwide. These are core systems development positions where you will own the design and development of significant software components critical to our industry leading database services architected for the cloud.
   

  

 In this hands on position you will be asked to do everything from building rock\-solid components to mentoring other engineers. You need to not only be a top software developer with a good track record of delivering, but also excel in communication, leadership and customer focus. This is a unique and rare opportunity to get in on the ground floor within a fast growing business and help shape the technology, product and the business. A successful candidate will bring deep technical and software expertise and ability to work within a fast moving, startup environment in a large company to deliver high quality code that has a broad business impact.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

* 5\+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 5\+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

*Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self\-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee\-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high\-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry.*
**Job Description**
 Ares is seeking a curious, hands\-on Full Stack Developer at the Analyst level to join our Legal \& Compliance Technology engineering team in Mumbai. You will work with experienced engineers and global business partners to build, enhance, and support applications that help our Legal \& Compliance teams manage critical workflows, monitoring, controls, and reporting.
   

  

 This is an opportunity for an early\-career engineer to deepen full\-stack development skills, learn how technology supports the investment lifecycle and regulated business processes, and take increasing ownership of production software. You will contribute across user interfaces, services, integrations, and data while learning through design discussions, code reviews, and day\-to\-day collaboration.
   

  

 Prior experience in financial services or compliance is helpful, but not required. We are most interested in strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to turn requirements into reliable, well\-tested software.
   

  

**Primary Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Build and enhance full\-stack application features, from intuitive user interfaces to backend services, APIs, and data access.
* Partner with business analysts, product partners, and engineers to understand requirements, break work into clear user stories, and deliver incremental solutions with well\-defined acceptance criteria.
* Develop and support integrations with investment and enterprise systems using REST APIs, services, batch processing, and messaging or event patterns where appropriate.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code; participate actively in code reviews and apply standards for security, performance, resiliency, logging, and operational supportability.
* Use SQL to analyze data, validate results, troubleshoot workflows, and support data quality and reconciliation activities.
* Contribute to solutions for compliance monitoring, controls, exceptions, approvals, attestations, AML/KYC, and regulatory reporting, with guidance from domain and engineering partners.
* Gain exposure to modern data platforms such as Databricks and case\-management or low\-code platforms such as Pega as relevant to team priorities.
* Support releases and production stability by monitoring applications, investigating issues, documenting root causes, and improving automated checks and operational runbooks.
* Explore responsible uses of AI\-enabled automation and agentic workflows under guidance, with appropriate attention to security, traceability, and human oversight.
* Communicate progress, questions, and risks proactively while collaborating with colleagues in Mumbai, New York, and other global locations.


**Qualification**
**Experience Required:**
* 1\-3 years of professional software development experience building, testing, and supporting applications.
* Strong foundations in object\-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, clean\-code practices, debugging, and problem solving.
* Hands\-on development experience in at least one backend language such as Java, C\#, or Python, together with web development using JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and a modern component\-based frontend framework such as React, Angular, Vue, or an equivalent technology.
* Working proficiency in SQL and relational database concepts, including joins, data validation, and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with modern development practices such as Git\-based version control, code reviews, unit or integration testing, and CI/CD concepts.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, and a collaborative approach to working in a global team.
* Bachelor's degree required; Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred.
* Ability to collaborate across time zones, including reasonable overlap with U.S. colleagues when needed for team meetings, releases, or production support.


**What Will Help You Stand Out**
*The following are advantages, not a checklist. We encourage candidates who meet the core requirements and are excited to learn to apply.*
* A portfolio, academic project, internship, open\-source contribution, or other example that demonstrates end\-to\-end application development.
* Exposure to REST services, microservices, batch processing, integration patterns, or messaging and event\-driven architectures.
* Experience with cloud or modern data platforms, data pipelines, analytics environments, or Databricks.
* Exposure to Pega or another low\-code, workflow, or case\-management platform.
* Interest in investment management, financial services, compliance technology, or other regulated and high\-control environments.
* Experience experimenting with AI or LLM\-enabled automation in a secure, testable, and responsible way.


**What You Can Expect**
* Practical learning through pairing, design discussions, code reviews, and collaboration with experienced engineers.
* Meaningful ownership: you will ship production features and gradually take responsibility for applications or components as your experience grows.
* Broad technical exposure across full\-stack engineering, integrations, data, workflow platforms, production operations, and AI\-enabled automation.
* A global working environment with direct exposure to business and technology partners across the organization.
* A team culture that values thoughtful questions, continuous improvement, disciplined execution, and high\-quality outcomes.


**We recognize that strong candidates do not always match every preferred qualification. If this opportunity excites you and your experience aligns with most of the core requirements, we encourage you to apply.**
**Reporting Relationships**
*There is no set deadline to apply for this job opportunity. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the search is no longer active.*
