Location: Bangalore, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

**Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to join our agile, international team. You will design, implement, and evolve robust, scalable backend and frontend components. This position requires strong technical ability, attention to code quality, and a passion for delivering reliable products.
   

  

**In addition, you may have the opportunity to take on the role of Scrum Master for the squad, supporting agile ceremonies and continuous improvement initiatives.**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Deliver Full\-Stack Features: Actively design, develop, and maintain scalable backend (Go) and frontend (Angular) features. Uphold code quality, performance, and maintainability standards.
* Participate in Software Architecture Discussions: Collaborate with the team to ensure alignment on technical choices and contribute to the improvement of architectural solutions.
* Contribute to Code Reviews and Technical Problem Solving: Review peers’ code, identify issues, and share solutions to build a robust product.
* Collaborate Across International Teams : Work closely with distributed teams, product owners, architects, and stakeholders. Ensure clear communication, alignment, and efficient coordination in an international environment.
* Agile Leadership \& Scrum: Possibility to take on the role of Scrum Master, leading agile ceremonies and supporting team agility. Drive continuous improvement and facilitate collaboration within the squad


**Required Skills and Experience:**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Software Engineer with the below Skills preferably between 6 to 8 years of relevant experience
   

  

**Foundational Expertise** 
 :
   

  

 Deep expertise in algorithms and data structures, including proper optimization approaches for performance and speed (using Big O notation for time and space complexity).
   

  

 Distributed Systems, Networking basics, Operating Systems, API design, System design, Scalability, Reliability, Security fundamentals
   

  

**Programming Languages:**
 Experience with one or two of the following languages: Go (Golang), TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, SQL, Bash/Scripting
   

  

**Software Architecture:**
 Experience with modern architectures, building resilient and communicative distributed systems, and working with replicated databases.
   

  

 Microservices architecture, REST APIs, Event\-driven architecture, Clean Architecture, Integration patterns, Resilience patterns
   

  

**Web/Mobile Technologies** 
 :
   

  

 Proficiency in modern web and mobile technologies, such as PWAs (Progressive Web Apps), modern JS frameworks (e.g., Angular, React), WebGPU/WebGL, WebRTC, and Web performance optimization. Responsible design, REST client integration.
   

  

 Strong experience in front\-end development using Angular (12\+), including component\-driven architecture
   

  

**Caching and Optimization:**
 Knowledge of caching tools and strategies (Redis, IndexedDB, Local Storage API, Load balancing, Latency reduction, etc.).
   

  

**Development Practices:**
 Clean code, Code review, Test\-driven development (TDD), Unit testing, Integration testing, Documentation, Version control (Git), Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban), Secure coding practices
   

  

**DevOps \& SRE** 
 :
   

  

 CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Monitoring, Logging, Observability, High availability, Fault tolerance, Cloud environments.
   

  

**Team \& Mindset** 
 :
   

  

 Autonomy, technical excellence, communication, teamwork, problem\-solving, adaptability, curiosity, continuous improvement
   

  

**Agile \& Scrum:**
 In\-depth knowledge of the Scrum agile process, strong soft skills, and prior experience as Scrum Master would be a strong asset.
   

  

 At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**Role Overview**


We are seeking an experienced Power Platform engineer to design and deliver complex enterprise solutions for clients while helping raise the technical capability of our broader Power Platform team.


This is a hands\-on player coach role with significant client delivery responsibility. The Manager will remain deeply involved in solution architecture, software development, troubleshooting, implementation, technical reviews, and client discussions. This is not a primarily administrative or people management position.


The ideal candidate is a software engineer with deep Microsoft Power Platform expertise who can combine low code capabilities with custom development, enterprise architecture, and strong consulting skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as a hands\-on engineer and technical lead for complex client engagements involving Microsoft Power Platform.
* Design and build enterprise applications using Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, and related Microsoft technologies.
* Develop custom solutions using C\#/.NET, JavaScript or TypeScript, plugins, custom APIs, PCF components, custom connectors, Azure Functions, and other extensibility approaches.
* Design scalable Dataverse architectures, including data models, security, integrations, business logic, and performance considerations.
* Integrate Power Platform solutions with Azure, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Dynamics 365, SQL, APIs, and other enterprise systems.
* Implement strong ALM practices including source control, solution management, deployment automation, environment strategy, and CI/CD.
* Lead technical discovery sessions and translate business requirements into practical, well\-designed solutions.
* Communicate architecture decisions, tradeoffs, risks, estimates, and recommendations clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Provide technical leadership across multiple engagements and act as an escalation point for complex engineering challenges.
* Establish and promote engineering standards, reusable patterns, code quality expectations, and delivery best practices.
* Mentor engineers and technical leads and help improve engineering quality across the broader team.
* Help teams determine when Power Platform is the right solution and when custom development or other technologies are more appropriate.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8 or more years of professional software engineering, application development, solution architecture, or related technology experience.
* 4 or more years of substantial hands\-on Microsoft Power Platform engineering experience.
* Strong software development experience using C\#/.NET and JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Experience extending Power Platform through plugins, custom APIs, PCF components, custom connectors, Azure Functions, or similar technologies.
* Strong understanding of Dataverse architecture, security, data modeling, integration patterns, solution management, and performance.
* Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and integrating with enterprise systems.
* Experience with Azure services, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Dynamics 365, SQL, and related technologies.
* Strong experience with ALM, source control, deployment automation, managed solutions, and CI/CD.
* Strong understanding of professional software engineering practices including code review, testing, debugging, monitoring, and production support.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical delivery on complex enterprise application projects.
* Strong client facing communication, consulting, and facilitation skills.
* Ability to lead technical discussions, challenge assumptions, explain tradeoffs, and provide clear recommendations.
* Experience mentoring engineers and improving technical practices across a team.
* Experience working with global clients and distributed delivery teams, including appropriate overlap with US based stakeholders when required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Power Platform governance, environment strategy, security standards, or Center of Excellence practices.
* Experience with Azure technologies such as Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault, or Application Insights.
* Experience working in consulting or professional services environments.
* Experience supporting presales, estimation, technical proposals, demonstrations, or workshops.
* Microsoft Power Platform or Azure certifications such as PL 400, PL 600, or related credentials.

**What Success Looks Like**


Successful engineers in this role remain highly engaged in client delivery while also raising the technical capability of the broader team. They are trusted by clients, comfortable solving difficult engineering problems, able to make sound architecture decisions, and capable of guiding others through complex technical challenges.


They approach Power Platform as an enterprise application development platform and combine its native capabilities with strong software engineering practices to deliver secure, scalable, maintainable solutions.

 **What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.


In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high\-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.


Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.


We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  

  

**How You Can Grow:**  

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  

  

**More about Crowe:**

The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.

We are committed to a merit\-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job\-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

description:

 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer\-facing or support role.
* Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms.
* Experience building full\-stack solutions that interface with enterprise systems.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* 4 years of experience in software development, systems architecture, or a highly technical customer\-facing role with proficiency in one of more general\-purpose programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go).
* Experience managing the technical pre\-sales cycle, from initial scoping and architecture design to the successful delivery of integrated PoVs.
* Experience with cloud\-native application development.
* Experience designing and building AI applications.


**About The Job**
 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem\-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
   

  

 As an Applied Solutions Architect within the Google Cloud Go\-To\-Market (GTM) team, you will act as the technical bridge between our customers' business challenges and Google’s engineering capabilities. You will work closely with customers to uncover their needs, architect scalable systems, and write code and build real\-world applications.
   

  

 You will not be building in a vacuum. Your core objective is to engineer the Proof of Value (PoV) products designed to integrate seamlessly into a customer’s existing, "as\-is" systems. By keeping the final production end\-state in mind from day one, you will advocate for our AI and cloud\-native solutions to not only look great on a whiteboard but function flawlessly in their actual enterprise environment.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the technical discovery sessions to understand customer requirements and their current technology landscape. Design comprehensive system architectures and run iterative workshops with stakeholders to lock in project scope, always architecting with the final end\-state in mind.
* Move seamlessly from high\-level architecture to low\-level implementation. Code, build, and deploy robust cloud systems, ensuring technical designs translate into functional, integrated realities.
* Architect and engineer enterprise\-grade AI solutions—such as agentic workflows, RAG systems, and applied foundation models—backed by highly scalable, cloud\-native infrastructure including event\-driven microservices, containerized workloads, and serverless compute.
* Engineer functional PoV products that integrate into the customer's as\-is systems to demonstrate true business value. Ensure all builds adhere strictly to engineering best practices, security standards, and scalability guidelines to ensure a smooth transition to production.

description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.
   

  





**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**




 Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost\-to\-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise\-grade yet easy\-to\-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.
   

  





***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.***



**Job Description**

 At Freshworks, we don’t just ship software—we shape it to be fast, reliable, and refreshingly simple. As a
 **Staff Full Stack Engineer (IC4\)** 
 , you will architect the end\-to\-end systems that drive our global SaaS products, balancing complex distributed backend infrastructure with highly responsive, scalable frontend applications. You will lead cross\-functional technical strategies, champion engineering excellence across teams, and mentor engineers to level up our entire platform ecosystem.
   

  





 If you obsess over time and space complexity, love breaking down tough, multi\-tier architectural problems, and take pride in leading technical execution without losing touch with the code—you’ll feel right at home.
   

  





**Impact You Can Create**



* **E2E Platform Evolution:** 
 Own and scale foundational full\-stack architectures capable of handling millions of transactions while delivering seamless, high\-performance web experiences globally.
* **Technical Guidance (IC4\):** 
 Act as a technical compass across multiple engineering tracks, translating ambiguous product visions into resilient, modular high\-level and low\-level designs.
* **Engineering Multiplier:** 
 Foster a culture of excellence by leading deep\-dive code reviews, mentoring junior/mid\-level systems engineers, and introducing modern architectural patterns.
* **AI\-Powered Efficiency:** 
 Pioneer the integration of modern AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) into the daily full\-stack development workflow to accelerate delivery without sacrificing technical depth.



**Roles \& Responsibilities (R\&R)**



* **Full\-Stack Architecture:** 
 Architect, build, and maintain scalable backend microservices and extensible REST APIs paired with intuitive, modular frontend application layers.
* **Full Lifecycle Ownership:** 
 Own the entire software development lifecycle—from gathering functional/non\-functional requirements and data modeling to deployment, automation, and production support.
* **Code \& Design Optimization:** 
 Write clean, modular, and testable code optimized for browser rendering efficiency, database execution performance, and space/time complexity.
* **Production Governance:** 
 Ensure backend and frontend systems are tuned for high availability (99\.99%\+), multi\-tenant fault tolerance, security compliance, and deep observability.
* **Cross\-Functional Partnership:** 
 Collaborate closely with Product Managers, UI/UX designers, and Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) to ship highly localized, value\-driven capabilities fast.
* **Root\-Cause Analysis:** 
 Troubleshoot complex full\-stack performance bottlenecks in production, from slow database queries to state\-management memory leaks.
* **Mentorship \& Best Practices:** 
 Lead architectural reviews, establish development roadmaps, mentor 2–4 engineers, and actively drive OOPS and SOLID design principles across the org.


**Qualifications**

**Skills**



* **Computer Science Foundations:** 
 Expert\-level grasp of Data Structures \& Algorithms (DSA), time/space complexity trade\-offs, and Object\-Oriented Design (OOD) anchored in SOLID principles.
* **System Design (HLD \& LLD):** 
 Proven capability to design scalable, highly available, and fault\-tolerant end\-to\-end multi\-tenant systems, including APIs, web architectures, schemas, and data models.
* **Distributed Infrastructure Stack:** 
 Solid exposure to RDBMS, NoSQL, caching strategies, microservices architecture, and distributed queuing systems.
* **Modern Web Ecosystems:** 
 Strong understanding of frontend engineering paradigms, including component lifecycles, state management, and client\-side performance optimization.
* **Cloud \& DevOps Practice:** 
 Hands\-on experience working with CI/CD automation pipelines, DevOps tooling, and cloud infrastructure platforms (AWS or GCP).
* **AI Tool Fluency:** 
 Practical exposure and experience using generative AI tools to improve day\-to\-day coding efficiency and technical exploration.
* **Technical Communication:** 
 Exceptional logical reasoning with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical thought processes and designs to both engineers and executives.



**Qualifications**

**About Gruve**
 Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well\-funded early\-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Gruve is seeking a Senior Software Engineer (Java) for the SecurityHub365 platform to work closely with the Engineering team in Pune and drive backend delivery for Gruve’s multi\-tenant Security Operations (SOC) and ITSM platform. SecurityHub365 ingests and correlates security\-incident data, manages the ITSM lifecycle, and integrates with SIEM/XDR and enterprise systems. It runs as an event\-driven microservice platform and is actively modernising across containerisation, cloud, and stronger platform foundations.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on build\-and\-lead role. The Lead Engineer will own significant parts of the backend, raise the engineering bar, mentor an early\-career team, and drive delivery, while still writing and reviewing code daily. We are an AI\-forward team, and using AI tooling effectively is central to how we build.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**
**Design \& Delivery Ownership**
* Own the end\-to\-end design and delivery of backend services and features, within the platform’s architectural direction, from requirements and API contracts through implementation, testing, and production.
* Make design decisions within your services, set patterns, and guide the team through trade\-offs.
* Contribute to and influence platform architecture alongside the platform architect.


**Technical Leadership \& Mentoring**
* Provide day\-to\-day technical leadership to drive tech deliveries and solutioning and raise the engineering bar through code review and design guidance.
* Mentor junior/new engineers, grow their skills, and reduce single\-points\-of\-failure by spreading knowledge.


**Quality, Security \& Reliability**
* Drive testing strategy, security, resilience, and performance on a multi\-tenant platform where correctness and tenant isolation matter.
* Own non\-functional concerns: authentication and authorization, error handling, observability, and safe rollout.


**AI\-Augmented Engineering (core to this role)**
* Use AI coding assistants and agentic tools (for example Claude Code, Claude, Copilot) day to day: scaffolding, refactoring, generating tests, and documentation.
* Apply strong prompt engineering and agentic, “vibe\-coding” workflows: decompose work into well\-scoped tasks, delegate to AI agents, steer them, and integrate the results cleanly.
* Exercise judgement on where AI helps (boilerplate, CRUD, mirrored patterns, tests, docs) versus where human rigour is required (security, authentication, correctness, and architecture). Review AI\-generated code critically; never merge it blind.
* Help the team adopt AI well, setting sensible practices and review gates so speed never comes at the cost of quality.


**Agile Delivery \& Planning**
* Drive sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, and breaking epics into deliverable stories.
* Produce defensible estimates grounded in the work, and sequence discovery and scope before committing timelines.


**Collaboration \& Stakeholders**
* Partner with product and the SOC/automation teams to scope work, define boundaries, and turn requirements into buildable plans.
* Communicate clearly with stakeholders, manage expectations, and provide clear delivery status.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 6 to 8 years building systems in Java and React/Angular, min 2 years full stack development exp. with strong fundamentals (OOP, concurrency, data structures, clean code) and depth in Spring Boot.
* Proven experience designing and running microservices and RESTful APIs (contract\-first / OpenAPI a plus).
* Hands\-on with event\-driven architecture using Apache Kafka (topics, consumers, delivery semantics, eventual\-consistency trade\-offs).
* Solid experience with MongoDB (data modelling, queries, indexing); working knowledge of relational databases.
* Experience with authentication and authorization in multi\-tenant systems: JWT/OAuth2 and identity integration (LDAP/AD).
* Experience with containerisation and CI/CD: Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins (or equivalent), Git\-based workflows, static analysis.
* Demonstrated technical leadership: mentoring, code review, and owning delivery for a squad.
* Fluency in Agile/Scrum and the ability to write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and defensible estimates.
* Effective, hands\-on use of AI development tools (AI assistants and agentic coding e.g. ClaudeCode) with sound judgement on review and quality.
* Strong communication skills across technical and non\-technical audiences; comfortable working with distributed teams across India and the US.


**Preferred Qualifications/skills**
* Familiarity with Azure cloud services and infrastructure\-as\-code.
* Exposure to security operations / SOC / ITSM domains, or integrations with SIEM/XDR (for example QRadar, Cisco XDR), Jira, or Cherwell.
* Experience modernising legacy systems and paying down technical debt.
* Experience mentoring or leading early\-career engineers.
* Prior experience in a startup or high\-growth technology environment.
* Hands\-on, senior full stack engineer who combines strong system\-design skills with Java \& front end technologies.

 At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.

 About AI Unika
 



 AI Unika is a technology company building intelligent products for real\-world problems across
 **Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, Automation, Mobility, Data and Software Engineering** 
 . We are not interested in simply creating another software product or building a company where people come to work, complete assigned tickets and go home. We are building a team that wants to create something meaningful, ambitious and lasting.
 



 We are at a stage where the right people can genuinely influence what the company becomes. Your work can be seen, your ideas can be heard and your decisions can directly contribute to the products we build. That's why this opportunity is for someone who is looking for more than a designation and a monthly salary.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We are looking for a
 **Full Stack Developer with 3\+ years of strong hands\-on MERN Stack experience** 
 who genuinely enjoys building products. Someone who can take an idea or business problem, understand what needs to be solved, design the right technical approach, build the application, deploy it, troubleshoot it in production and continuously make it better.
 



 You will work primarily with
 **MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript** 
 , building complete applications rather than working within a narrow technical boundary. You should be comfortable moving between frontend, backend, database, APIs and production environments whenever the product requires it.
 



 Your work will involve developing modern React applications, designing reusable components, building Node.js and Express.js backend services, creating secure REST APIs, designing MongoDB schemas and aggregation pipelines, integrating third\-party services, implementing authentication and authorization, optimizing application performance and supporting production deployments.
 



  





 💻 Technical Skills \& Qualifications
 


* **3\+ years** 
 of professional Full Stack Development experience
* Strong hands\-on experience with
 **MongoDB, Express.js, React.js and Node.js**

 **JavaScript (ES6\+)**
* Good hands\-on experience with

 , Hooks, component architecture and state management

 backend applications

 is an advantage
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, testing and release management



  





 ❤️
 **We Are Looking for a Builder** 




 We can teach a framework. We can introduce you to a new technology. We can help you understand a new business domain.
 



 What is much harder to teach is
 **the desire to build something extraordinary.** 




 We want someone who sees an unfinished product and gets excited rather than uncomfortable. Someone who can receive a difficult requirement and say,
 **“Let's figure it out.”** 
 Someone who doesn't need every step explained before beginning. Someone who takes ownership when something breaks, thinks about why a feature exists instead of blindly implementing it, and cares about whether the customer actually benefits from what was built.
 



 At AI Unika, we don't want developers who only ask,
 **“What should I code?”** 




 We want developers who ask,
 **“What are we trying to achieve, and what is the best way to build it?”** 




  





 🚀
 **Our Startup Culture** 




 AI Unika is a startup, and startup life is different. Not every requirement will arrive perfectly documented. Priorities can change. New problems can appear unexpectedly. Sometimes the most important work of the day won't be mentioned in your original job description.
 



 Our culture is simple:
 



**“Every work is my work. We complete every challenge as one team.”** 




 If the product needs help, we help. If production has a problem, we solve it. If another team needs technical support, we contribute. If the customer has a problem, we don't start by asking whose responsibility it is—we start by asking how we can solve it.
 



 Your designation tells us your expertise.
 **It does not define the limit of your contribution.** 




 We value people who step forward, learn quickly, communicate openly and take responsibility even when nobody is standing behind them.
 



  





 🤝
 **Work Close to the Action** 




 You will have the opportunity to work closely with
 **Founders, Product, Technology, Business and other teams** 
 , giving you exposure that goes far beyond writing code.
 



 You'll understand why a product is being built, what customers actually need, how business decisions influence technology and how technology ultimately creates value. If you have a better technical idea, we expect you to bring it forward. If you see a risk, we expect you to raise it. If you believe something can be built better, we want you to challenge it constructively.
 



 We want engineers who can
 **think like owners** 
 , not simply execute instructions.
 



  





 🌍
 **Build Technology That Goes Into the Real World** 




 Your work at AI Unika may contribute to products involving
 **AI, Computer Vision, Mobility, Automation, Data, SaaS and intelligent systems** 
 . You may work with real\-world datasets, intelligent workflows, third\-party platforms, APIs and applications that are used outside the development environment.
 



 You will experience the complete journey of software:
 



**Build it. Deploy it. Watch it work. Find what doesn't work. Fix it. Improve it. Scale it.** 




 That experience is difficult to gain when your entire career is limited to maintaining an already\-finished product.
 



  





 📈
 **What This Opportunity Can Become** 




 We don't want your next five years to simply add five years to your resume.
 



 We want those years to fundamentally change what you're capable of.
 



 Your growth at AI Unika will come from the problems you can solve, the products you can own, the responsibility you can handle and the impact you create. As your capability grows, your responsibility can grow with it.
 



 You may begin by owning features, then larger modules, architecture, technical decisions and eventually complete products or teams. The opportunity will be driven by
 **capability, ownership, performance, learning and contribution** 
 .
 



  





 💰
 **Compensation** 




 The CTC for this position is
 **up to ₹7 LPA** 
 , with the final compensation determined based on experience, technical capability, practical problem\-solving ability, interview performance and overall suitability.
 



 We understand that salary is important. Everyone deserves fair compensation for their work.
 



 But there is something we want to be very clear about.
 



**If you're looking for this role only because you want a salary hike or a bigger number on your CTC, this may not be the right opportunity for you.** 




 We respect people who priorities compensation, but that's not the person we're trying to build our core team around.
 



 At AI Unika,
 **we are looking for assets, not liabilities.** 




 We want people who make the organization stronger because they are here. People who create value instead of simply consuming resources. People who take responsibility, learn continuously, solve problems and help the entire team move forward.
 



 If your mindset is only
 **“What will I get?”** 
 , we may not be the right fit.
 



 If your mindset is
 **“What can I build, what can I learn, what can I contribute and what can I become?”** 
 , then we genuinely want to meet you.
 



  





 🌟 Maybe This Is the Opportunity You've Been Waiting For
 



 There are thousands of Full Stack Developer openings.
 



 Most will offer you a technology stack, a designation, a salary and a defined list of responsibilities.
 



 We are offering something different.
 



 You can join while the journey is still being written. You can work on products that are still evolving. You can sit close to the people making decisions. You can see your code become a real feature, your feature become a real product and your product create real impact.
 



 You won't simply inherit someone else's roadmap.
 



**You can help shape it.** 




 You won't simply maintain someone else's creation.
 



**You can help create something of your own.** 




 And perhaps years from now, the most valuable thing you remember won't be the salary you received in your first year.
 



 It will be the things you learned, the problems you solved, the people you built with and the products you can point to and say:
 



**“I was there when we built this.”** 




 If that feeling matters to you more than simply finding another job,
 **AI Unika could be the place you've been looking for.** 




 🚀 AI Unika
 **Build something real. Own your work. Learn without limits. Grow with the journey. Create something you'll be proud of. we People First Company.**

Applying for a job at PUMA is easy. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.


  
**Your mission**
----------------


**About the Organisation \& Role:**


You will be part of the Consumer Intelligence \& Engagement organisation responsible for delivering the intelligence and engagement capabilities that enable more relevant and personalised consumer experiences across digital channels. The organisation plays a key role in how consumers discover products, engage with content, and elevate experiences through membership \& loyalty. Through capabilities such as personalisation, recommendations, consumer intelligence, experimentation, and AI\-driven decisioning, the organisation helps deliver more contextual, data\-driven interactions across the consumer journey.


As a Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack), you will build backend services for the membership and loyalty capabilities. You will be responsible for technical design, development and validation. Working closely with the Lead Engineer, Product Owner and Engineering Manager, you will deliver low latency services that support real\-time consumer experiences. You will also be building reusable assets for consistent development and delivery.


**What you will do:**


* Design, build, and operate scalable, low\-latency APIs, event\-driven services, and integration layers that support real\-time and batch membership, loyalty, rewards, and consumer engagement use cases.
* Develop and evolve customer\-facing web applications and supporting backend services, ensuring a seamless and consistent membership and loyalty experience across digital channels.
* Configure, extend, and integrate the Antavo loyalty platform, including custom workflows, reward mechanisms, member lifecycle processes, event processing, and promotional capabilities.
* Design and implement integrations between Antavo and enterprise commerce platforms such as SFCC, Fluent Commerce, CDP, CRM, marketing automation, and data platforms to support accurate and near real\-time member data synchronisation.
* Apply distributed systems principles including asynchronous processing, idempotency, caching, retries, circuit breakers, and event\-driven architectures to build resilient and reliable member experiences at scale.
* Ensure solutions are secure, observable, reliable, and resilient by implementing engineering best practices for monitoring, logging and performance optimisation.
* Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Lead Engineers, Architects, Data Engineers, and AI/ML Engineers to deliver business capabilities and contribute to technical design decisions.
* Contribute to engineering standards, reusable libraries, reference implementations, and platform capabilities that improve consistency, maintainability, and developer experience across teams.
* Troubleshoot production issues through monitoring, logging, crash analysis, and root cause investigation.
* Mentor junior engineers, conduct code reviews, share technical knowledge, and promote engineering best practices across the team
**Your talent**
---------------


* 7\+ years of experience designing and building large scale distributed backend systems on cloud\-native platforms.
* Experience implementing or integrating enterprise loyalty platforms (Antavo preferred), including member lifecycle management, rewards, promotions, campaign execution, and loyalty transaction processing.
* Strong understanding of design patterns, data structures and algorithms, with practical experience applying them to real\-world use cases.
* Expertise in backend engineering, API design, microservices, event\-driven architectures, and scalable integration patterns using Java, Spring Boot and related frameworks.
* Working knowledge of React and modern frontend development practices sufficient to contribute to customer\-facing applications.
* Experience with Node.js and related frameworks.
* Experience in event streaming platforms like Kafka.
* Experience with SQL/No\-SQL databases with understanding of database architecture and distributed data management.
* Experience with observability, reliability engineering and performance optimisation.
* Experience using coding agents, LLMs or AI\-assisted engineering tools.
* Experience in eCommerce, retail, or consumer digital products is strongly preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
**Our principles**
------------------


PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.


At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity \- no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people \-with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.

 Responsible for developing and/or engineering the end\-to\-end features of a system, from user experience to backend code. Use development skills to deliver innovative solutions that help our clients improve the services they provide. Leverage new technologies that can be applied to solve challenging business problems with a cloud first and agile mindset.

 Laboratory Information and Execution Systems
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 7\.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 As a Full Stack Engineer, a typical day involves designing, developing, and implementing comprehensive system features that span from the user interface to the backend infrastructure. This role requires actively engaging in the creation of innovative solutions that enhance client services, while continuously exploring and applying emerging technologies. The work environment encourages a cloud\-first approach and agile methodologies, fostering collaboration and adaptability to address complex business challenges effectively.  Additional Information:
   

  

* The candidate should have minimum 7\.5 years of experience in Laboratory Information and Execution Systems.
* This position is based at our Kolkata office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
===================

**Infrastructure Engineer Intern**
----------------------------------

**Location:** Bangalore – Brookfield**Department:** IT Infrastructure / Technology**Employment Type:** Internship – Full\-Time**Working Hours:** 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday (Alternate Saturdays Off)**Experience:** Fresher / Recent Graduate / Intern### **About the Role**


We are looking for a motivated and technically strong **Infrastructure Engineer Intern** to join our IT Infrastructure and Technology team.
The candidate will receive hands\-on exposure to:  

* Server administration
* Virtualization
* Networking
* Endpoint support
* Operating systems
* Monitoring
* Cybersecurity
* Backups
* Databases
* Application platforms
* Infrastructure operations


The candidate must also have a **basic understanding of Frontend, Backend, and Full\-Stack development**, as the role involves supporting the infrastructure on which business applications and software platforms operate.
The ideal candidate should be interested in building a career in:  

* Infrastructure Engineering
* System Administration
* Network Administration
* DevOps
* Cloud Infrastructure
* IT Operations

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**1\. Infrastructure Management**
---------------------------------

* Assist in deploying, configuring, and maintaining on\-premises physical servers.
* Support environments consisting of multiple physical servers and virtual machines.
* Assist in managing servers deployed at client locations.
* Support virtualization environments and VM lifecycle management.
* Assist with VM creation, configuration, maintenance, backup, and decommissioning.
* Assist with IP allocation and network configuration.
* Maintain infrastructure documentation and configuration records.
* Support infrastructure capacity and resource monitoring.

**2\. Server Management**
-------------------------

* Assist in administering Linux, Windows, and macOS environments.
* Gain exposure to Dell and HP physical servers.
* Monitor server health and system performance.
* Assist in troubleshooting CPU, memory, storage, and performance issues.
* Monitor server availability and application services.
* Assist with database server and application platform administration.
* Perform basic server maintenance under supervision.
* Assist with patching, updates, and routine infrastructure activities.

**3\. End\-User Device \& Desktop Support**
-------------------------------------------

* Provide first\-level technical support for laptops, desktops, printers, and peripherals.
* Diagnose and resolve basic hardware and software issues.
* Troubleshoot driver and peripheral connectivity problems.
* Install and configure operating systems and applications.
* Prepare, image, and configure laptops/desktops for new employees.
* Support employee onboarding and IT setup.
* Maintain proper records of assigned IT equipment.

**4\. Operating System Administration**
---------------------------------------


Assist with installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of:  

* Windows
* Ubuntu/Linux
* macOS

**Responsibilities include:**  

* OS installation and configuration.
* Software and application installation.
* Driver troubleshooting.
* OS updates and patching.
* Boot and startup troubleshooting.
* Performance troubleshooting.
* Application compatibility troubleshooting.
* Basic system security configuration.

**5\. Network Infrastructure Management**
-----------------------------------------

* Assist in configuring and troubleshooting network switches.
* Support routers and wireless access points.
* Troubleshoot LAN and Wi\-Fi connectivity.
* Assist with IP addressing and network configuration.
* Understand basic VLAN and network segmentation concepts.
* Assist with firewall configuration and monitoring.
* Monitor firewall logs and identify unusual traffic.
* Assist with VPN configuration and remote connectivity.
* Support secure external access.
* Assist with periodic firewall rule reviews.
* Learn basic network performance optimization.
* Troubleshoot connectivity, latency, and network performance issues.

**6\. Endpoint Security \& Antivirus Management**
-------------------------------------------------

* Assist in deploying and managing Seqrite Antivirus and Endpoint Security.
* Monitor endpoint security status.
* Monitor malware and virus alerts.
* Assist with quarantine and security incident handling.
* Ensure endpoint definitions and security policies remain updated.
* Assist with endpoint security agent installation.
* Troubleshoot antivirus agent connectivity and installation issues.
* Maintain basic endpoint security documentation.

**7\. Infrastructure Monitoring**
---------------------------------


Assist in administering and maintaining:  

* Zabbix
* Uptime Monitoring
* Grafana
* SigNoz

**Responsibilities include:**  

* Monitor server availability.
* Monitor VM availability.
* Track CPU utilization.
* Track memory utilization.
* Monitor disk and storage utilization.
* Monitor application and service availability.
* Review alerts and logs.
* Assist in troubleshooting infrastructure alerts.
* Maintain monitoring dashboards.
* Support proactive infrastructure monitoring.

**8\. CCTV Infrastructure Support**
-----------------------------------

* Monitor CCTV system health and uptime.
* Ensure network connectivity to CCTV cameras.
* Troubleshoot basic camera connectivity issues.
* Monitor video feed availability.
* Assist with CCTV hardware and software troubleshooting.
* Monitor CCTV storage.
* Assist with surveillance footage archiving.
* Ensure required retention policies are followed.

**9\. Backup \& Storage Management**
------------------------------------

* Assist in maintaining backup infrastructure.
* Monitor scheduled backups.
* Verify successful completion of backups.
* Identify and report backup failures.
* Assist with database and server backup activities.
* Perform basic backup validation.
* Assist with restoration testing.
* Maintain backup documentation.
* Gain practical exposure to disaster recovery concepts.

**10\. IT Asset Management**
----------------------------

* Maintain hardware and software inventory.
* Track laptops, desktops, servers, monitors, printers, and networking equipment.
* Maintain asset allocation records.
* Track asset lifecycle and replacement requirements.
* Assist with procurement activities.
* Maintain infrastructure and asset documentation.
* Ensure proper handover and return of IT assets.

**11\. Core Platform Services**
-------------------------------

* Gain practical exposure to LDAP and directory services.
* Assist with basic identity and access management.
* Support user and system access activities under supervision.
* Maintain infrastructure room and server room documentation.
* Assist with physical infrastructure inspections.
* Maintain proper organization of network and server equipment.
* Follow infrastructure security and operational procedures.

**12\. Frontend Development Knowledge – MANDATORY**
===================================================


The candidate must have basic knowledge of **Frontend development**.### **Required Understanding**

* HTML
* CSS
* JavaScript
* Basic frontend application architecture.
* Basic understanding of browser and client\-server communication.
* Understanding of frontend build and deployment concepts.
* Basic understanding of API integration.
* Basic troubleshooting of frontend application issues.

### **Preferred**

* React
* Angular
* Vue.js
* npm
* Frontend build tools


The candidate should understand how a frontend application is hosted, deployed, accessed, and connected to backend services.**13\. Backend Development Knowledge – MANDATORY**
==================================================


The candidate must have basic knowledge of **Backend development**.### **Required Understanding**

* Basic backend application architecture.
* REST APIs.
* HTTP/HTTPS.
* API requests and responses.
* Authentication and authorization concepts.
* Application\-server communication.
* Basic backend troubleshooting.
* Basic database connectivity.

### **Backend Technologies**


Candidate should have exposure to at least one backend technology/language such as:  

* Java
* Python
* Node.js
* PHP
* .NET


The candidate should be able to understand how backend applications run on servers and communicate with databases and frontend applications.**14\. Full\-Stack Development Knowledge – MANDATORY**
======================================================


The candidate must have a basic understanding of **Full\-Stack application architecture**.
The candidate should understand the relationship between:**Frontend API/Backend Database Backend Frontend**### **Basic Knowledge Should Include**

* Frontend application structure.
* Backend/API structure.
* Database interaction.
* REST APIs.
* Application deployment.
* Server\-side application hosting.
* Basic application troubleshooting.
* Basic understanding of logs and application errors.
* Basic understanding of application\-server communication.


The candidate is **not required to be an expert Full\-Stack Developer**, but must understand how a complete application works across frontend, backend, database, server, and network layers.**15\. Database Knowledge – MANDATORY**
=======================================

* Basic understanding of databases.
* Basic SQL knowledge.
* Understanding of tables, records, and queries.
* Basic knowledge of relational databases.
* Understanding of application\-to\-database connectivity.
* Basic database troubleshooting.

### **Preferred Database Exposure**

* MySQL
* PostgreSQL
* SQL Server
* Similar databases

**16\. DevOps \& Development Tools**
====================================


Basic exposure to the following will be an advantage:  

* Git
* GitHub/GitLab
* Docker
* CI/CD concepts
* Build and deployment processes
* Shell scripting
* Python scripting
* Linux command line
* Application logs
* Environment variables
* Basic cloud concepts

**Mandatory Technical Skills**
==============================


The candidate must have basic knowledge or academic/project exposure to:### **Infrastructure**

* Infrastructure
* Linux/Ubuntu
* Windows
* Computer hardware
* Servers
* Virtual machines

### **Networking**

* Networking fundamentals
* TCP/IP
* DNS
* DHCP
* LAN/Wi\-Fi
* Routers and switches
* Basic firewall concepts

### **Development**

* **Frontend – Mandatory**
* **Backend – Mandatory**
* **Full\-Stack concepts – Mandatory**
* **Database/SQL – Mandatory**
* REST APIs
* HTTP/HTTPS
* Basic application architecture

### **Security \& Monitoring**

* Basic cybersecurity concepts
* Antivirus/Endpoint Security
* System monitoring
* Logs and troubleshooting

**Preferred Technical Exposure**
================================


Candidates having exposure to the following will be preferred:  

* Zabbix
* Grafana
* SigNoz
* Uptime Monitoring
* Docker
* Git/GitHub
* CI/CD
* Shell scripting
* Python
* LDAP
* Active Directory
* VPN
* Firewall administration
* Cloud platforms
* Database administration
* Backup and disaster recovery

**Educational Qualification**
=============================

* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related field.
* BCA / MCA or equivalent IT qualification.
* Freshers and recent graduates are welcome.
* Candidates with academic projects in Infrastructure, Networking, DevOps, Full\-Stack Development, or System Administration are preferred.

**Candidate Profile**
=====================


We are looking for someone who:  

* Has a strong interest in IT Infrastructure and Technology.
* Has basic knowledge of both Infrastructure and Software Development.
* Is comfortable working with Linux and Windows.
* Understands basic networking concepts.
* Has basic Frontend, Backend, and Full\-Stack knowledge.
* Has good troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Is willing to work hands\-on with servers, networks, systems, and applications.
* Can learn new technologies quickly.
* Has good communication and teamwork skills.
* Is willing to work in an onsite infrastructure environment.

**Key Learning Opportunities**
==============================


During the internship, the candidate will gain practical exposure to:  

* Server administration
* Linux administration
* Windows administration
* Virtualization
* Networking
* Firewalls and VPN
* Endpoint security
* Zabbix and Grafana monitoring
* Application monitoring
* Database environments
* Backup and disaster recovery
* CCTV infrastructure
* IT asset management
* LDAP
* Frontend applications
* Backend applications
* Full\-Stack architecture
* APIs
* Application deployment
* DevOps fundamentals
* Infrastructure troubleshooting

**Career Path**
===============


This internship can provide a foundation for careers in:  

* Infrastructure Engineer
* System Administrator
* Network Engineer
* DevOps Engineer
* Cloud Engineer
* IT Operations Engineer
* Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
* Application Support Engineer
* Full\-Stack Infrastructure/Platform Engineer

**Internship\-to\-Hire**
========================


Based on **performance, technical skills, learning ability, discipline, and organizational requirements**, the successful intern may be considered for a **full\-time employment opportunity after completion of the internship**.**Important Requirement**
=========================


Candidates with only basic desktop\-support knowledge and no understanding of **Frontend, Backend, Full\-Stack, APIs, and databases** will not be considered suitable for this position.
The role requires a combination of:**Infrastructure \+ Networking \+ Systems \+ Application \+ Development knowledge.**

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Additional AI Tools: Exposure to other AI tools and technologies can be beneficial.

* Emerging Technologies: Knowledge of emerging technologies and trends in cloud and AI can be advantageous.

Senior Full Stack Engineer (Java, Angular \& Cloud Infrastructure)

 Role Overview
 
 We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer who thrives at the intersection of robust backend services and scalable cloud infrastructure. You will be responsible for designing and implementing mission\-critical applications, ensuring that our technical architecture is as scalable as our business vision. We value clean code, automated infrastructure, and a “security\-first” mindset.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * End\-to\-End Development: Design, develop, and maintain complex backend services using Java 17/21 and Spring Boot 3\.x.
* Frontend Excellence: Build responsive, high\-performance web interfaces using Angular (v17\+) and modern state management (RxJS/Signals).
* Infrastructure as Code: Own the cloud lifecycle by writing and maintaining Terraform scripts to manage AWS resources.
* Security \& Identity: Implement and manage secure authentication/authorization flows using OAuth2, JWT, and OpenID Connect (Keycloak).
* Database Management: Design schema and optimize queries for PostgreSQL or similar relational databases.
* Architecture \& Mentorship: Lead technical decisions, conduct rigorous code reviews, and ensure the team adheres to SOLID principles and design patterns.

* Strong understanding of Microservices architecture and RESTful API design.
* Experience with build tools like Maven or Gradle and JVM tuning.
* Bonus: Experience with document processing libraries (Apache POI/iText) or Blockchain integration.


 Frontend (Angular)
 * Proficiency in TypeScript and Angular 17\+ (Standalone components, Reactive Forms).
* Solid grasp of RxJS for asynchronous stream handling.
* Experience with UI frameworks like Angular Material or Tailwind CSS.


 Cloud \& DevOps (AWS \& Terraform)
 * Hands\-on experience with AWS services: EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, and VPC.
* Proven ability to manage environments using Terraform (Modules, State management).
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI).


 General
 * Expertise in Git and version control workflows.
* Strong understanding of Docker and Containerization.
* Ability to write comprehensive unit and integration tests (JUnit, Mockito, Jasmine/Jest).


 What We Look For
 * Problem Solvers: You don’t just write code; you solve business problems with elegant technical solutions.
* Architectural Thinking: You understand the “why” behind technology choices, not just the “how.”
* Self\-Starters: You are comfortable working in an environment where you are expected to take ownership of a feature from conception to production.


 Why Join Us?
 * Opportunity to work on cutting\-edge financial technology/tokenization projects.
* A culture that values “Peace of Mind” and high\-quality engineering standards.
* Competitive compensation and the ability to influence the technical roadmap of the company.


 How to Apply

Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
 








  




**Who you will work with** 






 Bain \& Company is the leading consulting partner to the private equity industry and its stakeholders. PEG (Private Equity Group) in Bain provides comprehensive advisory services to investors across the entire investment lifecycle. PEG expertise spans from pre\-investment strategy and due diligence to post\-acquisition value creation and portfolio management. 
 





 PIT is a specialized division dedicated to supporting the private equity sector and its stakeholders. A key area of focus is harnessing Generative AI to develop innovative solutions that streamline due diligence, automate processes, and enable data\-driven decision\-making. By integrating expertise in due diligence, operational improvement, and cutting\-edge technologies like Generative AI, PIT empowers private equity clients to achieve superior returns and maintain a competitive edge in the market.

	+ **Generative AI Focus:** 
	 A significant portion of the work is expected to relate to Generative AI applications, pushing the boundaries of innovation in the private equity space.
	+ **Broader Automation:** 
	 The role may also include contributing to broader PIT automation initiatives aimed at streamlining processes and enhancing efficiency across various investment lifecycle stages.
* The person in this role will need to:
	+ Write complex code to develop scalable, flexible, user\-friendly applications across a robust technology stack.

	+ Evaluate potential technologies for adoption, including open\-source frameworks, libraries, and tools
	+ Ensure the maintainability and quality of code

* Ability to prioritize projects, manage multiple competing priorities and drive projects to completion under tight deadlines

 You are a product\-minded, full stack engineer who is equally comfortable building a React frontend, a Python backend, and the CI/CD pipeline that ships it. You will act as a trusted advisor to teams across customer, guiding them on best practices at the start of a prototype, and hands\-on when it's time to harden and scale that prototype into a production application. title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**Role Overview** 




 We are building a lean, high\-velocity engineering team to develop productized agentic AI applications on top of Savanna. Our flagship application focuses on agentic fraud investigation, with a broader mission to build a reusable suite of enterprise AI products that can be rapidly configured and deployed across customers.
 



 We are seeking a
 **Senior Full\-Stack Product Engineer** 
 with strong skills in
 **Java or Python** 
 on the backend and
 **Angular or React** 
 on the frontend. Working alongside an AI Engineer focused on LLMs, GraphRAG, and agent orchestration, you will own the full application stack—turning core AI capabilities into secure, scalable, and intuitive enterprise products from concept to production.
 



**Responsibilities** 




**1\. Full\-Stack Application Engineering** 



* Architect, build, and maintain production\-grade full\-stack applications using
 **Java or Python** 
 microservices/REST APIs and modern
 **Angular or React** 
 web interfaces.
* Design robust backend systems that handle asynchronous, long\-running agent workflows, state management, event\-driven data pipelines, and third\-party enterprise integrations.
* Build intuitive, dynamic frontend interfaces to visualize complex agent reasoning, graph networks, and interactive human\-in\-the\-loop workflows (approval mechanisms, override controls, and audit trails).
* Develop modular, configurable architectures separating reusable application code from tenant\-specific configurations.



**2\. Enterprise Security, Governance \& Agent Controls** 



* Implement enterprise\-grade security models, including Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC), multi\-tenancy, and secure API gateways.
* Design backend safeguards and transactional boundaries to prevent unauthorized or runaway agent executions.
* Build complete auditability logging to trace user requests, AI tool executions, state changes, and system errors.



**3\. Deployment, Scalability \& Cloud Packaging** 



* Own end\-to\-end delivery using modern CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud hosting across
 **AWS and Google Cloud** 
 .
* Prepare, package, and optimize applications for commercial distribution via
 **AWS Marketplace and Google Cloud Marketplace** 
 .
* Ensure high availability, observability, performance tuning, and monitoring across all layers of the stack.



  





  





 Requirements
 



  





**Requirements** 



* **Stack Expertise:**
* **Backend:** 
 Strong hands\-on experience with
 **Java** 
 (Spring Boot) OR
 **Python** 
 (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
* **Frontend:** 
 Strong hands\-on experience with
 **Angular** 
 (TypeScript) OR
 **React** 
 (JavaScript/TypeScript), alongside modern HTML5, CSS3/Tailwind, and state management (e.g., RxJS, Redux, Context API).
* **Full\-Stack Mastery:** 
 2\+ years of software engineering experience designing, building, and operating production web applications across both client and server layers.
* **Database \& API Design:** 
 Proficient in designing relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) or NoSQL databases, as well as RESTful APIs, WebSockets, or gRPC interfaces.
* **Cloud \& DevOps:** 
 Direct experience deploying and managing cloud\-native applications on
 **AWS or GCP** 
 , utilizing Docker, CI/CD tools, and basic Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* **AI Awareness:** 
 Practical understanding of integrating LLM outputs, asynchronous event processing, or agentic workflows into traditional application architectures.
* **Product Mindset:** 
 Ability to translate abstract AI/data capabilities into clear user workflows with minimal supervision.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience with graph visualization libraries (e.g., Cytoscape, D3\.js, Vis.js).
* Background in Fraud, AML, KYC, Cybersecurity, or enterprise case\-management platforms.
* Hands\-on experience packaging software for AWS Marketplace or GCP Marketplace.



**What Success Looks Like** 



* Rapidly bridge backend services and frontend UI to convert core AI capabilities into polished, market\-ready products.
* Deliver resilient, secure, and auditable enterprise software capable of running seamlessly in multi\-tenant or marketplace environments.
* Drive end\-to\-end ownership—writing clean backend code, crafting responsive interfaces, and managing cloud deployments

title: Full-Stack AI Engineer
description:
**Location:** 
 Remote (India\-based) — Bengaluru preferred; with meaningful daily overlap with our UK and US teams
   

  

**Engagement Type:** 
 Full\-time — permanent, ongoing
   

  

**About MarcoPolo Learning**
 MarcoPolo Learning is a leading provider of innovative content, technology, and instructional support for early childhood education. Since 2013, we’ve impacted thousands of classrooms and hundreds of thousands of families across North America. Our Emmy\-nominated MarcoPolo World School app and The Polos TV series bring STEM and global discovery to life for young learners.
   

  

 Backed by top\-tier investors, we’re on a mission to transform early learning at scale. At the center of that mission is Audrey, our AI Teaching Companion \& Coach — a guided AI assistant that helps early\-learning educators plan lessons, discover the right materials, and improve classroom outcomes. We’re looking for a Full\-Stack AI Engineer to help bring Audrey to life and shape where she goes next.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 This is a role for an engineer who loves working where AI meets product. You’ll own the intelligence behind Audrey — the retrieval, generation, and logic that make her genuinely useful to teachers — while being just as comfortable moving across the backend and frontend to bring the whole experience together. You’ll work alongside our backend, infrastructure, and frontend engineers, with real ownership of the AI and real influence over what we build.
   

  

 Audrey is approaching an exciting launch, and you’ll play a central part in shaping her — refining how she works today and helping define where she goes as we grow into more classrooms.
   

  

 Just as much as the engineering, we care about instinct for the product. We’re looking for someone genuinely curious about the teachers we serve — an engineer who asks the right questions, understands how educators actually use what we build, and lets that understanding shape the experience. You’ll bring deep AI expertise, a natural instinct for collaboration, and a calm, considered approach to solving hard problems.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the AI at the heart of Audrey — retrieval, generation, and the models and logic that make her intelligent and dependable.
* Craft an experience where teachers instantly find exactly the right video, printable, or activity, with retrieval that’s fast, accurate, and reliable.
* Build and refine the content and data pipelines that power Audrey — ingesting and structuring videos, printables, guides, and multilingual content for precise retrieval.
* Work across the full stack, connecting the AI seamlessly into the wider product alongside our backend and frontend engineers.
* Shape how Audrey thinks, responds, and guides teachers — designing her behavior, personality, and overall experience with the end user always in mind.
* Help bring Audrey to launch and shape her evolution as we scale.
* Continuously raise the quality, speed, and reliability of Audrey’s responses and recommendations.
* Build fluently with modern AI\-assisted development tools to design, build, and iterate quickly.
* Partner with our infrastructure lead to keep Audrey running smoothly and efficiently in the cloud.
* Put in place the evaluation, testing, and monitoring that keep quality high, and keep technical documentation clear.
* Collaborate closely and openly with engineering and product, sharing your thinking and progress early and often.
* Help shape the product roadmap — from deeper personalization to multilingual support and classroom insights.
* Build with privacy and safety in mind, including FERPA/COPPA alignment.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 5\+ years of software engineering experience across the full stack, comfortable working fluidly between backend and frontend.
* Proven, hands\-on depth with modern AI: you’ve personally built and shipped at least one production LLM/AI application. We know the LLM tooling is only a few years old — what you’ve actually built matters far more to us than years on a résumé.
* Strong experience building retrieval\-augmented (RAG) systems — embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and re\-ranking — with a real feel for what makes retrieval accurate and dependable.
* An AI\-native engineer who builds fluently with modern AI\-assisted development tools (e.g. Cursor) and weaves AI through their workflow.
* Strong Python and solid backend fundamentals (APIs, databases, data pipelines), with enough frontend ability to work end\-to\-end across the stack.
* Practical LLM orchestration and prompt engineering (LangChain or comparable), including agent/tool design, system\-prompt and persona design, and guardrails.
* Solid AWS experience (compute, storage, databases, containers, monitoring); familiarity with managed model services (e.g. Amazon Bedrock) and/or self\-hosted model inference is a plus.
* A genuine product sensibility — you’re curious about the people who use what you build, and you let that shape your work.
* A natural collaborator who communicates openly, builds trust across teams, and brings a calm, considered approach to a fast\-moving environment.
* Comfortable owning your work and driving it forward with minimal oversight.
* Able to work remotely with meaningful overlap across UK and US time zones, with strong written communication.
* Bonus: edtech or early\-childhood education experience; multilingual retrieval; video/audio ML; familiarity with FERPA/COPPA or similar.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive, market\-aligned salary for an experienced engineer in India.
* Fully remote, full\-time role with flexibility over how you structure your day.
* End\-to\-end ownership of the AI behind a flagship product, from launch through scale, with real influence over its architecture and roadmap.
* A collaborative, family\-friendly, mission\-driven environment at the intersection of education, media, and technology.


**Why Join Us**
 This is a rare chance to own the AI capabilities of a growing global education company at a defining moment. You’ll be the engineer who brings Audrey to life, shapes how she’s built, and helps take her from launch to a product used in thousands of classrooms. If you want work that’s visible, technically meaningful, and genuinely impactful for young learners and their teachers, this is it.
   

  

*Note: This is an India\-based engagement. Applicants must have the right to work in India; visa sponsorship is not available at this time.*
 MarcoPolo Learning is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. We pride ourselves on a supportive and mission\-driven working environment.

description:
Experience : 6\+ Years
