**Python / Java \| Generative AI, RAG \& Agentic AI** 




**Experience: 3 to 7 years \| Location: India / Remote / Offshore \| Employment: Full\-Time / Contract** 




  





**About NForce One** 




  





 NForce One is a technology services and solutions company with delivery capability across the United States and India. We build AI\-powered products, enterprise applications, accelerators, and client\-specific solutions across Generative AI, Agentic AI, Quality Engineering, Data Engineering, Cloud, and Digital Transformation.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We are looking for a hands\-on Full Stack AI Application Engineer who is a strong software engineer first and an AI practitioner second. You will build complete, production\-ready applications end to end, combining solid Python and Java engineering with modern front\-end development and Generative AI, RAG, and Agentic AI capabilities.
 



 You will own work across the full lifecycle: business requirements, solution design, backend development, database and vector store, LLM and agent integration, APIs, user interface, testing, cloud deployment, and production support. This is not a research, notebook\-only, or model\-experimentation role.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 ·       Design and develop AI\-powered enterprise applications, assistants, copilots, intelligent search, and workflow automation solutions.
 



 ·       Integrate commercial and open\-source LLMs into production systems using prompt engineering, context engineering, structured outputs, tool and function calling.
 



 ·       Build end\-to\-end RAG pipelines covering document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector storage, hybrid and semantic retrieval, metadata filtering, reranking, context construction, evaluation, and hallucination reduction.
 



 ·       Build Agentic AI workflows including multi\-agent systems, agent memory, planning, orchestration, supervisor agents, and human\-in\-the\-loop flows.
 



 ·       Develop backend services, REST APIs, and microservices in Python (FastAPI, Flask, Django) and Java (Spring Boot), with proper authentication, validation, error handling, logging, and versioning.
 



 ·       Build responsive front\-end interfaces with React or Angular and wire them to backend and AI services, including streaming LLM responses, chat interfaces, and authentication flows.
 



 ·       Design and work with relational, NoSQL, and vector databases.
 



 ·       Deploy, monitor, and support applications on Azure, AWS, or GCP using Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and standard observability tooling.
 



 ·       Build reusable AI services and components, and evaluate emerging AI frameworks and models for adoption.
 



 ·       Contribute to AI\-powered automation and quality engineering initiatives such as test generation, defect triage, root cause analysis, and self\-healing automation.
 



 ·       Translate business requirements into technical solutions, build rapid POCs, and convert successful POCs into production applications.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




  





 ·       3\+ years of professional software development experience.
 



 ·       Strong hands\-on Python development, writing maintainable production code (not limited to notebooks).
 



 ·       Hands\-on Java and Spring Boot development experience.
 



 ·       Proven experience designing and building REST APIs and backend services.
 



 ·       Full stack application development experience, including hands\-on front\-end work with JavaScript or TypeScript and React or Angular, plus HTML and CSS.
 



 ·       Strong SQL and relational database experience (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, or Oracle).
 



 ·       Hands\-on Generative AI / LLM integration experience in real applications.
 



 ·       Experience building or contributing to RAG\-based applications.
 



 ·       Hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
 



 ·       Proficiency with Git and strong software engineering fundamentals.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  





 ·       4 to 7 years of overall IT experience, including 2\+ years each in Python and Java application development.
 



 ·       Hands\-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, or Semantic Kernel.
 



 ·       Experience building and deploying AI agents in production.
 



 ·       Vector database experience: Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, FAISS, pgvector, Azure AI Search, or OpenSearch.
 



 ·       Microservices architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD (Jenkins or GitHub Actions).
 



 ·       Practical ML understanding (classification, regression, clustering, feature engineering, model evaluation and deployment) with Scikit\-learn, XGBoost, or Hugging Face.
 



 ·       Test automation exposure: Playwright, Selenium, RestAssured, PyTest, TestNG, JUnit, or Postman.
 



 ·       Data engineering exposure: PySpark, Kafka, Airflow, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, ETL/ELT pipelines.
 



 ·       Databricks experience: Delta Lake, Medallion Architecture, Unity Catalog, Workflows, Databricks SQL.
 



 ·       Monitoring and observability tools: Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch.
 



  





**Nice to Have** 




  





 GraphRAG, fine\-tuning and LoRA/PEFT, TensorFlow, PyTorch, MLflow, Terraform, JMeter or performance testing, Appium, Next.js, state management libraries, component design systems, and multi\-cloud experience.
 



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




  





 You are a hands\-on coder who is comfortable in both Python and Java, capable of building the user interface as well as the services behind it, curious about emerging AI technologies, and able to independently ship a feature from design through to production. You troubleshoot on your own, learn new frameworks quickly, and collaborate easily with product owners, architects, QA engineers, UI developers, and client teams.
 



  





**Education** 




  





 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or Engineering, or equivalent hands\-on software development experience.
 



  





  





*NForce One is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.*

title: Software Engineer (Full Stack)
description:
**Job Title** 
 :
 
 Software Engineer (Full Stack)
 




**Location :** 
 Delhi NCR
 



**Years of Experience :** 
 4\-7 Years
 



**Salary** 
 : As per the industry Standards
 



  





  





**What we are Building?** 




 Intellica is a BI \+ AI analytics cloud for Indian hospital chains. Hospital leadership opens it at 8am to see revenue, occupancy, and payor mix across facilities — dense fiscal comparison grids (FTD/MTD/LMTD/LYMTD) that today live in Power BI — and asks follow\-up questions in plain English. Under the hood: one metric registry, a deterministic query compiler over ClickHouse, and an LLM that translates questions into a validated intermediate representation. We are now looking to build a production grade AI native intelligence and insights product from the ground up that will service its first large customer within a few months
 



  





  





**What You'll own?** 




 You are the application engineer on the team — everything from the query engine to the pixel :
 



  




* **The semantic core** 
 : the IR validator, the fiscal time\-intelligence engine (as\-of dates, month\-to\-date comparisons across an Apr–Mar fiscal calendar), and the compiler that turns validated IRs into parameterized ClickHouse SQL. Pure TypeScript functions with exhaustive tests — this is where a subtle date bug becomes a wrong revenue number on a CFO's screen, so we test like it matters



  




* **The API** 
 : a NestJS service — auth/tenant context, report rendering, chat orchestration (SSE streaming), caching, audit logs.



  




* **The frontend** 
 : React \+ TypeScript. Two surfaces: a virtualized pivot grid that renders 40×60 fiscal comparison matrices smoothly with Indian number formatting (₹ Cr/L), and a chat experience with streaming answers, charts, tappable clarifications, and refusals that actually help.



  




* **The LLM plumbing :** 
 structured\-output calls via OpenRouter, prompt versioning, a semantic cache, and the eval harness \+ CI gates that keep accuracy honest. You'll treat the LLM as a component to constrain, not a magic box



  




* **Product decisions :** 
 We have no designer and no PM. You'll make dozens of small UX calls a week for non technical hospital executives, and you'll be right most of the time because you care how it feels



  





  





**What we are looking for ?** 




  




* 4–7 years shipping production web products, with
 **TypeScript across the stack** 
 (Node backend \+ React frontend) as your primary tool for at least the last 2–3 years



  




* You've built at least one
 **data\-heavy product surface** 
 — dashboards, reporting, analytics, admin tools with real tables and real numbers — and you know why "it renders" and "it's trustworthy" are different bars.



  




* **Testing discipline on tricky logic** 
 . You've written the boundary\-case tests nobody asked for (dates, money, pagination, permissions) because you've been burned. You can show us



  




* **Solid SQL** 
 . You can write and reason about analytical queries (GROUP BY, window basics, date ranges) and spot why two queries disagree.



  




* You've
 **used LLM APIs in production or serious side projects** 
 — structured outputs, streaming, retries — and you're pragmatic about them



  




* You work well with
 **AI coding tools** 
 (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) and can be honest about what you verify by hand. Our small team ships at the pace it does because we use these well, with taste



  





  





**Nice to Have** 




 ClickHouse or any OLAP store · NestJS · TanStack Table/Query, Recharts · SSE/streaming UIs · fiscal/timezone/calendar logic · B2B SaaS for non\-technical users · healthcare or fintech domain · pnpm monorepos.
 



  





  





**How we work** 



* Small team, high trust, direct access to the founder.
* Written specs and decision logs over meetings.
* CI gates over heroics.
* We'd rather you push back on the spec than silently build the wrong thing.
* You'll see your work used by hospital leadership within weeks, not quarters.



  





  





**About Prodigy Health** 





 Prodigy Health is an AI\-native healthcare technology company building the data and intelligence layer for modern hospitals. We build two products: CarePro, a patient engagement and conversion platform, and Intellica, a health BI cloud for multi\-unit hospital analytics. Our platforms live with leading enterprise hospital groups across India, running mission\-critical operations at scale. We're a small, fast\-moving team that ships real products into real hospitals — where reliability, security, and data integrity genuinely matter.
 




  






 We serve multi\-unit hospital groups running dozens of facilities on a single platform. That means everything we build has to be
 
**multi\-tenant, secure, and scalable by default** 

 . The core platform is already live on MERN and in production with enterprise hospital chains. We're now scaling the architecture and deepening AI across the product.

title: Full Stack Java Developer
description:
Company Description
 



 Wellness360 is a software\-as\-a\-service (SaaS) wellness technology platform that provides comprehensive population health management solutions to various healthcare stakeholders. The mission of Wellness360 is to empower individuals to improve their health and reduce the risk of chronic diseases through personalized recommendations and active support. The platform offers a range of tools and programs designed to transform the healthcare system into a proactive and preventive one, ultimately leading to better health outcomes and lower healthcare costs.
 



  





 Role Description
 



 This is a full\-time on\-site role for a Full Stack Java Developer at Wellness360 located in Hyderabad. We are seeking a talented and motivated Software Engineer to join our dynamic team for a challenging and rewarding experience. We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Java Full\-Stack Engineer to add value to our growing development team. The ideal candidate will combine technical expertise in Java full\-stack development with strong leadership skills to drive innovation and deliver high\-quality software solutions.
 



  





 Responsibilities
 


* Assist in the design, development, and testing of software applications
* Collaborate with team members to gather and analyze requirements
* Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code
* Debug and troubleshoot software issues
* Contribute to the development of technical documentation
* Contribute to architectural decisions and code reviews



  





 Qualifications
 


* We value passion and skill over formal qualifications (any or no degree is fine). If you're passionate about software development and can write clean, efficient code, we encourage you to apply and complete the case study.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
* Knowledge of Agile development methodologies
* Familiarity with cloud technologies and tools
* Excellent communication skills and eagerness to learn
* 2\+ years of full\-stack development( any UI technologies \& Java/Spring is a preferred backend) experience
* Strong knowledge of Java, Spring Framework, and modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular)
* Experience with microservices architecture and RESTful API design \& having RPC/GRPC knowledge.
* Proficiency in SQL(Mysql is preferred) and NoSQL databases
* Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools (e.g., Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes)



  





**Hiring Process** 



* **Apply here and knowledge that you will be completing the case study and send your github project link to eng\-jobs@wellness360\.co by Sept 14th.**
* **We only consider the candidates who complete and send the case study by Sept 14th.**



  





 Case Study:
 



 You are tasked with designing and implementing a RESTful API for a task management system. The system should allow users to create, read, update, and delete tasks, as well as mark them as complete.
 



  





 \#\#\# Requirements:
 



  





 1\. Implement the following API endpoints:
 



 \- GET /tasks: Retrieve all tasks
 



 \- GET /tasks/{id}: Retrieve a specific task by ID
 



 \- POST /tasks: Create a new task
 



 \- PUT /tasks/{id}: Update an existing task
 



 \- DELETE /tasks/{id}: Delete a task
 



 \- PATCH /tasks/{id}/complete: Mark a task as complete
 



 2\. Each task should have the following properties:
 



 \- id (unique identifier)
 



 \- title (string)
 



 \- description (string)
 



 \- due\_date (date)
 



 \- status (enum: "pending", "in\_progress", "completed")
 



 \- created\_at (timestamp)
 



 \- updated\_at (timestamp)
 



 3\. Implement basic error handling and input validation.
 



 4\. Use appropriate HTTP status codes for responses.
 



 5\. Implement at least one unit test for a critical function.
 



 6\. Bonus: Implement basic authentication for the API.
 



  





 \#\#\# Technical Specifications:
 



 \- Use any programming language and framework of your choice (e.g., Python with Flask, Node.js with Express, Java with Spring Boot). Java with Spring Boot will be preferred.
 



 \- Use an in\-memory data store or a simple file\-based storage for this exercise.
 



 \- Provide clear documentation on how to run and test your application.
 



  





 \#\#\# Evaluation Criteria:
 



 1\. Code quality and organization
 



 2\. Proper use of RESTful principles
 



 3\. Error handling and input validation
 



 4\. Efficiency of data structures and algorithms used
 



 5\. Adherence to best practices in the chosen language/framework
 



 6\. Quality of documentation and comments
 



 7\. Bonus points for implementing authentication or additional features
 



  





 \#\#\# Deliverables:
 



 1\. Source code for the API implementation (github link to case study)
 



 2\. README file with instructions on how to run and test the application
 



 3\. Brief documentation of your design decisions and any assumptions made
 



  





 \#\#\# Time Limit:
 



 Candidates should aim to complete this case study within 3\-5 days. The focus should be on demonstrating clean, well\-structured code rather than implementing every possible feature.
 



  





**Submit your solution, and resume to eng\-jobs@wellness360\.co by September 14th, 2026**

title: Computer Scientist II (Full Stack)
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Firefly Enterprise brings generative AI and automated document production into the infrastructure that powers enterprise creative operations at scale. Our team builds and operates the
 **InDesign APIs and InDesign Server platform on Firefly Services** 
 —the systems that let enterprises programmatically generate, resize, localize, and republish complex, pixel\-perfect layouts (catalogs, packaging, marketing collateral) across thousands of variants, with no manual production work.
   

  

 We're at an inflection point. The InDesign APIs are scaling fast in production, and we are migrating a large base of InDesign Server customers and partners onto the API platform. That means we need engineers who can ship durable, well\-documented APIs
 *and* 
 a horizontally scalable, observable server platform that holds up under heavy, bursty enterprise load.
   

  

**The problem we're solving:** 
 large enterprises need to produce and localize high\-fidelity layouts at a volume and speed that manual design workflows can't sustain. Today that often means brittle scripts, single\-purpose render farms, and integrations that don't survive enterprise load. We're building reliable, well\-documented APIs and a scalable server platform that make InDesign automation dependable, observable, and easy to build on.
   

  

 This is a full\-stack role: you'll build customer\- and developer\-facing surfaces (job consoles, dashboards, monitors) while working inside the services and server infrastructure that do the heavy lifting—job orchestration, template processing, rendering pipelines, and the APIs that expose it all.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Build full\-stack features spanning UI (React/TypeScript or similar) and backend services (Node.js/Java) that expose InDesign API and InDesign Server capabilities to enterprise customers and internal teams.
* Develop and maintain REST/GraphQL APIs for document generation, template/asset management, job submission, and status/result retrieval—including auth, entitlements and usage metering, rate limiting, and versioning.
* Work with InDesign Server internals, scripting (UXP/ExtendScript), and plugin interfaces to build and troubleshoot automated rendering, pagination, and content\-mapping workflows.
* Build reliable async job orchestration: queuing, polling, retries, partial\-failure handling, and clear progress/status UX for long\-running render jobs.
* Contribute to platform reliability—multi\-region operation, stability, performance, and observability—for high\-volume document generation.
* Own features end\-to\-end: architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring across the stack.
* Partner with Product, Design, and Platform to turn enterprise requirements (scale, compliance, entitlements) into robust solutions, and directly support IDS→API migration by closing feature and performance gaps.
* Champion engineering quality: unit/integration testing, code reviews, CI/CD hygiene, pragmatic tech\-debt management. Mentor junior engineers through reviews, pairing, and design discussions.


 What you need to succeed
   

  

* 6–8 years of professional software engineering experience with demonstrated full\-stack, end\-to\-end ownership.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and at least one backend language/runtime (Node.js, Java, or similar), with solid component\-based UI development and HTML/CSS.
* Proven experience building and integrating REST/GraphQL APIs and designing systems around asynchronous, long\-running workflows.
* Comfort across the stack: from UI implementation to service design, data models, and deployment/infrastructure basics.
* Strong CS fundamentals, practical software design skills, and the ability to reason about performance and scale.
* Excellent communication; ability to collaborate across functions and time zones.
* Fluency using AI coding assistants and agentic development tools to accelerate delivery.


 Nice to have
   

  

* Experience with Adobe InDesign Server, InDesign scripting (UXP/ExtendScript), or plugin development (C\+\+), or other document/layout automation platforms.
* Familiarity with print, packaging, or publishing workflows (templates, prepress, PDF/X, color management).
* Experience with containerized services (Docker/Kubernetes), job queues, and horizontally scaled render/worker fleets across regions.
* Familiarity with LLM/GenAI concepts and integrating AI\-assisted capabilities into enterprise products.
* Experience with build systems, CI/CD, and enterprise\-grade release processes.


**About Adobe**
 Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry\-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
   

  

 Our 30,000\+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Voice AI)
description:
You'll be the person who builds the machinery behind our AI calling agents. At JoyzAI, that means the real\-time voice pipeline itself — audio in, speech understood, LLM reasoning, tools called, speech out — and everything around it: the telephony that gets the call connected, the dashboard a client uses to configure their agent, and the webhooks and CRM plumbing that turn a call into a lead.
 



 This is not a feature\-ticket role. It's a build\-and\-own role. You'll own the voice stack end to end, from the socket that streams audio to the screen a client uses to change their agent's greeting. When a call stutters, drops, or talks over the customer, you're the one who finds out why — and fixes it.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




  





 Voice pipeline \& real\-time systems
 


* Build and harden the real\-time calling pipeline: telephony ↔ audio streaming ↔ speech/real\-time models ↔ tool calls ↔ speech out, with latency you can't feel.
* Own the hard voice problems: turn\-taking and barge\-in, silence and voicemail detection, noise and echo, language switching mid\-call (English ↔ Hinglish ↔ regional), and graceful recovery when a model or carrier hiccups.
* Integrate and evaluate voice models and providers across STT/TTS, real\-time LLMs, VAD, and telephony carriers — and help decide what we build on next.
* Implement non\-blocking tool calling inside live calls — lookups, bookings, CRM writes — so the agent never goes silent or loses the thread.



  





 Platform \& full\-stack product
 


* Build the product around the calls: agent configuration (tasks, behaviour, guardrails, AI config), call logs and transcripts, analytics, and bulk\-calling campaign controls.
* Design and ship the Node.js/Express services and APIs — call orchestration, queueing, webhooks, retries, recording and transcript storage — that hold up as call volume grows.
* Wire calls into the rest of the platform: CRM contacts and tickets, WhatsApp follow\-ups after a call, calendar and booking integrations, Google Sheets and Meta lead\-form ingestion.
* Ship clean, usable Angular frontends for our team and for clients — the agent configurator, the inbox, the call review screens.



  





 Reliability, cost \& scale
 


* Instrument everything: time\-to\-first\-word, per\-call latency breakdowns, drop rates, tool\-call failures, model cost per minute. Build the dashboards that tell us something's wrong before a client does.
* Bring down cost per minute without hurting quality — model choice, streaming strategy, caching, carrier routing.
* Debug production incidents on real client calls, reproduce them, and fix them at the root.



  





 Working with the team
 


* Pair with the prompt engineer and customer success on what the platform needs for agents to behave well — new tool types, better fallbacks, a proper test harness for prompts.
* Turn what you learn from client deployments into reusable platform capability, so the next voice agent takes hours to stand up, not days.



  





 Roughly 80% of your time is hands\-on engineering: writing code across the stack, debugging live calls, shipping. The other 20% is with the team and occasionally clients — understanding what's breaking in the field and deciding what the platform should do about it.
 



  





 We're under 15 people building AI calling agents. This is not a comfortable corporate job. You'll be in the trenches, you'll work hard, and you'll compress ten years of ordinary career growth into two (this means salary growth also, not just more work).
 



  





**What we're looking for** 




  





 Two things are non\-negotiable. Please apply only if you meet both — they're the first thing we screen for.
 


* **You've shipped real\-time voice AI to production.** 
 Not a demo, not a hackathon — a system where real people spoke to an AI over a phone line or live audio stream, and you owned the pipeline: streaming audio, speech or real\-time models, latency, interruptions, the lot. Experience at a Voice AI company is a strong signal.
* **You're a full\-stack engineer who can build the whole thing.** 
 Backend services, APIs, real\-time transport, databases, and a frontend a client can use without a walkthrough. You don't need a separate team to ship a feature end to end.



  





 Beyond that, we don't care much about degrees or years. We care that you can:
 


* Work fluently across the MEAN stack — MongoDB, Express, Angular, Node.js — with TypeScript throughout.
* Build and debug real\-time systems: WebSockets, WebRTC, streaming audio, event\-driven architectures, queues.
* Integrate with telephony/SIP providers and messaging APIs (WhatsApp Business API) and handle their quirks in production.
* Work with LLM APIs, tool/function calling, and speech models, and reason about latency, cost, and failure modes — not just accuracy.
* Design MongoDB data models and APIs for a multi\-tenant SaaS: contacts, conversations, tickets, workflows, role\-based access.
* Measure and profile before you optimise, write code others can read, and document what you built.



  





 Nice to have: experience with real\-time voice frameworks or APIs (OpenAI Realtime, LiveKit, Pipecat, or similar); Indian telephony providers; Hinglish or Indic speech models; GCP/AWS at scale.
 



  





 Full\-time, on\-site in Noida.
 



  





**Why JoyzAI?** 




 ✨ Utmost freedom and autonomy — to make decisions. You are the taskmaster, do it the way you think is best. We will only suggest.
 



 ✨ Complete responsibility. You are the taskmaster. Take responsibility for it.
 



 ✨ Top\-of\-the\-market pay – we reward high performance with the best packages.
 



 ✨ 5\-day working – weekends are yours to recharge.
 



 ✨ Work from office in Noida – collaborate, learn, and grow with a passionate team.
 



 ✨ High\-growth startup – opportunity to see first hand how AI brings change and be a part of that.

title: AI Full-Stack / Forward Deployment Engineer – GIS & Infrastructure
description:
DSTS works on field\-intensive infrastructure projects involving Railways, Telecom, GIS, DGPS and underground utility/cable mapping.
   

 We are starting a new AI initiative to transform field survey and infrastructure operations using AI, GIS and automation.
   

 We are looking for a highly hands\-on engineer who can understand a real operational problem and take it from field data → database → GIS → AI → working application.
   

 This is not a conventional website\-development role.
   

 Your first challenge
   

 Build a working AI\-enabled Railway Survey platform that can:
   

 Import DGPS/GIS and underground cable\-location data
   

 Plot surveyed routes and observations on maps
   

 Automatically detect missing or abnormal field data
   

 Perform survey QC
   

 Analyse team productivity
   

 Identify survey gaps and anomalies
   

 Generate daily/project reports
   

 Allow managers to query project data in natural language using AI
   

 Example:
   

 "Show all locations surveyed yesterday where cable depth could not be measured."
   

 or
   

 "Which survey teams completed less than 7 km yesterday and why?"
   

 Skills we are looking for
   

 Essential
   

 Python • FastAPI • React/Next.js • PostgreSQL • REST APIs • Git • JSON • LLM/API integration • cloud deployment
   

 Strong advantage
   

 PostGIS • QGIS/ArcGIS • GeoJSON • KML • shapefiles • mapping APIs • RAG • AI agents • computer vision • mobile/field\-data applications
   

 What matters most
   

 We aren't looking primarily for certificates.
   

 We want someone who can build.
   

 You should be comfortable sitting with field engineers, understanding how their work is actually performed and rapidly turning that workflow into production software.
   

 Engagement
   

 The selected candidate will initially undertake a 30\-day paid prototype assignment using real infrastructure survey workflows.
   

 A successful prototype can lead to a long\-term role with the opportunity to help build and lead DSTS's AI Deployment \& Automation initiative.
   

 Compensation: Competitive and based on demonstrated capability.
   

 To apply
   

 Please send:
   

 CV / LinkedIn profile
   

 GitHub or examples of applications you have personally built
   

 Details of one AI application you have taken from idea to working deployment
   

 Current location
   

 Current/expected compensation
   

 Availability to join
   

 Important: Candidates who can demonstrate working products will be preferred over purely theoretical AI experience.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer - Node.js/React.js
description:
**About The Role**
 This is not a role where you maintain a dashboard and close tickets. We build AI\-native enterprise software. Real\-time multilingual voice, heavy data pipelines, multi\-tenant systems, and interfaces that thousands of people sit inside all day, across India, the UK and Europe.
   

  

 The work is hard in the way good engineering work is hard. Latency budgets you actually have to hit. Queries that fall apart at scale unless you think about them properly. UI that has to stay responsive while streaming data in from three places at once.
   

  

 If you like being handed a spec and told what to type, this will not suit you. If you like owning a hard problem end to end and being the person accountable for it, keep reading.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
**On the backend:**
* Design and own services in Node and TypeScript, sitting on PostgreSQL.
* Model data properly. Normalised where it matters, denormalised where it earns you something. You should be comfortable reasoning about foreign keys, partial and composite indexes, and what a covering index actually buys you.
* Read query plans. Kill N\+1s. Understand connection pooling, transaction isolation levels, advisory locks, and why a long\-running transaction on a hot table ruins everyone's afternoon.
* Build multi\-tenant boundaries that hold. Tenant scoping, RBAC, row\-level isolation, audit trails. Getting this wrong in enterprise software is not a bug, it is an incident.
* Work with event\-driven flows. Queues, workers, retries with backoff, idempotency keys, dead letter handling, backpressure. Exactly\-once is a lie, design for at\-least\-once and make it safe.
* Caching that is actually correct. Cache\-aside patterns, TTL strategy, stampede protection, distributed locks, and knowing when invalidation is the wrong answer.
* Real\-time paths. SSE and WebSockets, streaming responses, connection lifecycle, reconnection semantics.
* Integrate with enterprise systems designed in a different decade. Legacy file transfer, XML and SOAP\-ish APIs, webhook contracts, OAuth flows, rate limits you do not control.


**On The Frontend**
* Build in React and TypeScript on a modern Next.js setup. Server components, client components, and a clear head about which does what and why.
* Streaming SSR, suspense boundaries, route\-level code splitting, and hydration behaviour you can explain rather than guess at.
* Own Core Web Vitals. LCP, INP, CLS. Bundle analysis, dependency pruning, font and image strategy, no waterfalls in the data layer.
* Complex stateful UI. Server state in a proper query cache, client state kept minimal, optimistic updates, race condition handling, stale data reconciliation.
* Data\-dense interfaces done well. Virtualised tables, infinite scroll, filter and sort state in the URL, forms with schema validation on both sides of the wire.
* Real\-time UI that does not thrash. Streaming tokens, live status, presence, without re\-rendering the world every tick.
* A design system that stays consistent. Typed component APIs, sensible primitives, accessibility that is not an afterthought.


**Across Both**
* Own features from schema to screen. You design the tables, write the API, build the UI, ship it, and watch what happens after.
* Review code seriously and push back when something is wrong.
* Argue about what to build, not just how.


**The Kind Of Stack You'll Be In**
* Languages: TypeScript end to end, SQL.
* Frontend: React, Next.js, a component library, utility CSS, schema validation.
* Backend: Node.js, a lightweight HTTP framework, a typed query layer, REST and streaming APIs.
* Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, object storage.
* Cloud: AWS across multiple regions. Serverless functions, managed queues, CDN, managed Postgres and cache.
* AI layer: LLM APIs, function calling, streaming inference, real\-time voice.


 You do not need every one of these on your CV. You do need to be the kind of engineer who picks up a new one over a weekend and is useful on Monday.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* 5 to 7 years building production web systems. Real users, real load, real consequences when it breaks.
* Deep TypeScript. Generics, discriminated unions, inference. You use the type system to prevent bugs, not to decorate the code.
* Strong React. You know why a component re\-rendered and how to stop it. You know when memoisation helps and when it is cargo cult.
* Genuinely comfortable in a database. You can write the SQL yourself and you know what the ORM is doing when you don't.
* You have designed an API someone else had to consume and it held up.
* You have debugged something in production under pressure and written up what went wrong afterwards.
* You write code a stranger can read in six months.


**On background:** 
 We lean towards engineers who have worked at a startup where they had to own a lot without a playbook, or who come from a strong engineering school (IIT, NIT, BITS, IIIT and similar). Both is ideal. Neither is a dealbreaker if the work speaks loudly enough. Send the GitHub, the side project, the thing that got used.
   

  

**Nice To Have**
* Worked with LLM APIs, streaming completions, prompt and eval design, or real\-time voice.
* Built multi\-tenant B2B SaaS with enterprise customers.
* Performance work you can talk about specifically. What was slow, what you measured, what you changed.
* Open source contributions, or a technical blog where you explain things properly.
* You have been the first or second engineer on something.


**What Working Here Is Like**
* Fast. Really fast. Decisions get made in one conversation, not across weeks of meetings. There is no ticket queue you sit in. If you see something broken you fix it.
* You get the whole picture. Founders sit in the same room. You will know what we are prioritising and why.
* The flip side is ownership. Nobody chases you for status. Ship it, tell the team, move on.


**What You Get**
* Competitive salary, benchmarked properly for senior engineers in Bengaluru.
* Real ownership of systems that carry weight, not a slice of someone else's feature.
* Hard problems, short feedback loops, and no layers between you and the outcome.
* A team where you will not be the smartest person in the room every day.

title: Software Dev Engineer I, L4
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


You use technology to validate and verify software, seeking input from team members on the best software test techniques to utilize. Your scope of work is to extend and effectively apply existing automation frameworks for small to mid\-size components and/or product features. You may create or have responsibility to improve existing test tools. You are able to take a defined design and turn it into code and deliver it on schedule, applying appropriate technologies and current software engineering best practices. You write secure, stable, testable, maintainable code with minimal defects. You are proficient in a broad range of data structures and algorithms, knowing when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). You make appropriate implementation trade\-off decisions (e.g., array or hash table?). You do not put the company at risk (e.g. pulling in unlicensed code, working on code in unsafe ways, test payment transactions in prod, etc.). You participate in team design, scoping and prioritization discussions. Your input to test plans and test cases are of high quality and high value. You seek to learn the business context and technologies behind your team’s software. You invent, refine and develop your solutions to ensure they are meeting team needs and project goals. You are a passionate advocate for your customer.  

You assume responsibility for the state of the code you inherit, produce, and test. You get your designs, code, and test plans reviewed. You test code thoroughly. You classify, store, and handle data in accordance with Amazon policies. You track risks and mitigate and/or escalate them in a timely manner. You take the time to understand the maintenance characteristics, runtime properties, and dependencies of your team’s software, including hardware platform, operating system and build dependencies. You prevent bugs from causing customer pain. You clearly document your software to ensure that future generations of developers understand the intention behind the test solutions you build. You troubleshoot, research the root cause of problems, and thoroughly resolve defects. You take ownership of problems (even when outside your own domain), propose solutions, and either take ownership for their resolution or ensure a clear hand\-off to the right owner. You participate in the interview process and help your team train and mentor SDE\-T interns.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering
* Experience of 1 to 3 years as an SDE

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Exposure to AWS, Full stack development experience

description:
**Overview**
 Money Forward is developing a variety of services for individuals and corporations to realize our vision, “Becoming the financial platform for all”. In addition, we are working to promote the effective use of data. To further address our customers' needs in the future, we are actively strengthening our development system using AI/ML technology for the main services of each department.
   

 We are looking for a passionate Platform Engineer for MLOps who can work along with our ML platform team and collaborate with ML engineers to ensure deployment, scaling, and maintenance of ML pipelines and applications.
   

 You will help manage cloud\-based resources, containerized environments, and automated workflows for AI models. You will contribute to building a scalable AI/ML infrastructure while gaining exposure to the broader MLOps lifecycle and automation.
   

  

**Attractive points**
 In this role, you will be at the forefront of the latest technologies in container orchestration, cloud services, and CI/CD pipelines to enable efficient development, training and deployment of ML models.
   

  

 You will have the autonomy to design and implement optimization strategies, operate and maintain a scalable robust infrastructure tailored for ML projects, and empower ML engineers throughout the MLOps cycle.
   

  

 Alongside our technical team of talented experienced ML engineers, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the MLOps cycle, gaining valuable insights in a diverse and dynamic environment.
   

 Responsibilities
   

* As an MLOps platform engineer, you will play a critical role by enabling our team of ML engineers to develop, train and deploy ML projects efficiently using the latest technologies in container orchestration, cloud services, CI/CD pipelines for data collection, model training and monitoring in production
* Building and maintaining a scalable infrastructure to execute ML projects, while committed to results and user value
* Develop, design, maintain and manage container orchestration using Kubernetes
* Design and execute strategies for GPU optimization, prediction servers, data and training pipelines while ensuring efficient use
* Design and build inference platforms while ensuring reliability and high performance
* Provision and monitor infrastructure resources
* Build and maintain ML workflows and pipelines
* Deploy and maintain monitoring services for observability
* Ensure compliance with security best practices
* Manage and expand LLM serving clusters using stacks like vLLM


 Requirements
   

  


**Qualification** 
  




* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, engineering or related field
* 3\+ years building core infrastructure for ML projects
* Demonstrated background in DevOps, Platform Engineering, SRE, cloud\-based infrastructure, or managing production operations
* Experience supporting Generative AI, LLM, production\-level AI/ML, or platforms focused on data\-intensive workloads
* Deep understanding of the AI application lifecycle, including MLOps, LLMOps, model monitoring, and deployment strategies
* Hands\-on experience deploying and providing support for AI services, inference endpoints, and APIs
* Experience in managing, designing, implementing and maintaining robust ML infrastructure to support development and inference workloads, ML workflows, training pipelines and versioning
* Experience building and scaling machine learning infrastructure
* Experience with AWS cloud services
* Experience with Kubernetes to deploy and manage containerized applications with high availability and performance
* Experience in running and scaling inference clusters
* Experience with TerraGrunt or TerraForm, IaC and CI/CD practices
* Comfortable taking over legacy projects for operation and maintenance
* Proficiency in programming Python
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and ability to work in a dynamic environment
* Effective communication skills to collaborate with technical and nontechnical members


 Nice\-to\-have
   

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, engineering or related field
* Production experience operating LLM inference servers such as vLLM (or equivalent serving stacks)
* Experience with LLM observability, including the detection of hallucinations, toxicity, and model drift, alongside implementing tracing through OpenTelemetry protocols
* Experience with RayServe
* Proficiency on KubeFlow and MLFlow for workflows and pipelines
* Experience in designing, developing and operating large\-scale AI/ML systems
* Certifications in AWS(MLS\-C01\), Kubernetes(CKA) or relevant technologies
* Experience with additional cloud services
* Contributions to open\-source projects
* Experience in working to improve model performance, including AI/ML model refinement and fine\-tuning
* Knowledge of data security standards such as handling personal information, financial/accounting data, PCI DSS, etc., and experience in designing, developing, and operating systems by these requirements.

Performs continuous testing for security, API, and regression suite. Creates automation strategy, automated scripts and supports data and environment configuration. Participates in code reviews, monitors, and reports defects to support continuous improvement activities for the end\-to\-end testing process.

**Good to have skills :** Automated Testing, Quality Management  

Minimum **2** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

Software Quality Engineers design, create, implement, and monitor
  

processes that ensure that the final product satisfies end users
  

needs and requirements, while also making sure no other influence
  

will cause the product to malfunction.
  

Being able to fully understand what project managers and product
  

owners expect, and to imagine what end users need and how they
  

will interact with the product are just some of the points that a Soft  

ware Quality Engineer has to be able to fulfill.
  

Clear and precise communications enable a Quality Assurance En  

gineer to address identified problems quickly to relevant partners in

overall product quality.

Review requirements, specifications and technical design documents to provide timely and meaningful feedback.
  

* Create detailed, comprehensive and well\-structured test plans and test cases to identify software problems.

* Develop and apply testing processes for new and existing products.
* Liaise with internal teams (e.g. product leads and developers) to identify system requirements.
* Investigate the causes of non\-conforming software.
* Work together with software developers to enhance and improve software.
* Track quality assurance metrics, like defect densities and open defect counts.
* Stay up\-to\-date with new testing tools and test strategies.

  

  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related
  

subject or comparable qualifications/experience.

ware quality assurance.
  

* Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools and

processes.
  

* Experience in writing clear, concise and comprehensive test

plans, test cases and defect descriptions.
  

* ISTQB or related certification is preferable.


  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 2 years of experience in Test Management.
* This position is based at our Chennai office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.


**Accountabilities**


* Development and delivery of high\-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.

* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

**Analyst Expectations**


* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

* Partner with other functions and business areas.

* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.

* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Senior Engineer, Software Development (Full-stack)
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

  

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

  

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

### **What if you could build a career where ambition meets innovation? At LPL Financial, we empower professionals to shape their success while helping clients pursue their financial goals with confidence. What if you could have access to cutting\-edge resources, a collaborative environment, and the freedom to make an impact? If you're ready to take the next step, discover what’s possible with LPL Financial.**

### **Job Overview:**

### 

### **Our company is seeking a skilled senior software developer to help with the development of many projects that span different technologies and requirements. You will be working with a motivated team in a fast paced environment.**

### **A senior developer's day involves attending a morning stand\-up meeting, reviewing code, working on complex coding tasks, collaborating with team members, and participating in design and architecture discussions. They also attend meetings like sprint planning and retrospectives, monitor project progress, deploy code, and mentor junior developers. By the end of the day, they review their progress, update documentation, and prepare for the next day's tasks.**

### **Responsibilities:**

* ### **Work on a team that is responsible for the design, implementation, and development of dynamic account opening and account maintenance applications.**
* ### **Explore and implement AI based solutions to enhance the account opening and client onboarding systems.**
* ### **Provide technical leadership to teammates through technical design and implementation of industry best practices adhering to LPL’s modernization practices, cloud practices, SDLC, and release management processes.**
* ### **Develop positive relationships with business partners to understand their needs, manage expectations, deliver value\-add solutions and support translation of problem statements into system requirements.**
* ### **Assess opportunities for application and process improvements and show success through KPIs.**
* ### **Full application life\-cycle coordination and management of deliverables in alignment with best practices and organizational compliance goals**
* ### **Collaborate with other shared services teams (technical and non\-technical) to ensure solutions and platforms are both functional and sustainable.**
* ### **Use customer and business feedback to inform roadmaps and non\-functional goals.**

### **What are we looking for?**

### **We want strong collaborators who can deliver a world\-class client experience. We are looking for people who thrive in a fast\-paced environment, are client\-focused, team oriented, and are able to execute in a way that encourages creativity and continuous improvement.**

### **Desired Skills and Competencies:**

* ### **4\+ years of hands on full\-stack development and a desire to learn.**
* ### **Proficiency in .NET Framework: Strong understanding of .NET Core and .NET Framework.**
* ### **Ability to create and consume RESTful services.**
* ### **Strong understanding of Angular concepts such as components, modules, services, and dependency injection.**
* ### **Understanding responsive design principles to ensure applications work on various devices.**
* ### **Knowledge of core AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS, and Lambda.**
* ### **Experience with IaC tools like AWS CloudFormation or Terraform.**
* ### **Utilizing AI\-powered tools like Copilot to generate code snippets, boilerplate code, and entire functions based on natural language descriptions.**
* ### **Leveraging AI to provide intelligent code completions, reducing the time spent on writing repetitive code.**
* ### **Using AI to identify potential bugs and suggest fixes in real\-time as you write code.**
* ### **Code Refactoring: Employing AI to suggest and automate code refactoring, improving code quality and maintainability.**
* ### **Documentation Generation: Utilizing AI to generate documentation for code, including comments, function descriptions, and usage examples.**
* ### **CI/CD using GitHub repositories.**
* ### **Excellent verbal and written communication skills, both technical and non\-technical.**
* ### **Problem\-Solving: Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to debug and resolve issues efficiently.**
* ### **Capable of effectively planning, prioritizing and executing tasks utilizing resources and tools.**

 The TeamViewer Digital Employee Experience (DEX) Platform finds and resolves IT issues before they affect users. * You will work closely with our existing Observability team (based in the US) and play a key role in the integration whilst supporting the existing platform.

 TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. description:
Sovereign Detailing Co. \| Build What Doesn't Exist Yet.
 
  





**This is not a job. This is a chance to become the person who builds the technology behind a company from Day One.** 




 Sovereign Detailing Co. is building an
 **on\-demand premium vehicle\-care platform** 
 — bringing professional detailing and car\-care services to customers through technology.
 



 We are looking for an exceptional
 **Co\-Founder \& CTO** 
 who can turn an ambitious vision into a world\-class product.
 



  





 Think like a founder.
 



 Build like an engineer.
 



 Execute like an elite technology company.
 



  




 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 
  





 We want someone who is
 **passionately delusional about what is possible — yet relentlessly professional about execution.** 




 Someone who doesn't ask:
 


 “Can this be built?”
 
 but asks:
 


**“What would it take to build it?”**

 You should be someone who:
 


* Can architect and build an application
 **from scratch**
* Has strong command of
 **frontend AND backend development**
* Is highly proficient in relevant programming languages and frameworks
* Understands
 **APIs, databases, authentication, cloud infrastructure, system architecture and security**
* Can build and deploy production\-ready
 **web and mobile applications**
* Can make technology decisions independently and defend them
* Understands scalability, performance and reliability
* Can eventually recruit and lead an exceptional engineering team
* Is comfortable working at the intersection of
 **technology, product and business**
* Is obsessive about quality and user experience
* Has the ambition to build something that can operate at
 **global scale**



  




 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 
  





 As CTO, you will own the entire technology function.
 



**Architecture → Product → Frontend → Backend → Mobile → Infrastructure → Deployment → Scale** 




 You will be responsible for transforming the vision into the actual technology that powers Sovereign Detailing Co.
 



 You won't be handed a massive engineering team and a finished roadmap.
 



**You will help build both.** 




  




 THE MINDSET
 
  





 We are not looking for someone who wants a comfortable corporate CTO title.
 



 We are looking for a
 **builder** 
 .
 



 Someone who can sit down on Day One with the founder, understand the vision, challenge assumptions, design the architecture and start building.
 



 Someone who sees a blank repository as an opportunity.
 



 Someone who wants their work to become
 **the technology foundation of a company that didn't exist before they helped build it.** 




  




 WHY THIS OPPORTUNITY IS DIFFERENT
 
  





 The biggest technology companies in the world were once just ideas.
 



 The difference was that someone decided to build them.
 



  





**This is that stage.** 




  





 You won't be joining after the product is built.
 



 You won't be joining after the technology team is established.
 



  





**You'll be there at the beginning.** 




  





 You'll have a direct influence on what we build, how we build it, and how far it can scale.
 



 If we build this the way we believe we can, you'll be able to look back years from now and say:
 



**“I built the technology from the ground up.”** 




  




 THE STANDARD
 
  





 We expect the level of thinking and execution you would associate with
 **Meta, Amazon, Flipkart, SpaceX or another world\-class technology organization.** 




 Not because we're trying to imitate them.
 



**Because that's the standard we're setting for ourselves.** 




  





 If you're genuinely exceptional, technically strong, relentlessly ambitious and ready to build something from zero:
 



  





**We want to hear from you.** 




  





**Role:** 
 Co\-Founder \& CTO
 



**Location:** 
 Remote / Flexible
 



**Stage:** 
 Pre\-Seed
 



**Structure:** 
 Founding partnership — equity \+ mutually agreed terms
 



  





**Apply:** 
 Send a DM with your profile, GitHub/portfolio, what you've built, your technical background, and why you believe you are the person who should build the technology behind Sovereign Detailing Co.
 



  





**One seat. One founding team. One opportunity to build something from the beginning.**

description:

**About American Airlines:** 




 To Care for People on Life's Journey®. Together with our American Eagle regional partners, we offer thousands of flights daily to more than 350 destinations in more than 60 countries.
 



 American Airlines is transforming the way it delivers technology to its customers and team members worldwide.
 



 American’s Tech Hub in Hyderabad, India, is our latest technology office location and home to team members who drive technical innovation and engineer unrivalled digital products to best serve American’s customers and team members. With U.S. tech hubs in Dallas\-Fort Worth, Texas and Phoenix, Arizona, our new team in Hyderabad, India enables better support of our 24/7 operation and positions American to deliver industry\-leading technology solutions that create a world\-class customer experience.
 



  





**INTRO:** 




 Are you ready to explore a world of possibilities, both at work and during your time off Join our American Airlines family, and you’ll travel the world, grow your expertise, and become the best version of you. As you embark on a new journey, you’ll tackle challenges with flexibility and grace, learning new skills and advancing your career while having the time of your life. Feel free to enrich both your personal and work life and hop onboard!
 



  





**WHY YOU’LL LOVE THIS JOB:** 



* As one diverse, high\-performing team dedicated to technical excellence, you will focus relentlessly on delivering unrivaled digital products that drive a more reliable and profitable airline.
* The Software domain refers to the area within Information Technology that focuses on the development, deployment, management, and maintenance of software applications that support business processes and user needs.
* This includes development, application lifecycle management, requirement analysis, QA, security \& compliance, and maintaining the applications and infrastructure.
* This list is intended to reflect the current job but there may be additional essential functions (and certainly non\-essential job functions) that are not referenced. Management will modify the job or require other tasks be performed

* Designs self\-contained systems within a team's domain, and leads implementations of significant capabilities in existing systems

* Formally mentors teammates and helps guide them to and along needed learning journeys
* Observes their environment and identifies opportunities for introducing new approaches to problems

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Technology, Information Systems (CIS/MIS), Engineering or related technical discipline, or equivalent experience/training

* Master's degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Technology, Information Systems (CIS/MIS), Engineering or related technical discipline, or equivalent experience/training
* Airline Industry experience

* Programming Languages: C\#

* Source Control: GitHub/GitHub Actions

* Proficiency in object\-oriented design techniques and principles
* Proficiency in Agile methodologies, such as SCRUM

 Ability to effectively communicate both verbally and written with all levels within the organization

description:

 At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress.  Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
   

  

 What if you could build a career where ambition meets innovation? At LPL Financial, we empower professionals to shape their success while helping clients pursue their financial goals with confidence. What if you could have access to cutting\-edge resources, a collaborative environment, and the freedom to make an impact? If you're ready to take the next step, discover what’s possible with LPL Financial.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 Our company is seeking a skilled senior software developer to help with the development of many projects that span different technologies and requirements. You will be working with a motivated team in a fast paced environment.
   

  

 A senior developer's day involves attending a morning stand\-up meeting, reviewing code, working on complex coding tasks, collaborating with team members, and participating in design and architecture discussions. They also attend meetings like sprint planning and retrospectives, monitor project progress, deploy code, and mentor junior developers. By the end of the day, they review their progress, update documentation, and prepare for the next day's tasks.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Work on a team that is responsible for the design, implementation, and development of dynamic account opening and account maintenance applications.
* Explore and implement AI based solutions to enhance the account opening and client onboarding systems.
* Provide technical leadership to teammates through technical design and implementation of industry best practices adhering to LPL’s modernization practices, cloud practices, SDLC, and release management processes.
* Develop positive relationships with business partners to understand their needs, manage expectations, deliver value\-add solutions and support translation of problem statements into system requirements.
* Assess opportunities for application and process improvements and show success through KPIs.
* Full application life\-cycle coordination and management of deliverables in alignment with best practices and organizational compliance goals
* Collaborate with other shared services teams (technical and non\-technical) to ensure solutions and platforms are both functional and sustainable.
* Use customer and business feedback to inform roadmaps and non\-functional goals.


 What are we looking for?
   

  

 We want strong collaborators who can deliver a world\-class client experience. We are looking for people who thrive in a fast\-paced environment, are client\-focused, team oriented, and are able to execute in a way that encourages creativity and continuous improvement.
   

  

**Desired Skills And Competencies**
* 4\+ years of hands on full\-stack development and a desire to learn.
* Proficiency in .NET Framework: Strong understanding of .NET Core and .NET Framework.
* Ability to create and consume RESTful services.
* Strong understanding of Angular concepts such as components, modules, services, and dependency injection.
* Understanding responsive design principles to ensure applications work on various devices.
* Knowledge of core AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS, and Lambda.
* Experience with IaC tools like AWS CloudFormation or Terraform.
* Utilizing AI\-powered tools like Copilot to generate code snippets, boilerplate code, and entire functions based on natural language descriptions.
* Leveraging AI to provide intelligent code completions, reducing the time spent on writing repetitive code.
* Using AI to identify potential bugs and suggest fixes in real\-time as you write code.
* Code Refactoring: Employing AI to suggest and automate code refactoring, improving code quality and maintainability.
* Documentation Generation: Utilizing AI to generate documentation for code, including comments, function descriptions, and usage examples.
* CI/CD using GitHub repositories.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, both technical and non\-technical.
* Problem\-Solving: Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to debug and resolve issues efficiently.
* Capable of effectively planning, prioritizing and executing tasks utilizing resources and tools.

description:

 Design and build features across the entire stack — data model, APIs, and UI — from requirement to production

* Model relational schemas and write safe, reversible migrations; design REST APIs with clean contracts, pagination, filtering, and permission scoping.

 Python

* REST APIs
* Redis
* AWS
* Git / GitHub
* CI/CD

* Multi\-tenant SaaS
* role\-based access control
* financially\- or calculation\-heavy features
* SSO / OAuth
* SSE / websockets
* Storybook
* AWS (RDS, S3, CloudFront, ElastiCache)
* performance profiling.


**Requirements**
**Must have**
* 4\+ years building and shipping production full\-stack web applications.
* Strong Django/DRF and React \+ TypeScript; solid SQL and relational data modelling.
* Sound API design, authentication/authorization, and a genuine testing habit.
* Proven ability to translate messy requirements into correct logic — and to push back when something doesn't add up.
* Excellent communication; comfortable working directly with a client/product team.

description:

 At Smart Working, we believe your job should feel right — not just look right on paper. 
 


  


 This isn’t just another remote role. This is belonging remotely — and that’s a big difference. From day one, you're supported, valued, and part of a genuine community. We're proud to be one of the highest\-rated companies on Glassdoor India.
 


  


  
 


  


 With one vision in mind — “Geographical limitations should not dictate access to talent” — Smart Working helps great people build long\-term, full\-time remote careers with exceptional UK teams. We’ve created a culture where you're backed from day one and given the space to grow — personally and professionally.
 


  


  
 


  


**About the Role ( 6 month contract)** 



  


  


 As a Sr. Full Stack Engineer, you will join the growing technology team of an award\-winning UK business specialising in changing and adapting how golf memberships work around the world. Golf is a fast\-growing and hugely popular sport globally, and the business is a leader within its field.
 


  


 This is a senior role focused primarily on backend software development, with responsibility for solving performance and scalability challenges, supporting strategic architecture planning and making technology choices. You will work with cross\-functional teams to define and deliver projects while contributing to technical support and continuous improvement.
 


  


 The company invests significantly in its staff and offers opportunities for promotion, learning and developing new skills.

* Develop backend software using C\#
  
* Solve technical problems relating to performance and scalability
  
* Work with cross\-functional teams to define and deliver projects
  
* Provide 2nd and 3rd line technical support
  
* Contribute to strategic architecture planning and technology choices
  
* Understand the bigger picture, including identifying opportunities for improvement and understanding user needs
  
* Share your experience and mentor others
  
* Remain open\-minded and willing to learn new skills and technologies
  

  


  


  




**Requirements** 
  

  
* 5\+ years of experience with C\# and .NET 6\.0 Web API
  
* 3\+ years of experience with SQL Server
  
* 1 year of experience with Angular and Next.js
  
* Understanding of Azure
  
* Prior experience with software integrations, including REST and SOAP
  
* Strong communication skills, which are fundamental to this role
  
* Ability to understand the bigger picture, proactively seek opportunities for improvement and understand user needs
  
* Willingness to share experience and mentor others
  
* Open\-mindedness and a desire to learn new skills and technologies
  

  


  


  




**Nice to Have** 
  

  
* Experience with Redis or other NoSQL technologies
  
* Experience with Hangfire or other asynchronous job systems
  
* Experience with Azure or other cloud platforms
  
* Solid architectural experience
  

  


  


  




**Benefits** 
  

  
* Fixed Shifts — 12:00 PM – 9:30 PM IST (Summer) \| 1:00 PM – 10:30 PM IST (Winter)
  
* No Weekend Work — Real work\-life balance, not just words
  
* Day 1 Benefits — Laptop and full medical insurance provided
  
* Support That Matters — Mentorship, community, and forums where ideas are shared
  
* True Belonging — A long\-term home where your contributions are valued
