description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

External Job Ad TextJob description
  
We are seeking a highly skilled AI Quality Engineer specializing in testing Generative (and non\-Generative) AI applications and agentic systems to join our team. The ideal candidate will have expertise in both traditional software testing and specialized testing methodologies for Large Language Models (LLMs)\-based and AI\-based systems.
  
As a fullstack Quality Engineer within a lean, agentic software team, you will cover the entire spectrum of quality assurance. You will span manual exploratory testing, traditional automated UI/API/MCP testing (across our Python and TypeScript stack), classical machine learning validation, and cutting\-edge generative and agentic AI evaluation. This role requires a deep understanding of LLM, agentic and ML systems behaviors, and testing frameworks to ensure the reliability, fairness, and effectiveness of our AI\-powered solutions.
  
Description of the area
  
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. The Applied AI Engineering Team focuses on architecting, building, and operating high\-value AI solutions and services to solve complex business challenges in healthcare.
  
In the 2026 tech landscape, we operate in small, highly autonomous agile teams (e.g., \~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before. In this highly regulated environment, quality cannot be an afterthought. You will be the foundational pillar ensuring our rapidly developed agentic workflows and AI, GenAI, and agentic applications are safe, compliant, and robust before they reach the clinical or enterprise user.
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Generative\& Agentic AI Testing Strategy: Design and implement comprehensive testing strategies specifically tailored for LLM\-based applications and agentic systems, including evaluation of model responses, RAG pipelines accuracy, and overall system reliability. You will expand this to evaluate autonomous multi\-agent behaviors and tool\-use accuracy.
* Full\-Stack Test Automation: Design and implement automated testing solutions for continuous evaluation of LLM applications, including integration tests, performance tests, and specialized AI behavior tests. This spans both our Python backend services and modern TypeScript/React/Angular frontends.
* Quality Assurance Framework\& Compliance: Utilize Roche's testing frameworks that address both traditional software quality aspects and AI\-specific concerns such as output consistency, contextual accuracy, and ethical compliance; co\-create and maintain such frameworks when required. Create and maintain comprehensive test documentation testing strategy, test cases, and testing guidelines specific to AI applications and compliant with Roche practices.
* Edge Case, Bias, and Fairness Testing: Identify and develop test scenarios for edge cases in LLM behavior, including handling of ambiguous inputs, potential biases, and unexpected response patterns. Design and execute tests to identify potential biases in model outputs and ensure fair treatment across different user groups and use cases.
* Security\& Performance Testing: Collaborate within development teams to test for potential vulnerabilities specific to LLM applications, including prompt injection, data leakage, and other AI\-specific security concerns. Collaborate with other engineers to conduct thorough performance testing of GenAI applications, including response time analysis, load testing, and resource utilization monitoring.


Qualifications
  
  

* Hold B.Sc., B.Eng., M.Sc., M.Eng. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent degree with strong background in testing methodologies.
* Be passionate about quality assurance and testing, particularly in the context of AI and GenAI applications and agents.
* Have strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Utilize critical thinking and problem\-solving when using AI prompts (in e.g. NLP, data distributions and edge cases).
* Be proactive in identifying potential issues and suggesting improvements.


Education / Experience
  
  

* Experience: 7\+ years of experience in software testing, with at least 1 year focused on genAI and/or agentic applications.
* Regulated Environments: Be ready to work in a regulated environment with qualified infrastructure and validated applications, understand the difference between GxP and non\-GxP products and the importance of CSV and ITSM processes in the delivery.
* Agile Integration: Be experienced in working with Agile development teams.


Skills
  
  

**Must\-have:**  

* Comprehensive Full\-Stack Testing Mastery
* Core Languages\& Testing Frameworks: Advanced command of Python and standard testing frameworks (e.g., pytest, allure), alongside practical familiarity with specialized AI evaluation tools. High competence in TypeScript\-driven test frameworks (such as Playwright, Jest, and Cypress) for thoroughly verifying dynamic generative user interfaces.
* End\-to\-End Automation\& CI/CD: Proven expertise in architecting and maintaining end\-to\-end automated testing suites that bridge traditional UI/API validation with complex, asynchronous AI/LLM evaluation pipelines.
* Pipeline Integration: Hands\-on experience integrating these comprehensive suites within GitHub Actions or modern CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous, reliable quality checks throughout the entire development lifecycle.
* Advanced AI Quality\& Evaluation Mastery
* AI Evaluation Frameworks: Expertise in implementing evaluation harnesses (e.g., RAGAS, DeepEval, Promptfoo) to quantify LLM performance, hallucination rates, and answer relevancy.
* Agentic Workflow Validation: Ability to test autonomous agentic loops, including tool\-use accuracy, step\-by\-step reasoning verification, and goal\-directed performance metrics.
* Evaluation Datasets: Experience in curating, managing, and versioning 'Golden Datasets' for benchmarking model responses against ground truth in both development and production environments.
* Observability\& Feedback Loops: Leveraging tracing (e.g., LangSmith, Arize Phoenix) to monitor production inputs/outputs, identify drift, and capture user feedback for continuous improvement.
* Basic broad AI knowledge: Understanding of LLM architectures, RAG systems, agents, and common failure modes in AI applications.
* Python Expertise: Advanced proficiency in writing robust, maintainable Python code for test automation (e.g., pytest). Experience using Python to orchestrate complex AI evaluation workflows, process large datasets for benchmarking, and automate interactions with LLM/AI services. Ability to integrate Python scripts into CI/CD pipelines for automated quality checks and performance observability in agentic systems.


**Should\-have:**  

* Cloud: Practical experience with testing applications on cloud platforms (AWS) and working with cloud\-based AI services.
* Observability\& ALM: Experience with monitoring and observability tools, log analysis, and performance metrics tracking (Grafana). Experienced in Roche mandatory ALM tools (Jira, GitHub).
* Agentic SDLC\& Engineering Excellence: Leverage AI coding assistants and autonomous agents (e.g., Claude Code, Ona) daily to accelerate full\-stack development and testing cycles. Conduct rigorous code reviews for both human\-written and AI\-generated code.
* Security: Understanding of security testing methodologies, particularly in the context of AI applications.


**Could\-have:**  

* Regulatory Compliance: Proven understanding of AI quality assurance and testing standards within highly regulated industries.


Additional Qualifications
  
  

* Stay current with the latest developments in AI and GenAI testing methodologies and best practices.
* Have excellent communication skills and the ability to clearly document findings and recommendations.
* Be able to communicate in English at the level of C1\+.
* Located in Hyderabad, India, with working hours structured to capture the 'golden hours' of overlap with Central European Time (typically running through the IST evening).

description:

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. description:
**Lead Developer, Full\-Stack (Node.js / React/ PostgreSQL)**

**Company:** Justo Global (justoglobal.com) / The Ark Enterprise (thearkenterprise.com)

**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. On\-site (some flexibility for the right candidate) Type:

**Full\-time Experience:** 7 to 10 years overall, including 2\+ years leading or mentoring a team

**Notice:** Immediate joiners preferred; candidates on up to 30 days' notice welcome

**About the Role**

Justo Global builds cloud, web, mobile, data, and AI solutions for global clients, mostly

across North America. We're hiring a Lead Developer to own the technical delivery of these

projects: a hands\-on leader who spends most of the week writing and reviewing code, and

the rest setting direction, mentoring the team, and keeping delivery on track.

In 2026, we expect our leads to work fluently alongside AI coding tools, using them to move

faster while keeping firm ownership of architecture, code quality, and security. If you love

building and leading, keep reading.

**What You'll Do**

* Own architecture, design, and delivery of scalable, secure, highly available applications for global clients.
* Write and review production code daily across frontend, backend, and APIs. You set the quality bar through your own work.
* Lead a small team: mentoring, code reviews, sprint planning, estimation, and unblocking.
* Translate client and business requirements into clear technical plans and break them down for the team.
* Establish engineering best practices: coding standards, testing discipline, CI/CD hygiene, and secure\-by\-design defaults.
* Make and document architectural trade\-offs across performance, cost, and maintainability.
* Use AI\-assisted development tools effectively, and set sensible team guardrails for reviewing and securing AI\-generated code.
* Work directly with US\-based clients, product, and design; represent engineering in stakeholder conversations.

**Must\-Have Skills**

**Leadership \& Architecture**

* Proven experience designing, building, and scaling robust, secure, highly available enterprise\-grade software.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor developers while staying deeply hands\-on.
* Strong ownership of delivery: planning, estimating, and shipping reliably.

**Core Stack**

* Deep expertise in the modern JavaScript / TypeScript ecosystem: runtimes, build tools, and package managers.
* Strong Node.js: scalable backend services and REST / GraphQL APIs with Express or Fastify.
* Extensive React.js: complex, responsive UIs with hooks, Context API, and modern state management (Redux, Zustand).
* Advanced PostgreSQL: schema design, query optimization, indexing, and data modeling.

**Cloud \& Infrastructure**

* Hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP): deploying, scaling, and running production workloads.
* Solid working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and running containerized services (cluster operations experience is a plus, not a requirement).
* Understanding of cloud cost, reliability, and observability basics (logging, metrics, tracing).

**Delivery \& Tooling**

* Modern workflows: Git, CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar).
* Testing discipline with Jest, Mocha, or PyTest.
* Sound application\-security fundamentals: authentication/authorization, secrets handling, and secure defaults.

**Nice\-to\-Have**

* Python (Django / FastAPI) for backend, data processing, or scripting.
* React Native for cross\-platform mobile.
* Go / Golang for high\-concurrency microservices.
* Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform, Helm) and managed Kubernetes (EKS / GKE /AKS).
* Experience integrating LLM / AI features (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, or similarAPIs)into production products.

**Soft Skills, What Sets Our Leads Apart**

These matter as much as the technical checklist. For a client\-facing lead, most friction is

human, not technical.

* **Communication (the big one):** clear written and spoken English; explains technical trade\-offs to non\-technical, US\-based clients and turns vague business asks into concrete plans.
* **Client\-facing maturity:** confident in stakeholder calls, manages expectations, and gives honest status, including bad news, without drama.
* **Ownership across time zones:** takes end\-to\-end responsibility and communicate proactively so US clients aren't left waiting on Coimbatore hours.
* **Leadership \& mentorship:** grows people through review and pairing; gives feedback that's direct but kind; builds trust rather than commanding.
* **Pragmatism \& decisiveness:** makes sound calls with incomplete information and balances "perfect" against "shipped."
* **Constructive collaboration:** disagrees well, commits once decided, and keeps client relationships steady under pressure.
* **Adaptability:** stays effective as priorities and client domains shift

Pay: ₹150,000\.00 \- ₹250,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

description:
##### **Project description**

We are seeking an M\-shaped Full\-Stack Technical Lead with expert\-level Java engineering skills and accountability for delivery across the platform. This role is not a traditional full\-stack position—the successful candidate will have deep, end\-to\-end expertise in Java as their primary discipline, while independently managing small\- to medium\-complexity tasks in three secondary areas: React front\-end development, DevSecOps, and Test Automation. AI and Agentic AI tools will be leveraged to enhance capabilities across these secondary domains without requiring deep specialization in each. The role includes platform\-wide technical leadership responsibilities, such as setting standards, reviewing designs, coaching engineers, and embedding quality early through shift\-left practices.


##### **Responsibilities**


Design, develop, and maintain Spring Boot microservices integrating with relational and NoSQL databases, message brokers (Kafka), and internal/external APIs, ensuring scalable and reliable services across on\-premise and cloud environments.


Manage REST API design end\-to\-end, including contract definition, versioning, error handling, performance optimization, and reliability, to meet non\-functional requirements and consumer expectations.


Serve as the technical leader for Java engineering platform\-wide, establishing coding standards, architectural patterns, reviewing designs and pull requests, and providing technical guidance to delivery teams.


Lead performance tuning and optimization of Java services by profiling, identifying bottlenecks related to memory, threading, I/O, and database, and implementing solutions collaboratively with engineering teams.


Implement Test\-Driven Development (TDD) as a foundational practice in Java delivery, ensuring testability is embedded from the outset.


Develop and maintain React components, screens, and features for small


to medium\-complexity front\-end tasks, integrating with back\-end APIs via RESTful services.


Utilize hooks, state management, and component lifecycle methods to deliver functional and responsive user interfaces aligned with design requirements.


Employ AI and Agentic AI tools to expedite front\-end development, including scaffolding components and troubleshooting UI issues, without requiring extensive front\-end specialization.


##### **Skills**


Must have


The role demands advanced proficiency in modern Java programming, emphasizing core concepts such as concurrency, streams, and modular design, with Java 17\+ being preferable. Candidates must exhibit substantial experience in architecting and developing Spring Boot microservices within large\-scale enterprise settings. Expertise in database interactions is essential, including strong skills in SQL, JPA/Hibernate, query optimization, and data modeling. Familiarity with event\-driven system design and message brokers, particularly Apache Kafka, is required. Deploying and managing Java services via containerization (Docker) and orchestration platforms (Kubernetes) is a key responsibility. Additionally, candidates should demonstrate the ability to design robust REST APIs, incorporating principles like contract\-first design, versioning, pagination, error management, and optimization of API performance. Experience in performance tuning involving profiling, heap and thread analysis, garbage collection adjustments, and latency minimization is also necessary. A rigorous approach to test\-driven development and unit/integration testing, using frameworks such as JUnit and Mockito, is expected. Candidates must also have experience delivering solutions in both on\-premise and cloud environments.


Soft skills and front\-end competencies include the ability to construct React components utilizing functional programming patterns, hooks, and state management techniques. A solid command of JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, and CSS3 is required to effectively integrate front\-end modules with back\-end RESTful services. Proficiency in managing asynchronous data flows between client and server components is essential to ensure seamless user experiences.


Hard skills:


At least 10 years of experience in IT.


Expertise in Java 17\+ with modern features including concurrency, streams, and modular design


Extensive experience building Spring Boot microservices


Proficient in SQL, JPA/Hibernate, query optimization, and data modeling

Ability to integrate front\-end with back\-end REST APIs and manage asynchronous data flows

Job description
  
  

We are recruiting a Senior Fullstack UX/UI Researcher\& Designer to serve as a pivotal member of our Applied AI function. This is a high\-impact Senior Individual Contributor (IC) role designed for an elite practitioner who prefers building and executing over administrative management. By intentionally merging deep user research and high\-fidelity UI design into a single "fullstack" discipline, you will solve the unique friction points created by non\-deterministic AI outputs. In an environment where AI behavior is fluid, the ability to unify discovery and delivery is essential. Your work—ranging from embedded enterprise chat to real\-time generative UI streams—will be the primary engine for establishing user trust, ensuring that unpredictable machine learning data is transformed into intuitive, systemic, and reliable human experiences. This role represents a critical evolution in Roche’s digital mission, bridging the gap between raw algorithmic power and meaningful user value.
  
  

Description of the area
  
  

At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. As part of our strategic initiatives, we are enabling high\-value AI (with a strong focus on Generative AI and agentic AI) through fit\-for\-purpose platforms, services and applications. The Applied AI Engineering Team is tasked with building innovative AI applications, GenAI agents, and agentic foundations. Perform usability tests to iterate on design concepts, integrating user feedback for continuous improvements. Design and test complex workflows and conversational interactions, observing how users react to dynamic, non\-deterministic system outputs.
* Systemic UI\& Conversation Design: Focus on enhancing interaction with AI\-driven features by crafting user experiences that are conversational, responsive, and human\-like. Shift from designing static, predictable layouts to creating flexible, dynamic interfaces that can gracefully handle unpredictable data, varying confidence intervals, and real\-time LLM streams. Develop innovative visualizations to represent outputs from AI models, allowing users to easily understand and interact with complex information. Apply a strong aesthetic sense to build interfaces that foster user trust, utilizing enterprise design systems to maintain visual consistency across all touchpoints.
* Wireframing and Prototyping: Design wireframes, user flows, and prototypes for innovative AI\-driven applications, focusing on both desktop and mobile experiences.
* Accessibility and Usability: Ensure that all designed interfaces are accessible, inclusive, and provide a seamless user experience. Apply best practices to accommodate diverse user needs.


Qualifications
  
  

* Hold a degree in Interaction Design, Human\-Computer Interaction or related fields.
* Be passionate about AI\-driven user experiences and interested in staying up\-to\-date with emerging trends in UX/UI and AI.
* Have a "Golden Mean" profile: deep design fundamentals backed by an artistic inclination and deep empathy for the end\-user.
* Be detail\-oriented and have excellent problem\-solving skills.
* Demonstrate strong self\-management skills to work effectively \- take initiative in identifying and solving problems, managing time efficiently, and ensuring tasks are completed on schedule.


Education / Experience
  
  

•
  
**General UX/UI Mastery:** 7\+ years of UX/UI Design mastery, with a demonstrated evolution into designing for AI\-driven and agentic systems.
  
  

•
  
**Research Autonomy:** 3–5\+ years of dedicated, hands\-on experience in User Research, Usability Testing, or Product Design Research, with a proven ability to own projects from a brief to final stakeholder presentation.
  
  

•
  
**AI Integration Experience:** Demonstrated experience designing interfaces that incorporate Large Language Models (LLMs) and classical Machine Learning (e.g., conversational assistants and data exploration tools).
  
  

•
  
**Information Architecture:** Experience developing user journey maps, sitemaps, and wireframes that inform AI\-driven user experiences.
  
  

**Must\-have:**  

Be able to conduct an end\-to\-end journey from ideation to prototype and testing:
  
  

* Research Skills: Strong user research skills, including conducting interviews, usability testing, and A/B testing to validate designs.
* Design Tools: Proficiency in Figma for creating wireframes, mockups, and prototypes. Design system knowledge.
* Prototyping and Testing: Ability to create interactive prototypes and gather user feedback through testing.


**Should\-have:**  

* Developing experience: Basic software development skills to allow editing codebases, creating code solutions, and understanding created codebases.
* aSDLC: Created working mockups, PoCs, PoVs, prototypes via Agentic Software Development Lifecycle tools and approaches like Claude Code and Codex.
* CX Strategy\& Integration: Ability to map customer touchpoints and integrate broader Customer Experience (CX) strategy into the product lifecycle


**Could\-have:**  

* Regulatory Compliance: Proven experience working within highly regulated industries.
* Agentic SDLC Prototyping Interest: A desire to further specialize in exchanging code with engineers via agentic workflows to streamline the handoff process.
* Leading\& Educating Others: Interest in contributing to the development of the broader UX community through mentorship and knowledge sharing.


Additional Qualifications
  
  

* Communication: Strong communication skills to effectively articulate design decisions and user needs to stakeholders. Be able to communicate in English at the level of: C1\+.
* Collaboration: Ability to work collaboratively in Agile AI product development teams.
* Ethics\& Empathy: Strong understanding of responsible AI deployment, backed by deep empathy for the end\-user to foster trust and accessibility.

title: Software Development Engineer II (Full-Stack - Node/React)
description:

At Saltmine, we are rebuilding the $300B enterprise workplace design and asset management industry from the ground up. Founded in 2017 and backed by $20M in Series A funding, Saltmine is an enterprise B2B SaaS platform that helps corporate real estate (CRE) teams and enterprise companies plan, design, and optimize their physical workspaces.



By integrating spatial data, employee utilization metrics (such as badge swipes, sensors, and calendars), real\-time collaborative 2D/3D visualization, and automated space planning tools, we act as the single source of truth for the modern workplace. Trusted by global brands like Nike, Snowflake, PG\&E, and Workday, we are transforming a legacy, manual process into an intelligent, data\-driven experience.



As we scale our platform and expand our visual, spatial, and data integrations, we are looking for a highly capable **Software Development Engineer II (SDE 2\)** to join our core product engineering team.


**Role Overview**



As an SDE II at Saltmine, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, and maintaining robust, high\-performance web applications that power our real\-time spatial planning, visualization, and collaboration modules. You will work across the stack, writing clean, modular backend services in **Node.js (Express \& Nest.js)** and building rich, responsive user interfaces in **React.js**.



This is an opportunity to solve unique engineering challenges around big spatial datasets, interactive floor plan canvas elements, system performance, and collaborative workflow architectures.


* **Experience Level:** 4–6 Years
* **Employment Type:** Full\-time
* **Location:** Remote / Hybrid (as per location)
* **Target Industry Background:** Strong preference for candidates from **Product\-based companies**, specifically in the **B2B SaaS** ecosystem.


**Key Responsibilities**


* **Feature Delivery:** Design, implement, test, and deploy end\-to\-end features using NestJS/Express on the backend and React on the frontend.
* **Architecture \& Scalability:** Write clean, self\-documenting, and testable code. Help design scalable database schemas and API contracts (RESTful/GraphQL).
* **System Optimization:** Identify performance bottlenecks in web clients and backend servers; refactor code and optimize complex queries to ensure snappy, low\-latency performance.
* **Collaborative Development:** Partner closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, and QA engineers to turn complex enterprise requirements into seamless user workflows.
* **Code Quality \& Mentorship:** Participate actively in code reviews, enforce coding guidelines, write comprehensive unit/integration tests, and mentor junior developers.


**Role Requirements**


**Must\-Have Skill Sets**


**Technical Background**


* **Core Languages:** Strong proficiency in **TypeScript** and modern **JavaScript (ES6\+)**.
* **Backend Development:** Minimum 3\+ years of professional hands\-on backend development with **Node.js**, with proven experience in building production APIs using **Express.js** and **Nest.js** frameworks.
* **Frontend Development:** Minimum 2\+ years of professional experience building complex, interactive single\-page applications (SPAs) with **React.js** and state management systems (such as Redux, Recoil, or React Context).
* **Database Management:** Deep understanding of relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) or NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB), including index optimization, complex queries, and data modeling.
* **System Design:** Clear understanding of RESTful API principles, microservices or modular monolith architectures, and MVC patterns.


**Professional Experience \& Profile**


* **Years of Experience:** 4 to 6 years of solid software engineering experience in web\-scale applications.
* **Product Company Pedigree:**  

**Direct, recent experience working in product\-focused companies.** You understand how to build for long\-term maintainability, manage tech debt, and adapt to shifting product\-market requirements.
* **B2B SaaS Mindset:** Experience building enterprise\-grade applications. You understand multitenancy, role\-based access control (RBAC), data isolation, and security best practices.
* **Agile Work Ethic:** Experience working in fast\-paced Agile/Scrum product cycles.


**Good\-to\-Have Skill Sets**


* **Performance Optimization:** Experience optimizing high\-frequency operations, data serialization/deserialization, and rendering optimization (especially around interactive DOMs, SVG, HTML5 Canvas, or WebGL/Three.js).
* **Real\-time Engineering:** Experience with real\-time multiplayer systems using WebSockets (Socket.io) or WebRTC.
* **DevOps \& Cloud Ecosystem:** Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS, Docker containerization, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
* **Modern CSS Frameworks:** Experience with Tailwind CSS, styled\-components, or similar modern CSS methodologies for clean, responsive UI layouts.
* **Testing Libraries:** Solid experience with automated testing tools (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Mocha/Chai).


**Why Join Saltmine?**


* **Work on a Unique Product:** We aren't just building CRUD dashboards. You will work on a platform that merges complex spatial data, real\-time collaboration tools, and enterprise workflow engines.
* **High Growth \& Impact:** As an SDE 2 in a tight\-knit, collaborative product team, your decisions will directly impact our system architecture, product direction, and customer success.
* **Culture of Autonomy:** We practice radical trust, value open communication, and encourage engineering initiatives and out\-of\-the\-box ideas.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Competitive salary and equity packages, flexible work timings, a generous vacation policy, and a focus on work\-life balance and psychological safety.

title: Fullstack UX/UI Researchers/Designer - Applied & Agentic AI Systems
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are recruiting a Senior Fullstack UX/UI Researcher \& Designer to serve as a pivotal member of our Applied AI function. This is a high\-impact Senior Individual Contributor (IC) role designed for an elite practitioner who prefers building and executing over administrative management. By intentionally merging deep user research and high\-fidelity UI design into a single "fullstack" discipline, you will solve the unique friction points created by non\-deterministic AI outputs. In an environment where AI behavior is fluid, the ability to unify discovery and delivery is essential. Your work—ranging from embedded enterprise chat to real\-time generative UI streams—will be the primary engine for establishing user trust, ensuring that unpredictable machine learning data is transformed into intuitive, systemic, and reliable human experiences. This role represents a critical evolution in Roche’s digital mission, bridging the gap between raw algorithmic power and meaningful user value.
   

  

****Description of the area****
 At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. As part of our strategic initiatives, we are enabling high\-value AI (with a strong focus on Generative AI and agentic AI) through fit\-for\-purpose platforms, services and applications. The Applied AI Engineering Team is tasked with building innovative AI applications, GenAI agents, and agentic foundations. We operate in small agile teams (e.g., \~9 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before.
   

  

****Job Responsibilities****
* UX Research \& User Advocacy: Conduct user research to understand target users, develop personas, and ensure that our interfaces are optimized for user needs. Actively engage with end\-users to understand their workflows and translate business needs into intuitive design concepts. Perform usability tests to iterate on design concepts, integrating user feedback for continuous improvements. Design and test complex workflows and conversational interactions, observing how users react to dynamic, non\-deterministic system outputs
* Systemic UI \& Conversation Design: Focus on enhancing interaction with AI\-driven features by crafting user experiences that are conversational, responsive, and human\-like. Shift from designing static, predictable layouts to creating flexible, dynamic interfaces that can gracefully handle unpredictable data, varying confidence intervals, and real\-time LLM streams. Develop innovative visualizations to represent outputs from AI models, allowing users to easily understand and interact with complex information. Apply a strong aesthetic sense to build interfaces that foster user trust, utilizing enterprise design systems to maintain visual consistency across all touchpoints
* Wireframing and Prototyping: Design wireframes, user flows, and prototypes for innovative AI\-driven applications, focusing on both desktop and mobile experiences
* Accessibility and Usability: Ensure that all designed interfaces are accessible, inclusive, and provide a seamless user experience. Apply best practices to accommodate diverse user needs


**Qualifications**
* Hold a degree in Interaction Design, Human\-Computer Interaction or related fields
* Be passionate about AI\-driven user experiences and interested in staying up\-to\-date with emerging trends in UX/UI and AI
* Have a "Golden Mean" profile: deep design fundamentals backed by an artistic inclination and deep empathy for the end\-user
* Be detail\-oriented and have excellent problem\-solving skills
* Demonstrate strong self\-management skills to work effectively \- take initiative in identifying and solving problems, managing time efficiently, and ensuring tasks are completed on schedule


****Education / Experience****
* General UX/UI Mastery: 7\+ years of UX/UI Design mastery, with a demonstrated evolution into designing for AI\-driven and agentic systems
* Research Autonomy: 3–5\+ years of dedicated, hands\-on experience in User Research, Usability Testing, or Product Design Research, with a proven ability to own projects from a brief to final stakeholder presentation
* AI Integration Experience: Demonstrated experience designing interfaces that incorporate Large Language Models (LLMs) and classical Machine Learning (e.g., conversational assistants and data exploration tools)
* Information Architecture: Experience developing user journey maps, sitemaps, and wireframes that inform AI\-driven user experiences


**Skills**
****Must\-have:****
 Be able to conduct an end\-to\-end journey from ideation to prototype and testing:
   

  

* Research Skills: Strong user research skills, including conducting interviews, usability testing, and A/B testing to validate designs
* Design Tools: Proficiency in Figma for creating wireframes, mockups, and prototypes. Design system knowledge
* Prototyping and Testing: Ability to create interactive prototypes and gather user feedback through testing


****Should\-have:****
* Developing experience: Basic software development skills to allow editing codebases, creating code solutions, and understanding created codebases
* aSDLC: Created working mockups, PoCs, PoVs, prototypes via Agentic Software Development Lifecycle tools and approaches like Claude Code and Codex
* CX Strategy \& Integration: Ability to map customer touchpoints and integrate broader Customer Experience (CX) strategy into the product lifecycle


**Could\-have:**
* Regulatory Compliance: Proven experience working within highly regulated industries
* Agentic SDLC Prototyping Interest: A desire to further specialize in exchanging code with engineers via agentic workflows to streamline the handoff process
* Leading \& Educating Others: Interest in contributing to the development of the broader UX community through mentorship and knowledge sharing


**Additional Qualifications**
* Communication: Strong communication skills to effectively articulate design decisions and user needs to stakeholders. Be able to communicate in English at the level of: C1\+
* Collaboration: Ability to work collaboratively in Agile AI product development teams
* Ethics \& Empathy: Strong understanding of responsible AI deployment, backed by deep empathy for the end\-user to foster trust and accessibility
* Located in Hyderabad, India, with working hours structured to capture the 'golden hours' of overlap with Central European Time (typically running through the IST evening)


 \#Hyd2026
   

  

 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**\| About us:** 




 Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition\-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.
 



  





 Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer\-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.
 



  





 Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost\-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low\-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet\-related diseases.
 



  





 At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment:
 



  





 👥 Customer First \- You start with the member and work backwards.
 



 🚀 Make It Happen \- You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.
 



 🤝 One Team \- You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.
 



  





 Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food.
 



  





**\| About the role:** 




 As a Senior Fullstack Engineer at our company, you will play a crucial role in developing both the user\-facing frontend and the backend systems powering the Foodsmart platform. You’ll be responsible for designing and maintaining scalable, high\-performance web applications and backend services. You will work closely with both frontend and backend teams to create efficient APIs, manage data, and ensure a seamless user experience. Your contributions will directly impact the lives of our users, helping to bridge the gap between personalized nutrition seekers and registered dietitians providing expert guidance. You’ll have a passion for coding and a deep understanding of web technologies, enabling you to contribute to every layer of the product stack.
 



  





**You will:** 




  





 Develop and maintain the full\-stack Foodsmart web application.
 



 Design and implement robust, scalable backend systems and APIs.
 



 Collaborate with UX/UI designers to implement interactive, accessible, and responsive frontend interfaces using modern web technologies.
 



 Define and maintain development practices including code reviews, unit testing, and continuous integration to improve code quality and efficiency.
 



 Collaborate with the product team to understand user requirements, formulate use cases, and translate them into technical solutions.
 



 Debug and fix issues across both frontend and backend systems.
 



 Proactively monitor and optimize system performance, scalability, and security across both layers.
 



 Stay up\-to\-date on emerging technologies and propose ways to apply them in current and future development.
 



  





**You are:** 




  





 Strong in modern frontend engineering practices, accessibility, responsive design, and browser performance optimization.
 



 Solid in software engineering principles, with a strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, and system design.
 



 Well\-versed in both frontend and backend development tools, frameworks, and languages.
 



 Proficient with API design and integration, and able to implement robust solutions for seamless communication between frontend and backend.
 



 Experienced with database management, whether SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL) or NoSQL (DynamoDB), and cloud data platforms.
 



 Strong in debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
 



 A collaborative team player who can communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
 



  





**You have:** 




  





 5\+ years of full\-stack development experience, with deep, hands\-on expertise in React.js, and TypeScript for building production frontend applications, plus strong backend experience in Node.js for building services and APIs.
 



 Strong RESTful API design and integration skills — you can design clean, versioned API contracts, handle authentication/authorization, and consume third\-party APIs reliably from both frontend and backend code.
 



 Deep database knowledge across both relational and non\-relational systems: comfortable designing schemas, writing performant queries, and managing migrations in MySQL/PostgreSQL, as well as modeling and querying data in DynamoDB.
 



 Working familiarity with core AWS services, including compute (EC2, Lambda), messaging (SQS, SNS), storage (S3\), and managed databases (RDS) \- enough to deploy, configure, and troubleshoot services in a cloud\-native environment.
 



 Experience with containerization and orchestration, including building and running services in Docker and deploying/managing them in a Kubernetes (or similar) environment, along with general comfort operating in cloud infrastructure.
 



 BS or MS in Computer Science or a related field.

title: Principal Engineer - Java Full Stack-Generative AI, Agentic AI
description:
**About This Role**
 Wells Fargo is seeking a Principal Engineer to provide enterprise\-level technical leadership for the architecture, design, engineering, and modernization of mission\-critical Financial Crimes and Risk Management platforms.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Act as an advisor to leadership to develop or influence applications, network, information security, database, operating systems, or web technologies for highly complex business and technical needs across multiple groups
* Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges requiring in\-depth evaluation across multiple areas or the enterprise, delivering solutions that are long\-term, large\-scale and require vision, creativity, innovation, advanced analytical and inductive thinking
* Translate advanced technology experience, an in\-depth knowledge of the organizations tactical and strategic business objectives, the enterprise technological environment, the organization structure, and strategic technological opportunities and requirements into technical engineering solutions
* Provide vision, direction and expertise to leadership on implementing innovative and significant business solutions
* Maintain knowledge of industry best practices and new technologies and recommends innovations that enhance operations or provide a competitive advantage to the organization
* Strategically engage with all levels of professionals and managers across the enterprise and serve as an expert advisor to leadership


**Required Qualifications:**
* 7\+ years of Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education


**Desired Qualifications**
* Strong hands\-on experience in Java ecosystem technologies, including Core Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, concurrency, and performance optimization.
* Strong experience in frontend architecture and development using React or Angular, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, with the ability to build secure, accessible, resilient, and scalable enterprise user experiences.
* Proven experience designing, building, modernizing, and operating large\-scale distributed systems in production.
* Strong understanding of object\-oriented design, domain\-driven design, microservices architecture, API design, event\-driven systems, integration patterns, and distributed computing.
* Hands\-on experience delivering Generative AI solutions using large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, evaluation approaches, and agent orchestration frameworks.
* Experience integrating AI capabilities into enterprise platforms, backend services, digital workflows, and engineering processes in a secure, resilient, governed, and supportable manner.
* Experience defining architecture and integration patterns for machine learning\-enabled systems, model services, data pipelines, and scalable deployment.
* Experience with cloud\-native architecture, containers, orchestration platforms, infrastructure automation, CI/CD, DevSecOps, observability, and site reliability engineering practices.
* Experience designing highly available and resilient systems with appropriate recovery, fault\-tolerance, capacity, performance, monitoring, and operational\-support patterns.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and eliminate redundant technologies, overlapping capabilities, duplicate solutions, and fragmented engineering patterns across multiple domains.
* Experience creating reusable platforms, common services, reference architectures, accelerators, or engineering frameworks that can be adopted by multiple teams.
* Demonstrated curiosity about emerging technology concepts and the ability to evaluate their practical application to business problems.
* Awareness of emerging areas such as digital assets, harness engineering, loop engineering, newer AI models, intelligent automation, modern data platforms, and next\-generation development practices.
* Experience working in Financial Crimes, Risk Management, banking, financial services, or another highly regulated environment.
* Understanding of regulatory, security, privacy, model risk, data governance, audit, resiliency, and operational\-risk considerations relevant to enterprise technology solutions.
* Ability to connect engineering decisions to business results, customer outcomes, regulatory obligations, risk reduction, operational efficiency, and return on investment.
* Ability to balance strategic architecture with hands\-on technical engagement, including prototyping, design validation, code review, and complex problem resolution.
* Strong executive communication skills. Ability to explain complex engineering issues, alternatives, risks, and recommendations in concise business language.
* Demonstrated ability to influence decisions without direct authority and establish alignment across product, engineering, architecture, security, risk, and business stakeholders.
* Experience mentoring engineers, developing technical talent, raising engineering standards, and building communities of practice.
* Evidence of technical thought leadership through patents, publications, conference participation, external engineering forums, open\-source contribution, industry engagement, or equivalent internal influence.


**Job Expectations**
* The Principal Engineer will shape next\-generation digital platforms and intelligent systems across Java\-based distributed applications, modern web technologies, cloud\-native platforms, machine learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI. The role will ensure that solutions meet the highest standards of scalability, security, resiliency, operability, regulatory alignment, and engineering excellence within a complex banking environment.
* This role operates in a highly competitive and rapidly evolving technology environment where business expectations, regulatory requirements, customer needs, and technological innovation continue to accelerate. Success requires an exceptional engineering leader who continuously learns, adapts, innovates, and applies emerging technologies to create meaningful business advantage. The individual must maintain deep expertise in existing technologies while proactively identifying, evaluating, and adopting new engineering approaches, architectural patterns, and industry innovations that improve business outcomes.
* The Principal Engineer is expected to develop deep expertise in the Financial Crimes and Risk Management domain and become a recognized authority on how technology can be applied to solve business problems within the domain. This includes understanding regulatory requirements, operational processes, customer impacts, industry trends, emerging risks, and technology opportunities. The individual will use this knowledge to apply the latest technologies, tools, engineering practices, and solution patterns to deliver increasingly efficient, scalable, and valuable business outcomes.
* Operate as an enterprise Principal Engineer and not solely as the architect for an individual application, product, or delivery team.
* Operate with a growth mindset in a highly competitive technology landscape. Continuously build expertise in emerging technologies, industry trends, business domains, and engineering practices.
* Build and continuously deepen expertise in Financial Crimes and Risk Management. Apply that expertise when forming architecture decisions, technology strategies, and engineering priorities.
* Maintain deep expertise in primary technical disciplines. Develop sufficient knowledge of adjacent disciplines to make sound end\-to\-end decisions.
* Be self\-motivated in identifying and learning emerging technologies, concepts, engineering methods, and industry practices.
* Evaluate how emerging capabilities can be responsibly applied to Financial Crimes and Risk Management. Convert relevant concepts into practical experiments, reusable patterns, and scalable solutions.
* Maintain a relentless focus on technology leadership to help Wells Fargo remain competitive in the application of technology within Financial Crimes and Risk Management.
* Benchmark internal solutions against industry\-leading practices. Identify opportunities to leapfrog conventional approaches through innovation, simplification, automation, reuse, artificial intelligence, and engineering excellence.
* Demonstrate consistent focus on business outcomes. Ensure technology solutions improve efficiency, control effectiveness, resiliency, scalability, user experience, risk management, or return on investment.
* Look across Financial Crimes domains and the wider technology organization for redundant platforms, duplicated services, overlapping capabilities, and inconsistent engineering patterns.
* Proactively recommend consolidation, reuse, standardization, simplification, or retirement opportunities when they improve enterprise outcomes.
* Balance innovation with regulatory obligations, security requirements, resource constraints, operational readiness, and long\-term supportability.
* Demonstrate the courage to challenge existing assumptions, architectural decisions, technology choices, operating models, and established approaches. Support challenges with evidence, technical reasoning, business context, and viable alternatives.
* Bring a clear and independent technical point of view. Remain open to diverse perspectives and credible challenges.
* Influence senior leaders and cross\-functional stakeholders through expertise, trust, clarity, and strategic judgment.
* Communicate complex technology matters in simple language. Tailor depth, framing, and recommendations to each audience.
* Maintain regular hands\-on engagement with critical designs, code, prototypes, engineering standards, technical investigations, and production concerns.
* Establish architecture direction without becoming a delivery bottleneck. Enable teams through principles, reusable patterns, decision frameworks, and appropriate delegation.
* Drive engineering excellence across security, resiliency, performance, observability, automation, testability, maintainability, accessibility, and operational readiness.
* Mentor engineers across levels and organizational boundaries. Create opportunities for others to develop technical judgment and leadership capability.
* Contribute to recruiting, developing, and retaining diverse engineering talent.
* Share knowledge through technical forums, reusable documentation, architecture communities, publications, and appropriate external industry engagement.
* Promote Wells Fargo engineering excellence through credible technical leadership and active contribution to the wider engineering community.
* Establish measurable outcomes for major technical initiatives. Assess success through business value, risk reduction, reuse, simplification, reliability, engineering productivity, and sustainable adoption.
* Represent engineering perspectives in strategic planning and executive discussions. Contribute to multi\-year technology direction across Financial Crimes and Risk Management.


**Posting End Date:**
 22 Sep 2026
   

  

* Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.


**We Value Equal Opportunity**
 Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.
   

  

 Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance\-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit's risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

 Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s’ IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
   

  

 A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.

 will be aligned to the
 ****Business Operations Technology (BOT)****

* Hands‑on experience building modern web applications using Angular and/or React, with solid JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals.

- Demonstrated experience with Azure services, including

* Azure Functions \& Logic Apps

title: MTS 1, Software Engineer - Full Stack
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
   

  

 Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
   

  

 Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
   

  

 Join eBay’s Advertising and Marketing Technology teams to build the platforms, services, and user experiences that help sellers grow their business and make eBay the destination website for existing and new customers. You’ll work on high\-scale systems spanning frontend applications, backend services, APIs, data pipelines, and AI\-assisted engineering workflows, partnering closely with product, design, analytics, and applied science. We’re looking for engineers who can turn business problems into reliable, maintainable software, make sound technical tradeoffs, and take ownership from design through production. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving practical engineering problems in a fast\-moving environment where performance, quality, and measurable customer impact matter.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Design and build innovative advertising, marketing platform features that help eBay sellers, advertisers grow their business and help eBay become the dominant eCommerce platform.
* Develop scalable, highly available applications, APIs, and services using technologies such as Marko, React, Node.js, Java, and Scala.
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of complex features, from technical design and architecture through deployment and production support.
* Drive technical decisions, system design, and cross\-team collaboration to ensure scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions.
* Leverage AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) throughout the development lifecycle for coding, debugging, testing, and code review to increase engineering velocity.
* Contribute to AI\-powered advertising and marketing features by collaborating with ML engineers on LLM integrations, recommendation systems, and intelligent campaign optimization.
* Contribute to a culture of continuous learning, Agile development, open\-source collaboration, and rapid software delivery.
* Mentor team members, participate in technical discussions, and help shape engineering best practices across the organization.


**Job Requirements**
* BS/BA in Computer Science or related field plus 7 years work experience or MS with 6 years of relevant experience.
* Strong experience in building modern web applications at scale with React (or similar frameworks), HTML/CSS, RESTful APIs and responsive design.
* Experience with relational (Oracle/Postgres/MySQL) and/or NoSQL (Cassandra/MongoDB) databases, including schema design and query optimization.
* Proven ability to own end\-to\-end system design: writing technical design documents, leading design reviews, and making architectural decisions for multi\-service features.
* Experience designing scalable distributed systems with a track record of evaluating trade\-offs (consistency, availability, latency, cost) and driving technical alignment across teams.
* Experience with AI\-assisted development practices and tools to increase engineering productivity (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent).
* Experience building or integrating LLM\-powered features, agentic workflows, or AI\-driven automation in production systems is a plus.
* Strong ownership mentality with ability to drive work end\-to\-end in a collaborative environment.
* Exposure to GraphQL and experience in building Federated GraphQL APIs is highly desirable.
* Experience on contributing to open\-source is a plus.


 Benefits are an essential part of your total compensation for the work you do every day. Whether you’re single, in a growing family, or nearing retirement, eBay offers a variety of comprehensive and competitive benefit programs to meet your needs. Including maternal \& paternal leave, paid sabbatical, and plans to help ensure your financial security today and in the years ahead because we know feeling financially secure during your working years and through retirement is important.
   

  

 Here at eBay, we love creating opportunities for others by connecting people from widely diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and geographies. So, being diverse and inclusive isn’t just something we strive for, it is who we are, and part of what we do each and every single day. We want to ensure that as an employee, you feel eBay is a place where, no matter who you are, you feel safe, included, and that you have the opportunity to bring your unique self to work. To learn about eBay’s Diversity \& Inclusion click here: https://www.ebayinc.com/our\-company/diversity\-inclusion/
   

  

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
   

  

**Additional Details**
 eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
**Who We Are Looking For** 




 We are looking for a Full Stack Developer with strong frontend expertise to contribute to the development and scaling of GreyOak’s real\-time market intelligence platform.
 



 The role is ideal for someone who is highly hands\-on with Next.js, React, TypeScript, APIs, WebSockets, real\-time data handling and interactive charts.
 



 You will work closely with our quantitative research and backend teams to convert APIs, live data streams and quantitative outputs into fast, reliable and responsive product experiences.
 



 While the role requires an understanding of backend integration and application architecture, the primary focus will be on building and optimizing data\-intensive frontend applications involving live market data, dashboards, charts, filters and multiple real\-time data streams.
 



 Why This Role Is Important to Us
 



  





 GreyOak is building quantitative market intelligence products that process and present large amounts of historical and real\-time market data.
 



 As our products expand, application performance, chart responsiveness, WebSocket reliability and efficient frontend state management become increasingly important.
 



 This role will be responsible for strengthening the application layer between our quantitative/backend systems and the end user, ensuring that real\-time intelligence can be delivered reliably without unnecessary loading, rerendering or performance degradation.
 



 What You Will Be Responsible For
 



  





**As a Full Stack Developer, you will:** 



* Design, develop and maintain applications using Next.js, React and TypeScript.
* Build responsive and high\-performance dashboards for real\-time and historical datasets.
* Integrate REST APIs and WebSocket\-based real\-time data streams.
* Manage WebSocket connection lifecycle including subscriptions, unsubscriptions, reconnections and error recovery.
* Prevent duplicate socket connections, event listeners and unnecessary subscriptions.
* Build and optimize interactive financial charts using streaming and historical data.
* Manage live candle and price updates efficiently without unnecessarily rerendering or recreating complete charts.
* Build complex filters, selectors, indicators and dashboard interactions.
* Implement scalable application state management using Zustand or equivalent technologies.
* Optimize React components and state updates to prevent unnecessary rerenders.
* Improve application performance using caching, lazy loading, memoization, throttling and debouncing where appropriate.
* Handle symbol and timeframe switching efficiently across APIs, WebSockets and charts.
* Maintain synchronization between historical data and incoming real\-time data.
* Identify and resolve frontend memory leaks, slow rendering, excessive API calls and browser performance issues.
* Implement stable loading, error and reconnecting states.
* Integrate authentication, session management and protected routes.
* Develop and maintain API integration layers and Next.js server\-side functionality where required.
* Work closely with backend and quantitative teams on API contracts, schemas and real\-time payload structures.
* Troubleshoot production issues and perform root\-cause analysis.
* Participate in code reviews, testing and application architecture discussions.
* Maintain clean, reusable and strongly typed code across the application.



  





**What We Value** 




**These skills will help you succeed in this role:** 



* Strong hands\-on experience with React and Next.js.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript.
* Good understanding of Next.js App Router architecture.
* Strong understanding of React hooks, component lifecycle and rendering behaviour.
* Practical experience working with WebSockets and/or Server\-Sent Events.
* Experience building real\-time or frequently updating web applications.
* Strong REST API integration experience.
* Experience with state management tools such as Zustand, Redux or equivalent.
* Experience developing data\-intensive dashboards.
* Hands\-on experience with charting or data visualization libraries.
* Strong understanding of asynchronous data handling and frontend state synchronization.
* Understanding of WebSocket subscription and reconnection patterns.
* Experience diagnosing frontend performance issues using browser development and profiling tools.
* Good understanding of caching, memoization, throttling, debouncing and lazy loading.
* Understanding of server\-side and client\-side rendering in Next.js.
* Experience implementing authentication and secure session/token handling.
* Experience with Tailwind CSS or similar modern CSS frameworks.
* Familiarity with Git and standard software development workflows.
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills.



  





**Preferred Technical Experience** 



* Experience in fintech, trading, financial markets, analytics or other data\-intensive applications.
* Experience building financial or candlestick charts.
* Experience with TradingView Lightweight Charts, Highcharts, ECharts or similar charting libraries.
* Experience handling multiple simultaneous live data streams.
* Experience working with high\-frequency or frequently updating datasets.
* Experience with Zustand.
* Experience with TanStack Query.
* Experience with TanStack Table.
* Experience with Next.js API routes, middleware and server\-side application logic.
* Familiarity with Node.js.
* Understanding of SQL and/or NoSQL databases.
* Experience with Vitest, Playwright or similar testing frameworks.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and cloud deployment.
* Understanding of logging, monitoring and application observability.



  





**Education \& Preferred Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field is preferred.
* Approximately 2–5 years of relevant software development experience.
* Strong practical experience will be valued over years of experience alone.
* Candidates with demonstrated experience building real\-time, chart\-heavy or data\-intensive applications will be preferred.



  





**About GreyOak** 




 GreyOak Capital Intelligence is a fintech company building quantitative market intelligence products designed to make complex market data easier to interpret and use.
 



 Our technology combines proprietary quantitative models, historical and real\-time market data and modern product experiences to deliver structured market intelligence across financial markets.
 



 Our platform involves real\-time market data, quantitative analytics, interactive charts, multiple timeframes, filters, dashboards and data\-driven intelligence.
 



 The technology and quantitative research teams work closely together to transform complex market data and proprietary model outputs into simple, scalable and reliable product experiences.
