title: Software Engineer II - Full Stack
description:
**About Revolte** 




  






 Revolte is building AI for Software Engineering.
 




  






 We are creating an AI\-native platform that helps engineering teams execute the software delivery lifecycle with speed, quality, and control \- from planning and implementation to testing, release, governance, and production feedback.
 




  






 We're looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer II who can work across the frontend and backend, take ownership of features end to end, and build scalable, production\-ready applications in a fast\-moving AI\-first environment.
 




  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Design, develop, and ship scalable full\-stack applications and production\-ready features.
* Build responsive, high\-performance frontend experiences and reliable backend services.
* Develop and integrate REST APIs, microservices, third\-party services, and AI\-powered capabilities.
* Work across the entire development lifecycle, from technical design and implementation to testing, deployment, and production support.
* Collaborate closely with Product, Design, AI, Backend, and Platform Engineering teams.
* Build reusable frontend components and maintain scalable application architecture.
* Improve application performance, reliability, security, and overall user experience.
* Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, debugging, and technical decision\-making.
* Contribute to CI/CD, cloud deployments, observability, and engineering best practices.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to improving team engineering standards.
* Stay current with modern web, cloud, AI, and software engineering technologies.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




  




* 3–5 years of professional experience in full\-stack software development.
* Strong experience building and shipping production\-grade web applications.
* Ability to work confidently across frontend and backend systems.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, APIs, databases, and distributed systems.
* Strong problem\-solving, debugging, and analytical skills.
* Experience taking ownership of features from concept to production.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.
* Strong communication skills and a willingness to mentor and support other engineers.
* Interest in AI, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, and modern software engineering.



  





**Technical Skills** 




  




* Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, React.js, and Next.js.
* Strong backend experience with Node.js, Python, Go, or Java.
* Experience building RESTful APIs, microservices, and third\-party integrations.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, or similar technologies.
* Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, responsive design, and frontend performance.
* Experience with Git, GitHub, testing frameworks, and CI/CD workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with Docker and familiarity with Kubernetes.
* Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Understanding of system design, asynchronous processing, caching, and event\-driven architectures.
* Familiarity with observability, logging, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.
* Experience with AI/LLM APIs, RAG, embeddings, or AI agents is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools and modern developer workflows is desirable.



  





**Why Join Revolte** 




  




* Build the future of AI\-powered software engineering.
* Work across AI, full\-stack engineering, cloud infrastructure, and developer experience.
* Solve complex technical problems and build systems used by modern engineering teams.
* Work closely with experienced engineers, AI specialists, designers, and product teams.
* Own features end to end and see your work move from idea to production.
* Work with modern technologies and continuously expand your technical expertise.
* Mentor and influence engineering practices as Revolte grows.
* Join a high\-ownership AI\-first company where your work directly contributes to shaping the future of software engineering.

title: Staff Engineer - Full Stack
description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.
   

  





**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**




 Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost\-to\-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise\-grade yet easy\-to\-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.
   

  





***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.***



**Job Description**

 At Freshworks, we don’t just ship software—we shape it to be fast, reliable, and refreshingly simple. As a
 **Staff Full Stack Engineer (IC4\)** 
 , you will architect the end\-to\-end systems that drive our global SaaS products, balancing complex distributed backend infrastructure with highly responsive, scalable frontend applications. You will lead cross\-functional technical strategies, champion engineering excellence across teams, and mentor engineers to level up our entire platform ecosystem.
   

  





 If you obsess over time and space complexity, love breaking down tough, multi\-tier architectural problems, and take pride in leading technical execution without losing touch with the code—you’ll feel right at home.
   

  





**Impact You Can Create**



* **E2E Platform Evolution:** 
 Own and scale foundational full\-stack architectures capable of handling millions of transactions while delivering seamless, high\-performance web experiences globally.
* **Technical Guidance (IC4\):** 
 Act as a technical compass across multiple engineering tracks, translating ambiguous product visions into resilient, modular high\-level and low\-level designs.
* **Engineering Multiplier:** 
 Foster a culture of excellence by leading deep\-dive code reviews, mentoring junior/mid\-level systems engineers, and introducing modern architectural patterns.
* **AI\-Powered Efficiency:** 
 Pioneer the integration of modern AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) into the daily full\-stack development workflow to accelerate delivery without sacrificing technical depth.



**Roles \& Responsibilities (R\&R)**



* **Full\-Stack Architecture:** 
 Architect, build, and maintain scalable backend microservices and extensible REST APIs paired with intuitive, modular frontend application layers.
* **Full Lifecycle Ownership:** 
 Own the entire software development lifecycle—from gathering functional/non\-functional requirements and data modeling to deployment, automation, and production support.
* **Code \& Design Optimization:** 
 Write clean, modular, and testable code optimized for browser rendering efficiency, database execution performance, and space/time complexity.
* **Production Governance:** 
 Ensure backend and frontend systems are tuned for high availability (99\.99%\+), multi\-tenant fault tolerance, security compliance, and deep observability.
* **Cross\-Functional Partnership:** 
 Collaborate closely with Product Managers, UI/UX designers, and Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) to ship highly localized, value\-driven capabilities fast.
* **Root\-Cause Analysis:** 
 Troubleshoot complex full\-stack performance bottlenecks in production, from slow database queries to state\-management memory leaks.
* **Mentorship \& Best Practices:** 
 Lead architectural reviews, establish development roadmaps, mentor 2–4 engineers, and actively drive OOPS and SOLID design principles across the org.


**Qualifications**

**Skills**



* **Computer Science Foundations:** 
 Expert\-level grasp of Data Structures \& Algorithms (DSA), time/space complexity trade\-offs, and Object\-Oriented Design (OOD) anchored in SOLID principles.
* **System Design (HLD \& LLD):** 
 Proven capability to design scalable, highly available, and fault\-tolerant end\-to\-end multi\-tenant systems, including APIs, web architectures, schemas, and data models.
* **Distributed Infrastructure Stack:** 
 Solid exposure to RDBMS, NoSQL, caching strategies, microservices architecture, and distributed queuing systems.
* **Modern Web Ecosystems:** 
 Strong understanding of frontend engineering paradigms, including component lifecycles, state management, and client\-side performance optimization.
* **Cloud \& DevOps Practice:** 
 Hands\-on experience working with CI/CD automation pipelines, DevOps tooling, and cloud infrastructure platforms (AWS or GCP).
* **AI Tool Fluency:** 
 Practical exposure and experience using generative AI tools to improve day\-to\-day coding efficiency and technical exploration.
* **Technical Communication:** 
 Exceptional logical reasoning with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical thought processes and designs to both engineers and executives.



**Qualifications**



* **Professional Timeline:** 
 10\+ years of progressive software engineering experience building and scaling full\-stack applications in high\-growth product teams.
* **Iterative Sourcing History:** 
 A proven track record of building complex systems from scratch and steering them through multiple scale iterations in production.
* **Pragmatic Delivery:** 
 Skilled at balancing rapid feature delivery with long\-term code maintainability, clean documentation, and scalability.
* **Collaborative Leadership:** 
 Experience managing technical initiatives, coordinating cross\-functional engineering loops, and mentoring other engineers.
* **Education Baseline:** 
 Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative technical field.


**Additional Information**

 At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Frontend/Fullstack, UI Platform
description:
#### **About Rippling**


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365 \- all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.85B\+ from the world’s top investors \- including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, Bedrock, GIC, Elad Gil and Goldman Sachs and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

 *We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @rippling.com addresses.*

 **About the UI Platform Team**


The UI Platform team is a foundational platform team shaping how products are designed, built, and delivered at Rippling.

  

As Rippling continues to scale across products and engineering teams, excellence cannot be left to individual implementation alone. UI Platform builds the shared systems, design patterns, application architecture, performance guardrails, and delivery foundations that help teams ship high\-quality product experiences with speed, reliability, and consistency.

  

The team works across core areas such as:

* **Application Framework / SDUI** – enabling product teams to build configurable, scalable, and consistent product experiences.
* **Design System** – powering reusable primitives, patterns, and guardrails across Rippling products.
* **Frontend Infrastructure** – evolving Rippling’s web architecture for scale, performance, and independent product delivery.
* **Performance and Product Experience** – raising the quality bar across product surfaces.
* **AI\-native Developer Experience** – building infrastructure that helps engineers and AI agents write, validate, and ship production\-quality code more reliably.


This team partners closely with 40\+ product teams across Rippling and plays a central role in improving developer velocity, product consistency, and customer experience at scale.

 **About the Role**

* We are looking for a **Senior Software Engineer – Frontend\-Fullstack** to join Rippling’s UI Platform team.
* This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who is strong in frontend engineering, comfortable working across the stack, and excited about building platform systems that are used by many product teams.
* In this role, you will work on Rippling’s **Application Framework / Server Driven UI platform**, helping product teams build and integrate scalable, configuration\-driven user experiences. You will partner with engineers, designers, product managers, and platform stakeholders across the company to solve high\-leverage problems that improve how Rippling products are built and shipped.
* The ideal candidate has strong frontend fundamentals, practical backend exposure, good product intuition, and the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple teams. This role is approximately **80% frontend and 20% backend**, with a strong emphasis on building reusable frameworks, scalable UI architecture, and developer\-facing platform capabilities.
* You should be comfortable owning projects end\-to\-end, driving technical clarity, communicating well with partner teams, and operating in a fast\-moving environment where platform decisions can impact dozens of product surfaces.

 **What You Will Do**

* Build and evolve Rippling’s **Application Framework / SDUI platform**, enabling product teams to create configurable, consistent, and scalable user experiences.
* Partner with **40\+ product teams** to support adoption, integration, and evolution of UI Platform capabilities.
* Design and implement reusable frontend platform primitives, patterns, abstractions, and workflows that improve engineering velocity across Rippling.
* Work closely with Design, Product, and Engineering teams to translate platform requirements into high\-quality technical solutions.
* Contribute to frontend architecture, performance improvements, developer tooling, and platform reliability.
* Build backend components where needed to support configuration\-driven UI, schema\-based rendering, platform APIs, and internal tooling.
* Help improve the developer experience for product engineers building on top of Rippling’s UI Platform.
* Participate in technical design discussions, code reviews, debugging, testing, rollout planning, and production support.
* Use AI tools thoughtfully to improve development velocity, code quality, validation, and engineering workflows.
* Collaborate with senior engineers to drive larger projects, influence technical direction, and raise the quality bar across the team.
* Contribute to platform systems such as design systems, shared UI infrastructure, performance guardrails, and AI\-assisted development workflows.

**Qualifications**

* **6–9 years of professional software engineering experience**, preferably with strong frontend/platform/product engineering exposure.
* Strong hands\-on experience building complex frontend applications using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks such as **React**.
* Solid understanding of frontend architecture, component design, state management, performance, accessibility, testing, and maintainability.
* Experience building reusable UI systems, internal platforms, frontend infrastructure, or developer\-facing frameworks.
* Comfortable working fullstack, with backend exposure in areas such as APIs, services, data modeling, schemas, configuration systems, or platform integrations.
* Ability to independently own well\-defined to moderately ambiguous projects from design through execution, launch, and iteration.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, especially when working with multiple product teams and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Good product and design sensibility; able to balance platform consistency with product flexibility.
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced environment with evolving priorities and high ownership.
* Practical exposure to AI tools, AI\-assisted development, agentic workflows, orchestration, or automation is strongly preferred.
* Experience with design systems, component libraries, SDUI, schema\-driven UI, or configuration\-driven platforms is a strong plus.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience building or contributing to **design systems** or shared frontend platforms.
* Experience with **server\-driven UI / schema\-driven UI / configuration\-driven rendering**.
* Exposure to frontend monorepos, micro\-frontends, module federation, or large\-scale web architecture.
* Experience building internal developer tools, platform APIs, or productivity infrastructure.
* Familiarity with AI coding tools, AI agent workflows, prompt orchestration, automated validation, or code\-generation systems.
* Experience working in a platform team that supports multiple product teams.

**What Makes This Role Exciting**

* You will build systems that directly impact how 40\+ product teams build and ship at Rippling.
* You will work on high\-leverage platform problems across frontend architecture, SDUI, design systems, performance, and developer experience.
* You will help shape the future of AI\-assisted development inside a large production web application.
* You will work on foundational systems where improvements benefit every product team, not just one feature area.
* You will get strong ownership, high visibility, and the opportunity to grow toward Staff\-level platform scope over time.

**Role:** Senior Fullstack Engineer — Agentic AI Systems
  
  

**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**Work Experience:** 5–9 years
  
  

**Company:** Soulpage IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
  
  

**Positions:** 3
  
  

About the Role
  
  

Soulpage is an AI\-first technology company building enterprise AI products and platforms for clients including Fortune 500 and government organizations, alongside our own SaaS products.
  
  

You will join a dedicated pod (engineers \+ BA \+ Delivery Lead \+ Solution Architect) working directly with the CTO office. This is product engineering with ownership — not ticket execution: you will take modules from architecture through production, working in the prod repositories to enterprise standards.
  
  

What You Will Do
  
  

Design and build backend services and APIs (Python) that productionise AI/ML and agentic workflows — from prototype\-grade pipelines to reliable, observable, scalable services
  
  

**Build and orchestrate agentic systems:** multi\-step LLM workflows, tool/function calling, retrieval pipelines, evaluation and guardrails
  
  

Work with graph and document data models — entity extraction outputs, knowledge\-graph queries, large\-scale document processing pipelines
  
  

**Contribute across the stack where needed:** React\-based front ends for internal tools, review dashboards, and co\-pilot interfaces
  
  

**Own modules end to end:** architecture proposals, milestone delivery with exit criteria, demos to all stakeholders, documentation as a first\-class deliverable
  
  

Participate in fortnightly demos and architecture discussions with the engineering leadership
  
  

Must\-Have Skills
  
  

5\+ years of backend engineering with Python (FastAPI/Flask/Django), including REST/gRPC API design, async processing, and message queues
  
  

Hands\-on production experience with LLM\-based and agentic systems: at least one of LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs with tool calling, or equivalent in\-house frameworks — beyond tutorials: you have shipped and debugged these in production
  
  

**RAG pipelines:** chunking/embedding strategies, vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant, or similar), retrieval quality evaluation
  
  

Solid relational database skills (PostgreSQL) plus exposure to at least one NoSQL or graph store
  
  

**Cloud\-native development on AWS or Azure:** containers (Docker), CI/CD, infrastructure basics; Kubernetes exposure preferred
  
  

**Engineering rigor:** automated testing, code review discipline, observability (logging/metrics/tracing)
  
  

Strong written and spoken communication
  
  

Good to Have
  
  

Neo4j or other graph database experience (strong plus — the platform's core is a knowledge graph)
  
  

**Document AI / intelligent document processing:** OCR pipelines, layout parsing, entity and relationship extraction from technical documents
  
  

Full\-stack experience with React/TypeScript
  
  

MCP (Model Context Protocol), agent evaluation frameworks, or LLM observability tooling (LangSmith, Langfuse)
  
  

Domain exposure to energy, oil \& gas, EPC, or industrial/manufacturing software
  
  

Experience working in AI\-assisted development workflows (Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) with strong code\-review judgment
  
  

What Makes This Role Different
  
  

Product ownership from day one — named module ownership with demos to client leadership, not anonymous sprint tickets
  
  

**Frontier work:** agentic AI applied to a hard, real domain where correctness matters, not a chatbot wrapper
  
  

Direct mentorship from Soulpage's Director of Engineering and Solution Architect embedded in the same pod
  
  

**A clear growth path:** this pod is phase one of a multi\-phase programme expected to scale
  
  

Hiring Process
  
  

Profile review \+ 20\-min screening call
  
  

**Technical deep\-dive:** backend design \+ agentic systems (90 min, includes a practical discussion of a system you've shipped)
  
  

Problem\-solving round with our Solution Architect
  
  

Culture and ownership conversation with the Director

**About UptimeAI**
 UptimeAI provides AI reasoning agents that help industrial operations teams make goal\-oriented, real\-time decisions.
   

  

 Industrial facilities are rich in data but constrained by the expertise required to maintain and interpret it. As experienced engineers retire and operational complexity grows, organizations struggle to scale the expert judgment needed to maintain reliability, safety, and performance.
   

  

 UptimeAI addresses this challenge by embedding engineering reasoning directly into AI agents that continuously analyze operational data, diagnose issues, and guide teams toward the best actions. The result is faster decisions, reduced downtime, improved efficiency, and stronger operational performance.
   

  

**Role : Full stack Developer (MEAN/MERN Stack)**
**Location:** 
 Bangalore, India (Hybrid)
   

  

**Experience:** 
 4\+ years
   

  

**Department:** 
 Engineering
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a skilled Fullstack Developer with experience in MEAN/MERN stack development to join our remote team. The ideal candidate will have at least 2 year of professional experience, strong data structures and algorithms (DSA) knowledge, and proficient programming skills. Freshers with notable projects are also encouraged to apply. This is an excellent opportunity to work with a dynamic team on exciting projects and grow your career in a collaborative environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using the MEAN stack.
* Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code following best practices.
* Implement responsive user interfaces using modern front\-end frameworks (Angular).
* Develop and integrate APIs for seamless communication between front\-end and back\-end systems.
* Perform code reviews, debugging, and troubleshooting to ensure high\-quality deliverables.
* Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends to continuously improve development processes and solutions


**Qualifications Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science/engineering (B.Tech in CSE/IT) or MCA.
* Minimum 4\+ years of professional experience in MEAN/MERN stack development.
* Proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and related web technologies.
* Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience with database systems such as MongoDB, MySQL, or PostgreSQL.
* Familiarity with version control systems (Git/GitHub) and agile development methodologies.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively in a remote team environment.
* Demonstrated ability to learn and adapt to new technologies quickly.
* Freshers with relevant projects/portfolio will also be considered


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform).
* Knowledge of server\-side frameworks such as Express.js (for Node.js) or Flask/Django (for Python).
* Understanding of microservices architecture and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with DevOps practices for continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD)


**Good To Have**
* Competitive Coding / Algorithmic Problem Solving: Demonstrated proficiency in competitive coding platforms (e.g., LeetCode, HackerRank, TopCoder, Codeforces) or a strong, demonstrable foundation in algorithms and data structures, showcasing exceptional problem\-solving abilities


**Why To Join UptimeAI**
* Impact Industry\-Wide Change: Contribute to transformative solutions that significantly improve operational efficiency and reliability for global clients.
* Collaborative and Growth\-Oriented Environment: Join a talented, passionate team that values innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth.
* Opportunities for Leadership and Innovation: Lead pioneering projects, influence product development, and shape the future of industrial AI solutions.

title: Senior NodeJS Engineer (4-5 years)
description:
THE ROLE
 



 This is not a promotion title for a mid\-level developer. This is for the engineer who decides how systems are structured — who owns architecture, not just implementation within it.
 



  





 You'll work directly with the CTO and product leadership to translate ambiguous business problems into system design. You'll define scope, propose architecture, own decisions end\-to\-end, and be accountable for outcomes.
 



  





 If you've always worked within someone else's architecture, this isn't the role. If you've been the person who defines that architecture — keep reading.
 



  





 WHAT YOU'LL OWN
 



 • System architecture: service design, inter\-service communication patterns, event\-driven design, and data modeling — independently, from first principles
 



 • Technical requirement gathering directly with product and business stakeholders — you define scope, not wait for a spec
 



 • AWS infrastructure architecture: compute, networking, data layer, and delivery
 



 • Real\-time financial data pipelines on Kafka are critical to our core product
 



 • Data layer design across PostgreSQL (relational/transactional) and MongoDB
 



 • Backend engineering standards the rest of the team follows
 



 • Build vs. buy decisions with documented, defensible tradeoff reasoning
 



  





 WHAT "SENIOR" MEANS HERE
 



 • You've designed distributed systems end\-to\-end — not just contributed to someone else's design
 



 • You lead technical discussions with non\-technical stakeholders; you don't wait for a ticket to start thinking
 



 • You identify over\-engineering in your own work and in others' — and course\-correct without prompting
 



 • You make confident architectural decisions with incomplete information and articulate your tradeoffs clearly
 



 • You've shipped systems you designed, not just systems you inherited
 



  





 REQUIRED STACK
 



 Node.js/Nest.js · AWS · Kafka · PostgreSQL · MongoDB — all required in production
 



  





 REQUIREMENTS
 



 • 4–5 years of backend engineering; minimum 2 years in architecture\-owning roles
 



 • All stack technologies used in production environments — not side projects
 



 • Product company background — not services, outsourcing, or agency
 



 • Based in Bangalore or willing to relocate immediately
 



  





 YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF
 



 • Small team dynamics give you energy — less process, more ownership
 



 • You're comfortable being the most accountable person for technical calls
 



 • You treat over\-engineering as a problem, not a signal of seniority
 



 • Regulated or data\-sensitive environment experience
 



  





 YOU'LL STRUGGLE HERE IF
 



 • You need architectural direction before you can start
 



 • You've been technically strong but have always deferred design decisions upward
 



 • You've never led stakeholder conversations to define technical scope
 



  





 WHY NOW
 



 Stack Wealth is approaching Series A. The systems you design will scale with the company. The technical foundations you lay today will define the platform for the next three years.

title: AI Customer Engineer, Digital Natives, Google Cloud

* Knowledge of integration patterns using OpenAPI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect AI agents with business systems and Application Programming Interface (API) gateways.

 The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
   

  

 As a AI Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to customers. You will leverage your deep expertise in strategic product areas in partnership with platform CEs, writing code, developing prototypes, proofs\-of\-concept, and demos to promote new specialized solutions to customers. You’ll be leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

description:

* Apply testing \& quality: pytest, unit/integration/e2e tests, property‑based (hypothesis), linters/formatters (ruff/flake8, black), type checks (mypy/pyright), pre‑commit.
* Deliver IaC with Terraform/Pulumi; manage config via Helm/Kustomize; implement GitOps with Argo CD/Flux on managed/self‑hosted Kubernetes.

* Monitor model/data drift, bias, and performance with Evidently/WhyLabs/Arize/Fiddler; unify telemetry via OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki, Jaeger.

* Implement progressive delivery for services/models (blue/green, canary, shadow) using Argo Rollouts/Flagger with instant rollback and health checks.
* Operate API gateways and service mesh (Kong/NGINX/Envoy, Istio/Linkerd) for rate limiting, mTLS, authN/Z, and zero‑trust patterns.
* Ensure privacy/compliance (GDPR/CCPA/DPDP/ISO 27001\): data minimization, masking/tokenization, DLP, lineage (OpenLineage/Marquez), model cards/data sheets.
* Collaborate with security, data, and platform teams to publish golden paths, templates, and reference implementations for repeatable AI delivery.

* Strong expertise in Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, and modern CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps.

* Strong troubleshooting, problem‑solving, and system debugging skills with a collaborative, engineering‑first mindset.
* Excellent communication skills with ability to work cross‑functionally with Data, AI/ML, DevOps, Security, and Platform Engineering teams.


**Experience 4 To 7 Years**
**Education B.Tech. / BS in Computer Science**
**Technical Skills \& Certifications**
* Terraform, Pulumi, and IaC for automated cloud and platform provisioning.
* Kubernetes, Docker/Podman, Helm, and Kustomize for container orchestration and packaging.
* CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, and Azure DevOps.
* Proficient in Python (FastAPI, ML/LLM libraries) and scripting with Bash/PowerShell.
* DevSecOps tooling: Snyk, SonarQube, Trivy, Checkmarx, GitLeaks, and secret scanning.
* MLOps platforms: MLflow, Kubeflow, W\&B, Azure ML, Vertex AI for model lifecycle management.

**Software Engineering SMTS, Identity \& Access Management**
**About The Team**
 The Salesforce Enterprise Security Engineering team builds and operates highly scalable, fault\-tolerant, distributed systems that deliver cloud\-scale Identity and Access Management (IAM) services across our Enterprise network, public cloud infrastructure, and internal data centers. We provide the core building blocks for identity lifecycle, governance, authentication, authorization and privileged access management that protect customer trust and empower every Salesforce engineer to operate securely, regardless of environment.
   

  

 We are seeking a full\-stack software engineer with a track record of building modern, secure services and applications following the Software Development Life Cycle and best security development practices. You'll work across the IAM domain, so a solid understanding of identity concepts in the authentication, authorization, and identity governance space is important for this role.
   

  

**About The Position**
 This is a hands\-on software engineering role with a focus on the IAM domain. You will design and build end\-to\-end capabilities from backend services and APIs to the user\-facing experiences that power identity lifecycle (human/non\-human), access requests, provisioning, entitlement/role management, access certifications, and policy\-driven access decisions at enterprise scale.
   

  

 You will secure the emerging agentic enterprise by designing controls for AI agents and autonomous workloads, including agent identity, privilege, least privilege, just\-in\-time access, time\-bound access, separation of duties, and continuous risk\-based access decisions.
   

  

 You will also own features through the full development lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement. You'll partner across application owners, product management, and governance to translate identity and compliance requirements into intuitive, reliable, and scalable solutions. This work is foundational to advancing Salesforce's Zero Trust architecture, enabling dynamic, real\-time access decisions based on employment status, role change, and device or user trust.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Design, build, and operate scalable IAM services and APIs spanning identity lifecycle, access requests, entitlement/role management and access certifications.
   

  

 Build privileged access management (PAM) capabilities — credential vaulting/rotation, session control, and secrets management and just\-in\-time (JIT) access flows that grant elevated, time\-bound entitlements and revoke them automatically.
   

  

 Model and secure non\-human/workload identities (NHI) — service accounts, agents, workloads, and machine credentials — including issuance, rotation, and lifecycle governance.
   

  

 Develop full\-stack features, backend services and modern web front\-ends that deliver intuitive self\-service and administrative experiences for IAM.
   

  

 Build and manage containerized workloads with Kubernetes, Docker, and infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform); operate services in a full DevOps model (monitor, troubleshoot, continuously improve).
   

  

 Integrate across identity sources, directories, and downstream applications using SCIM, REST, and event\-driven patterns.
   

  

 Partner with governance and compliance teams to embed SoD, least\-privilege, and audit controls (SOX, NIST, SOC 2\) into the platform.
   

  

 Write clean, maintainable, secure code; participate in design and code reviews; and champion secure SDLC practices.
   

  

 Collaborate with cross\-functional teams across security, infrastructure, product, and engineering to ensure platform integrity and trustworthiness.
   

  

 Create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and enablement materials.
   

  

 Design for significant features, mentor junior engineers, and drive technical direction and continuous improvement across the platform.
   

  

**Required Skills/Experience**
 SMTS: 5\+ years of professional software development experience building distributed systems in SaaS, PaaS, or IaaS environments.
   

  

 Full\-stack development proficiency: strong backend skills in Java, Go, and/or Python, plus front\-end experience with modern frameworks (e.g., React).
   

  

 Solid understanding of the IAM domain, identity governance/lifecycle, authentication, authorization, RBAC/entitlement models, privileged access management including just\-in\-time access and common protocols (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, SCIM, LDAP).
   

  

 Experience designing and consuming REST APIs (JSON/XML, OpenAPI/Swagger) and integrating heterogeneous systems.
   

  

 Strong experience on public cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), including containers (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform).
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with CI/CD and source control (Git, Jenkins, or equivalent), including secure coding and defensive programming.
   

  

 Solid grasp of DevOps practices, monitoring, and ownership of production systems in high\-availability environments.
   

  

 Strong problem\-solving, debugging, communication, and collaboration skills.
   

  

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Experience integrating AI/agentic capabilities into IAM workflows or user experiences.
   

  

 Experience with globally distributed teams and large enterprises.
   

  

 Familiarity with commercial IAM platforms (e.g., SailPoint, Okta, CyberArk, Active Directory/EntraID) as a consumer or integrator, not required as a specialty.

May include research, new development, prototyping, modification, reuse, re\-engineering, maintenance, or any other activities related to software products used internally or externally on product platforms supported by the firm. The software development process requires in\-depth subject matter expertise in existing and emerging development methodologies, tools, and programming languages. Software Developers work closely with business partners and / or external clients in defining requirements and implementing solutions. The Software Development Engineer In Test (SDET) role encompasses automation development and execution, functional, and non\-functional testing. The SDET role specializes in the design, development, execution, and maintenance of automated tests to ensure the quality of software products. Partners with team members to understand software requirements and execute automated tests that validate the functionality while considering privacy and security requirements

* Detailed understanding of smoke testing, functional, and non\-black box testing, as well as regression testing

* Experience in Software Development

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in\-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.
   

  

****Role Overview And Core Responsibilities****
**Architecture \& Solution Design**
****Responsibilities****
 Design scalable and resilient data processing solutions using Apache Spark and modern data platform technologies. Create architecture designs, reference patterns, and technical specifications for distributed data platforms. Guide engineering teams on architecture, design, and implementation decisions. Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, and engineering best practices. Evaluate technology choices, frameworks, and platform capabilities to address evolving business needs. Identify architectural risks and recommend mitigation strategies. Contribute to platform modernization and cloud transformation initiatives.
   

  

**Apache Spark \& Data Platform Leadership**
****Responsibilities****
 Provide technical leadership for Apache Spark\-based batch and streaming data processing solutions. Guide development teams on Spark architecture, performance optimization, and operational best practices. Define design patterns for scalable, fault\-tolerant, and maintainable Spark applications. Assist teams in resolving complex technical challenges involving distributed processing and large\-scale data workloads. Drive performance improvements through effective partitioning, query optimization, resource management, caching, and tuning strategies. Establish standards for observability, monitoring, reliability, and operational excellence.
   

  

**Solution Architecture \& Engineering Guidance**
****Responsibilities****
 Collaborate with engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle. Conduct architecture and design reviews for new features, data pipelines, and platform enhancements.
   

  

 Support engineering teams in implementing scalable and maintainable solutions.
   

  

 Promote adoption of CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure\-as\-code, and DevOps best practices. Contribute to technical decision\-making for platform enhancements and modernization initiatives.
   

  

**Stakeholder Collaboration**
****Responsibilities****
 Work closely with product managers, engineering leads, data scientists, and platform teams. Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and architecture designs. Communicate architecture decisions, technical trade\-offs, and implementation approaches to stakeholders. Participate in roadmap discussions to ensure alignment between business goals and technology strategy. Collaborate across teams to drive successful implementation of data platform capabilities.
   

  

**Technical Mentoring**
****Responsibilities****
 Mentor engineers on distributed systems design, Spark development, and data engineering best practices. Provide guidance through architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical workshops.
   

  

 Share knowledge on emerging data platform technologies and architectural patterns.
   

  

****Required Knowledge And Experiences****
**Process \& Quality**
****Responsibilities****
 Ensure architecture and design activities follow established SDLC and governance standards. Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and architecture assessments. Promote reliability, maintainability, scalability, and performance considerations throughout solution development. Drive continuous improvement in architecture practices and engineering standards.
   

  

****Required Knowledge \& Experience****
**Technical Expertise**
 10\+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or distributed systems development.
   

  

 Strong Hands\-on Expertise With Apache Spark (Spark SQL, Structured Streaming, DataFrames, Dataset APIs). Experience Designing And Building Large\-scale Distributed Data Processing Systems. Strong Knowledge Of Spark Optimization Techniques Including:
   

  

* Partitioning Strategies
* Shuffle Optimization
* Join Optimization
* Memory Management
* Resource Utilization
* Performance Tuning


 Proficiency in Scala, Java, or Python. Experience with technologies such as:
   

  

* Hadoop
* Hive
* Iceberg
* AWS EMR
* AWS Glue
* GCP Dataproc
* BigQuery


 Experience designing and operating batch and streaming data pipelines. Understanding of cloud\-native architecture and distributed systems principles. Experience deploying Spark solutions on AWS and/or GCP platforms.
   

  

**Scope \& Positioning**
 Individual contributor architecture role focused on distributed data platforms and Spark\-based solutions. Provides architecture leadership and technical guidance across one or more engineering teams. Responsible for solution architecture quality, technology selection, design governance, and technical direction within the domain. Partners with Engineering Managers and Technical Leads to deliver scalable and reliable platform capabilities. Serves as a key technical advisor for Spark architecture, distributed systems design, and cloud\-native data platforms.
   

  

****Preferred Qualifications****
* Experience with AWS services such as EMR, Glue, S3, Lambda, EKS, ECS, Step Functions, and CloudWatch.
* Experience with GCP services such as Dataproc, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, and Composer.
* Experience managing terabyte\-to\-petabyte scale data processing environments.
* Experience with Spark Structured Streaming, real\-time analytics, and event\-driven data processing.

**About the Role** 




 We are seeking a
 **Full Stack Builder \- AI Specialist** 
 to design, build, and deploy production\-grade agentic AI applications and intelligent workflow systems who combines strong full\-stack software development with hands\-on generative AI implementation, requirements discovery, and technical solution architecture.
 



 In this role, you will interface directly with business stakeholders to understand complex operational workflows (particularly across BFSI, supply chain, and industrial manufacturing), evaluate feasibility, design scalable technical blueprints, and execute end\-to\-end agentic and RAG solutions.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Requirements Gathering \& Technical Discovery** 



* **Stakeholder Discovery:** 
 Conduct technical discovery sessions with product owners and domain stakeholders to unpack workflow bottlenecks and document clear functional/non\-functional requirements.
* **AI Feasibility \& Risk Assessment:** 
 Critically assess whether a problem requires GenAI/agents or deterministic software/traditional ML, identifying edge cases, latency boundaries, and compliance risks early.
* **Scope \& Metric Definition:** 
 Define clear success criteria (e.g., target accuracy, latency budgets, faithfulness thresholds, cost per transaction) and translate them into engineering backlogs and evaluation benchmarks.



**2\. Solution Design \& Architecture** 



* **End\-to\-End System Design:** 
 Architect resilient AI systems, producing clear technical design documents (TDDs), sequence diagrams, data flow schemas, and API contracts.
* **Hybrid AI Strategy:** 
 Design architectures that intelligently blend open\-source/open\-weights models (via vLLM/Ollama) with proprietary frontier APIs based on data sovereignty, residency, and cost constraints.
* **Security \& Guardrail Design:** 
 Architect data sanitization layers, Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) confirmation flows, and role\-based access controls (RBAC) to ensure sensitive business data remains protected.



**3\. Development \& Execution** 



* **AI\-Native Development:** 
 Leverage AI engineering assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity) to deliver robust, maintainable full\-stack software quickly.
* **Agentic Systems \& Tool Calling:** 
 Implement multi\-step agent workflows using open\-source orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or n8n) with strict structured outputs (Pydantic).
* **Advanced RAG Pipelines:** 
 Build high\-precision retrieval engines using vector databases (Qdrant, pgvector) with hybrid dense\-sparse search, contextual re\-ranking, and metadata filtering.
* **Full Stack Integration:** 
 Build scalable backend services (Python/FastAPI, TypeScript, or C\#/.NET) paired with reactive user interfaces (React/Next.js) supporting real\-time streaming.
* **Automated Evaluation:** 
 Set up automated CI/CD eval suites using frameworks like Ragas or DeepEval to catch hallucinations and regressions before production deployment.



**Requirements \& Qualifications** 



* **Experience:** 
 2\+ years in software engineering with demonstrable experience building full\-stack applications and deploying AI/LLM components.
* **System Design \& Architecture:** 
 Proven ability to translate business requirements into system architecture diagrams, database schemas, and API specifications.
* **Core Stack:** 
 Strong proficiency in Python, TypeScript, or C\#/.NET, along with relational databases (PostgreSQL/SQL Server) and open\-source vector databases (Qdrant, pgvector).
* **Agent \& RAG Orchestration:** 
 Hands\-on experience with LLM tool\-calling, prompt engineering, structured output validation, and retrieval pipelines.
* **Communication:** 
 Strong verbal and written communication skills to bridge technical architecture and business outcomes for non\-technical stakeholders.



**Nice\-to\-Haves** 



* Experience in data compliance/residency, Knowledge Graphs (Neo4j), or Industrial/Financial data schemas.
* Experience with on\-premises/edge model deployment (Ollama, vLLM, LiteLLM).

description:
**Engineering at Innovaccer**
With every line of code, we accelerate our customers' success, turning complex challenges into innovative solutions. Collaboratively, we transform each data point we gather into valuable insights for our customers. Join us and be part of a team that's turning dreams of better healthcare into reality, one line of code at a time. Together, we're shaping the future and making a meaningful impact on the world.

**About the Role**


We're looking for an SDE\-1, Fullstack Engineer to develop and maintain a multi\-tenant application platform with integrations to InNote, P360, Gravity, and AidBox (FHIR\-first schema).


You'll build scalable backend services and responsive frontend interfaces for healthcare providers and payers, working across the full stack on referral workflows — from creation and approval to tracking and fulfillment — while contributing to a broader FHIR migration effort that brings our data models in line with FHIR R4 standards.

**A Day in the Life**


Referral Workflow Development

* Build full\-stack features for referral workflows — creation, approval, tracking, and fulfillment.
* Develop RESTful APIs with FastAPI/Node.js for referral CRUD, status transitions, and reporting.
* Build React\-based dashboards and workflows for referral management.


Integration \& Interoperability

* Integrate with InNote and Gravity APIs for data exchange and workflow orchestration.
* Lead FHIR migration efforts — convert existing data models to FHIR\-compliant schemas.


Data \& Multi\-Tenancy Architecture

* Implement multi\-tenancy architecture ensuring data isolation and tenant\-specific customizations.
* Design and optimize PostgreSQL/MongoDB schemas for referral entities and audit trails.


Quality, Collaboration \& Operations

* Write comprehensive unit and integration tests; maintain \>80% code coverage.
* Participate in code reviews and architectural discussions.
* Deploy and monitor services in Kubernetes environments using Argo CD.
* Collaborate with product, design, and QA teams on requirements and acceptance criteria.

**What You Need**


Must\-Haves

* 2\+ years of Full\-stack web development experience with Python (async), FastAPI/Django, and Node.js/Express.
* Proficiency with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Material Design.
* Hands\-on experience with MongoDB (primary) and PostgreSQL (optional), including schema design and SQL optimization.
* Working knowledge of FHIR R4, HL7, and REST API design patterns.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Argo CD, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Familiarity with Git, Jira, Postman, and monitoring tools such as ELK or Datadog.
* Healthcare domain knowledge, including FHIR basics and HIPAA/compliance awareness.
* Understanding of multi\-tenancy design patterns and microservices architecture.
* Comfort writing and maintaining automated tests using standard testing frameworks.

**Good to Have**

* Familiarity with InNote or similar EHR platforms.
* Experience with event\-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
* GraphQL implementation experience, to be used with AidBox.

**Here’s What We Offer**

* Generous Leaves: Enjoy generous leave benefits of up to 40 days.
* Parental Leave: Leverage one of industry's best parental leave policies to spend time with your new addition.
* Sabbatical: Want to focus on skill development, pursue an academic career, or just take a break? We've got you covered.
* Health Insurance: We offer comprehensive health insurance to support you and your family, covering medical expenses related to illness, disease, or injury. Extending support to the family members who matter most.
* Care Program: Whether it’s a celebration or a time of need, we’ve got you covered with care vouchers to mark major life events. Through our Care Vouchers program, employees receive thoughtful gestures for significant personal milestones and moments of need.
* Financial Assistance: Life happens, and when it does, we’re here to help. Our financial assistance policy offers support through salary advances and personal loans for genuine personal needs, ensuring help is there when you need it most.


Innovaccer is an equal\-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, marital status, or veteran status, feel valued and empowered.

 **Disclaimer:** Innovaccer does not charge fees or require payment from individuals or agencies for securing employment with us. We do not guarantee job spots or engage in any financial transactions related to employment. If you encounter any posts or requests asking for payment or personal information, we strongly advise you to report them immediately to our HR department at px@innovaccer.com. Additionally, please exercise caution and verify the authenticity of any requests before disclosing personal and confidential information, including bank account details.


About Innovaccer
Innovaccer builds software that helps hospitals, clinics, and health insurance companies make sense of all the scattered data they deal with every day — patient records, appointments, insurance claims, lab results — and turns it into something useful and actionable.


Think of a typical hospital: patient information often lives in a dozen different systems that don't talk to each other well. This causes delays in scheduling, slows down doctors, and makes it harder to catch health problems early. Innovaccer's platform connects all of that data together, and increasingly, uses AI "agents" to actually do some of the manual work for healthcare teams — things like scheduling appointments, preparing insurance paperwork, or drafting clinical notes — so that staff can spend more time with patients and less time on admin work.


Some of the largest healthcare systems in the US — including CommonSpirit Health, Atlantic Health, and Banner Health — use Innovaccer's platform today.


The company is also investing heavily in this direction: in June 2026, Innovaccer signed a multi\-year partnership with AWS to run its AI agents at a much larger scale, using AWS's cloud AI tools (Amazon Bedrock) and healthcare\-specific data infrastructure (AWS HealthLake). This is a strong signal of where the platform — and this engineering team — is headed next. For more information, visit www.innovaccer.com and check us out on YouTube, Glassdoor, LinkedIn, Instagram, and the Web.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
**Job description**

**Location:** Ahmedabad, India on\-site  
**Shift**: 8:00 AM 5:00 PM US CST (6:30 PM 3:30 PM night shift, India)  
**Reports to**: Founder \& CEO  
**Experience**: 6\+ years  
**Type**: Full\-time and In\-person  
**Split**: Approx. 70% hands\-on engineering / 30% technical leadership \& mentoring

**ABOUT PROFUSION SYSTEMS**

Profusion Systems is a Chicago\-based, AI\-enabled custom software development company. Our engineering team in Ahmedabad builds production software for clients across fintech, nonprofit, food and facility services, and SaaS RAG and LLM integrations, Azure AI deployments, document automation, and custom web and mobile applications. Our team works US Pacific hours, which means we collaborate with our clients and leadership in real time, not across a handoff.

We are a small team where individual work is visible. Nothing you build disappears into a large organization, and nothing you neglect does either.

**WHAT THIS ROLE ACTUALLY IS**

This is not a role where you wait for tickets and hand off problems.

You will be the most senior technical person on one or two client accounts.

That means the architecture is yours, the release is yours, and the answer to "what should we do here?" is expected to come from you — with the tradeoffs laid out — rather than be routed upward.

The other half of the job is people. You will mentor two to four engineers, review their work, and raise the standard of what "done" means on your accounts. We are deliberately hiring a player\-coach, not a manager who has stopped building.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

* **End\-to\-end delivery.** Architecture, implementation, testing, and deployment for one or two client accounts — from requirements conversation to production.
* **Releases, completely.** You build the CI/CD pipeline, you verify what is in the artifact, and you confirm the release is live and working. A release stays yours until it is proven in production — not until it is triggered.
* **Solutions, not problems.** When you are blocked, you arrive with a recommended path and the tradeoffs behind it. Escalation is for genuinely ambiguous business decisions, not for technical ones inside your scope.
* **Technical judgment on your accounts.** Routine architectural and implementation decisions are yours to make and defend. We would rather you make a reasoned call and be occasionally wrong than wait for permission.
* **Code quality on your pod.** Review discipline, test coverage, documentation, and a consistent definition of done that holds when nobody is watching.
* **Growing two to four engineers.** Structured code review, honest feedback, and a deliberate plan to move each person up a level. Some of them are being groomed toward lead roles — your success includes theirs.
* **Direct client conversations.** You explain your own architecture, timelines, and tradeoffs to the client. You will not have someone translating your work for you.

**WHAT YOU NEED TO HAVE**

* 6\+ years building and shipping enterprise web applications in C\#/.NET, including modern .NET (8/9\) and legacy .NET Framework
* ASP.NET Core and MVC, Web API, REST service design, Entity Framework / EF Core
* React (or a comparable modern JavaScript framework), plus solid HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript fundamentals
* SQL Server and T\-SQL, including relational data modeling and query performance work
* Azure — App Service, Functions, Azure SQL, Key Vault, and Blob Storage in production
* Azure DevOps — demonstrable experience building and owning CI/CD pipelines, not only consuming pipelines someone else configured
* Git branching and release strategy for a team, including hotfix workflow
* Object\-oriented design, unit testing, and integration testing as habits rather than afterthoughts
* Third\-party platform and API integration, including debugging failures you did not cause
* Agile delivery across concurrent workstreams, working directly with product owners and clientsjobs@profusionsystems.com
* Fluent written and spoken English — this role is client\-facing
* A track record of mentoring engineers, formally or informally, that a reference will confirm

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, RAG pipelines, or vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate)
* Docker and containerized deployment
* React Native or other mobile experience
* Fintech, lending, or another regulated\-industry background
* Test\-driven development
* Experience as a formal tech lead or in a comparable role

**How we will evaluate you**

We screen for judgment as hard as we screen for stack knowledge, because judgment is the part of this role that cannot be trained quickly.

Expect scenario questions: a release you owned that went wrong and what you checked before you deployed; a decision you made without complete information; a time your call was wrong and how you found out.

Expect to walk us through code you wrote and defend the design choices in it.

Years of experience will not by itself qualify you here, and fewer years will not by itself disqualify you.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Direct working relationship with the founder and with clients — no layers between your work and the person who benefits from it
* Real AI work on production systems, not pilots that never ship
* Genuine ownership of accounts and of the engineers you develop, with a defined path toward a lead role
* Compensation aligned to the top of the Ahmedabad market for the right person

You will join a team of five in Kolkata and work across the stack, using modern JavaScript frameworks such as React and Angular on the front end, Node.js and PHP services on the back end, relational and NoSQL data stores underneath, and APIs and serverless technologies to connect applications with CRM, marketing technology, content management, and other business platforms. This is a hands-on engineering role with real technical ownership. You will translate business requirements into resilient technical solutions, write production-grade code, deploy through automated pipelines, and mentor less experienced engineers along the way. On a team this size, your work is visible. You will work with a high degree of independence in a fast-paced agile setting and be expected to raise the bar on quality and maintainability across the full software development lifecycle.

Microsoft Azure is strongly preferred , although relevant cloud-native and serverless experience on platforms such as AWS will also be considered. Working DevOps capability, including Git-based workflows, CI/CD pipeline configuration, Docker, and environment and release management. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to pick up unfamiliar platforms, technologies, and codebases quickly. title: Full-Stack Developer (On-site, Mumbai | 2+ Years)
description:
**We're Hiring: Full\-Stack Developer (Mumbai \| 2\+ Years)** 




  





 We're hiring a Full\-Stack Developer at BriskFab.
 



 You'll own BriskFab's products and internal tools – from architecture through deployment. We need someone who can take a product idea from a rough brief to a working, shippable app, write code that holds up when 200 things go wrong at once, and use AI tools as a force\-multiplier rather than a crutch.
 



  





**The Role** 




 This is a full\-time position based in Mumbai. You'll work closely with the core team, take end\-to\-end ownership of deliverables, and get real exposure to modern platforms and AI workflows.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  





**Product \& App Development (70%)** 



* Build full\-stack features end\-to\-end – frontend (React), backend (Node), database, deployment
* Turn a one\-paragraph brief into a working product decision, not just code
* Design for edge cases by default: bad inputs, empty states, race conditions, failed API calls, scale
* Own architecture choices for tools you build – not just execute a spec handed to you
* Ship, monitor, and iterate – you don't disappear after the first deploy
* Figure out what you don't know on the way – new framework, new integration, new platform, no hand\-holding



  





**AI\-Native Build Workflow (30%)** 



* Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) to move fast – but review every line like you wrote it yourself
* Know where AI\-generated code breaks – hallucinated APIs, missed edge cases, silent logic errors – and catch it before it ships
* Prototype quickly using AI for scaffolding, then harden manually for production
* Bring new AI\-assisted dev tools and workflows to the team as they emerge
* Learn and work on Webflow, Framer, or similar modern platforms
* Build landing pages for GTM and outbound campaigns
* Integrate third\-party tools – forms, CRMs, analytics, and tracking pixels
* Experiment with AI\-assisted design and build tools (Relume, Durable, etc.)



  





**What We're Looking For** 




**Must\-Have:** 



* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience building real applications (not just coursework or clones)
* Strong with JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and Node.js – can build a full feature without hand\-holding
* Comfortable with databases (SQL or NoSQL), REST/API design, and deployment (Vercel, Railway, AWS, etc.)
* Actively uses AI coding tools in daily work – and can explain what they double\-check vs. trust
* Demonstrated edge\-case thinking – can describe how they've broken or stress\-tested their own code
* A figure\-it\-out streak – evidence you've picked up a new tool, framework, or platform on your own and shipped with it
* Can show 2–3 real, live, or deployed projects – not just GitHub repos with no users



  





**Good to Have:** 



* Basic product sense – has opinions on UX, not just implementation
* Prior experience in a small team/startup where you owned a feature outright
* Exposure to no\-code/low\-code or modern site builders (Webflow, Framer)



  





**About BriskFab** 




 BriskFab is a GTM advisory and growth execution firm helping B2B tech companies build high\-performance sales and marketing engines. We're a lean, senior team where everyone owns outcomes – not just tasks. If you want a role where your work actually shows up in results, this is it.
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 No cover letter needed. Show us what you've built.
 



 📩 Send your resume \+ 2–3 links to live/deployed projects (not just repos) to careers@briskfab.com
 



 Subject line: Full\-Stack Developer

 No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

 The Full Stack Engineering Department builds the Agoda web and app products.  Staff Engineer is the key role in our technology organization working together with individual contributors and senior leadership. Our Lead engineers are heavily involved in the hiring and mentoring process and are the go\-to people who design and implement new systems and components. * Track record of technical mentorship, cross\-team collaboration, and solving ambiguous, complex problems in fast\-paced environments.
* Strong API and middleware skills: Ability to design and implement APIs and backend services tailored for frontend needs.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with Scala or other JVM languages.
* Exposure to cloud platforms, microservices, and modern DevOps practices.
* Prior work on large\-scale migration or cross\-platform initiatives.

title: Full Stack Developer – Python & Azure
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced
 **Full Stack Developer with strong Python and Microsoft Azure expertise** 
 to join our engineering team building and scaling a
 **PCI DSS v4\.0–ready, microservices\-based order processing platform** 
 . This platform running on a secure, private\-network Azure architecture.
 



 You will work across the full stack — from API design and serverless compute to database design and CI/CD — building secure, cost\-efficient, and highly available services in a regulated, payment\-adjacent environment.
 



**What You'll Work On** 



* Design, build, and maintain
 **Python\-based microservices on Azure Functions** 
 (Python 3\.11/3\.12\) across domains such as order intake, customer management, catalog, orchestration, tax, payment/PCI, fulfillment, notifications, and support APIs.
* Build and secure APIs exposed through
 **Azure API Management (APIM)** 
 — including authentication, throttling, CORS, brand\-scoped RBAC, and correlation\-ID based tracing.
* Work within a
 **Private VNet architecture** 
 , integrating Function Apps, Private Endpoints, NSGs, and NAT Gateway–based outbound connectivity to third\-party partners (payment gateways, tax providers, OMS, email/mail services).
* Design and maintain schemas in a
 **shared Azure SQL Database** 
 using module\-owned table prefixes, optimizing for cost and performance at moderate transaction volume.
* Implement
 **secrets and credential management via Azure Key Vault** 
 using Managed Identity — ensuring no hardcoded credentials anywhere in the platform.
* Build
 **tokenized payment integrations** 
 (e.g., CyberSource/PayPal) ensuring PAN/CVV data never touches application code or storage — token\-only handling.
* Contribute to
 **PCI DSS v4\.0 compliance controls** 
 : network segmentation, encryption in transit/at rest, access logging, audit trails, and secure system design.
* Support
 **queue\- and timer\-triggered async processing** 
 (cron/orchestration patterns) for order lifecycle management with retry logic.
* Collaborate on
 **cost\-optimization decisions** 
 — right\-sizing Function plans (Elastic Premium), SQL tiers, and reserved capacity planning.
* Monitor and troubleshoot production systems using
 **Application Insights, Log Analytics, and Microsoft Defender for Cloud** 
 .
* Partner with stakeholders to translate deployment architecture and solution design into working, well\-tested code.



  





 Requirements
 



**What We're Looking For** 




**Required:** 



* 6–9 years of professional software development experience, with strong full\-stack capability.
* Deep hands\-on experience with
 **Python** 
 (3\.x) for backend/microservice development.
* Solid experience building and deploying on
 **Microsoft Azure** 
 , specifically:
* Azure Functions (serverless compute, VNet integration)
* Azure API Management
* Azure SQL Database
* Azure Key Vault \& Managed Identity
* Azure VNet, NSGs, Private Endpoints, NAT Gateway
* Experience designing
 **RESTful APIs** 
 and microservices architectures.
* Experience with
 **relational database design** 
 (schema design, query optimization, TDE/encryption\-at\-rest concepts).
* Understanding of
 **secure application design** 
 : secrets management, least\-privilege access, RBAC, TLS/encryption in transit.
* Familiarity with
 **asynchronous/queue\-based or timer\-based processing patterns** 
 .
* Experience integrating with
 **third\-party APIs** 
 (payment gateways, tax engines, OMS, email/notification providers, etc.).
* Working knowledge of
 **monitoring/observability tools** 
 (Application Insights, Log Analytics or equivalent).
* Strong understanding of
 **CI/CD pipelines** 
 and cloud deployment practices.



**Preferred / Nice to Have:** 



* Experience working in a
 **PCI DSS–regulated environment** 
 .
* Exposure to
 **e\-commerce order management systems** 
 (Shopify, OMS platforms, or similar).
* Experience with
 **tokenized payment processing** 
 (CyberSource, PayPal, Stripe, or similar gateways).
* Familiarity with
 **Infrastructure as Code** 
 (Bicep, ARM templates, or Terraform on Azure).
* Front\-end development experience (React/Angular/Vue) for full\-stack contributions beyond APIs.
* Experience with
 **cost optimization** 
 on cloud platforms (reserved capacity, right\-sizing).
* Azure certifications (e.g., AZ\-204, AZ\-400, AZ\-305\) are a plus.



**Soft Skills** 



* Strong ownership mindset — comfortable working across the stack from database to API to deployment.
* Ability to work in a security\- and compliance\-conscious environment with attention to detail.
* Clear communicator, able to work with architects and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Comfortable in a fast\-paced environment balancing scalability, security, and cost.

 At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
   

  

 Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
   

  

 No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

 The Full Stack Engineering Department builds the Agoda web and app products. We have several teams in front\-end focusing on different aspects of our products including accommodations, flights, payments, marketing, post\-booking services, and more. Agoda’s marketplace is the world. We build localized and optimized user experiences at scale on every major internet platform. These include our mobile websites, native apps, and desktop sites. We hire people from around the world who have a passion for using technology to create and implement the best user experiences. Our teams work on the full stack and build end\-to\-end systems including user interfaces, APIs, backend systems, and database systems. Our products are always evolving and under experimentation. We accomplish this by having an amazing degree of automation, CI/CD systems, and use a modularized approach. As we are data driven and measure our results, we continually innovate and improve our work. We are looking for the next great talent who strives to learn and grow and has a standard of excellence, strong sense of ownership, and great technical skills.
   

  

**The Opportunity:**
 Staff Engineer is the key role in our technology organization working together with individual contributors and senior leadership. Our Lead engineers are heavily involved in the hiring and mentoring process and are the go\-to people who design and implement new systems and components. We are looking for people who are passionate to take on more responsibility and driving major architectural changes in Agoda. It's expected from you in this role as Staff engineer to push Agoda forward technically by adopting new technologies and setting higher standards.

* Track record of technical mentorship, cross\-team collaboration, and solving ambiguous, complex problems in fast\-paced environments.

We bring together a global team of engineers, architects, designers, researchers and operators united by rigor, accountability and a commitment to delivering measurable results.
