 Our work combines human\-centered design, engineering excellence and AI\-powered capabilities to solve complex challenges with clarity and precision. Innovation, particularly in the responsible application of AI, is embedded in how teams approach problem\-solving and continuous improvement. At Algoworks, growth is continuous and closely tied to impact. Teams collaborate across geographies and disciplines, strengthening outcomes through shared insight and collective expertise. The culture values transparency, open dialogue and an environment where every voice is heard and contribution is recognized.
   

  

 Through collaboration, accountability and a focus on results, Algoworks operates at the intersection of technology and people, building not only advanced systems but strong global teams that elevate performance and create lasting impact. Follow the video below to know about us! Clipchamp.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 This engineer will build and extend the Python services behind AI features endpoints, data access, ingestion and retrieval jobs, and the integration points to foundation model APIs and will also implement the front\-end surfaces for a new AI Playground that ACD engineering will develop for rapid prototyping and experimentation, before implementing it in customer\-facing UI.
   

  

 The work is majority backend; the front\-end capability matters because it means features get delivered whole rather than handed across a seam. This is a delivery role on a small team, working to patterns set by the AI Engineering Lead and senior backend engineer rather than defining architecture. The expectation is steady, tested, production\-ready output with growing independence over the engagement.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build and maintain Python API endpoints and service logic (FastAPI or equivalent) backing AI features, following established patterns for request validation, streaming responses, timeouts, retries, and structured error handling.
* Implement the front\-end features in Angular or React streaming and incremental response rendering, loading and partial\-failure states, and responsive layouts for the AI Playground and customer\-facing UI.
* Write and maintain SQL against relational stores, Python against other NoSQL or object data stores.
* Write automated tests as a normal part of delivery: unit and API tests on the back end, fixture\-based tests for model\-dependent paths, and contributions to regression suites running in CI.
* Add logging, metrics, and tracing to the services and jobs owned so failures and performance regressions are visible without a customer report.
* Fix defects on owned features through to root cause, including issues surfaced in production.
* Collaborate with the AI Engineering Lead, Senior Backend Engineer, Product, and UX in a distributed team, using written updates and asynchronous communication as the default.


**Required Skills And Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of professional software development experience delivering production backend services and web application user interfaces.
* Strong Python for production backend work: REST API development, async basics, testing, and debugging in a real codebase not scripting or notebook\-only experience.
* Hands\-on experience with FastAPI, Flask, Django, or an equivalent Python API framework.
* Working proficiency in a modern front\-end framework Angular or React sufficient to build and modify feature\-level UI independently.
* Angular is preferred, as it is used in ACD's existing platform.
* Comfort with TypeScript/JavaScript and browser fundamentals including async behavior and debugging.
* Solid SQL and relational data modeling: joins, indexing basics, schema changes, and migrations.
* Experience with Git\-based workflows, code review, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong written English and the ability to work effectively with a US\-based team.


**Must Have Skills**
* Strong Python backend development with REST APIs and FastAPI/Flask/Django.
* Hands\-on Angular or React with JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Strong SQL, relational databases, data modeling, and API integration.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, debugging, and production support.


**Desired Attributes**
* Exposure to AI/LLM features, model APIs, RAG/retrieval, or streaming interfaces.
* Knowledge of Azure, Docker, and cloud deployment.
* Experience with background jobs/queues such as Celery.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, ownership, and ability to work with distributed/US\-based teams.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Exposure to AI or LLM\-backed features calling model APIs, prompt handling, retrieval\-backed search, or streaming and conversational interfaces.
* Vector databases or embedding\-based retrieval.
* Azure cloud services, Docker, or exposure to cloud deployment workflows.
* Background job and queue processing (Celery, or equivalent).
* C\# and .NET familiarity, which are core to ACD's existing product platform.
* Accessibility (WCAG) and front\-end performance work.
* Fluency with AI\-assisted development tooling in day\-to\-day work.

 You may currently be a:
 


* Lead Software Engineer
* Lead Full Stack Engineer
* Technical Lead
* Tech Lead
* Senior Software Engineer
* Senior Full Stack Engineer
* Hands\-on Staff Engineer
* Full Stack Technical Lead



 Your current title matters less than the level at which you already operate.
   




 About Script Assist
 
 Script Assist is a UK healthcare technology company providing the software and operating infrastructure behind complex private clinical and pharmacy services.
 



 Our platform connects:
 


* Clinics
* Pharmacies
* Prescribers
* Patients
* Operational teams
* External technology providers



 and supports tens of thousands of structured clinical and pharmacy transactions every month.
 



 The platform includes complex functionality across:
 


* Clinical workflows

* Medication management
* Pharmacy operations
* Inventory
* Dispensing
* Payments
* Subscriptions
* Fulfilment
* Communications
* Reporting
* Permissions
* Integrations
* Customer\-specific configuration
* Operational automation



 Healthcare experience is
 **not required** 
 .
 



 What matters is that you have already built sophisticated software products where many features, workflows, integrations and customer configurations interact with each other.
   




 The engineering problem
 
 Script Assist is not a simple CRUD application.
 



 Different customers may use the same underlying platform in different ways.
 



 A new feature can interact with:
 


* Existing workflows
* Different user roles
* Tenant\-specific configuration
* External integrations
* Payment states
* Operational processes
* Existing customer data
* Historical product decisions



 We need engineers who understand how to extend a mature shared product without creating an unmaintainable collection of exceptions.
 



 You should be comfortable thinking about questions such as:
 


* How should customer\-specific behaviour be represented?
* Should this be configuration or code?
* How should workflows be versioned?
* What happens to processes already in progress?
* How do we prevent duplicate actions when events retry?
* How do we maintain data integrity across several systems?
* How do we change one module without breaking another?
* How do we make increasingly complicated software easier—not harder—to maintain?


 🔧 What you will ownTechnical ownership
 
 You will take responsibility for a substantial product domain.
 



 That will include:
 


* Technical design
* Backend services
* Data models
* React applications
* APIs
* Integrations
* Testing strategy
* Deployment
* Production behaviour
* Technical debt
* Reliability



 You should become the person who can say:

 Hands\-on engineering

 You will:
 


* Write production
 **Node.js / TypeScript** 
 backend code
* Build and review
 **React / TypeScript** 
 applications
* Design APIs and service contracts
* Work directly with databases
* Debug difficult production behaviour
* Refactor problematic areas
* Implement technically difficult functionality
* Review and improve existing architecture



 This is not an architecture\-only role.
 


 Technical leadership
 
 You will:
 


* Lead design discussions
* Break large engineering problems into sensible pieces
* Review important pull requests
* Maintain high coding standards
* Challenge poor abstractions
* Identify hidden dependencies
* Mentor engineers
* Improve testing and release discipline
* Establish reusable patterns
* Help engineers make better technical decisions



 The goal is
 **not** 
 for you to personally write every difficult piece of code.
 



 The goal is for the engineering around you to become better because you are there.
   




 The SaaS experience we care about
 
 We want engineers who have genuinely worked on
 **shared multi\-tenant software products** 
 .
 



 Relevant experience may include:
 


 Multi\-tenancy

* Tenant\-aware data models
* Customer configuration
* Entitlements
* Feature flags

 Complex workflows

 Permissions and governance

 Integrations

 Production complexity

* Kubernetes

 Important
 
 Your

 .
 



 Node used only for:

 will not be enough by itself.
   




 Relevant backgrounds

 **B2B SaaS and enterprise software product companies**

 .

title: Risk Modeling Solutions - Full-stack GenAI - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Risk Modeling Solutions \- Gen AI Lead Engineer**
**Description:**
 The AI Lab is the engineering core of our Risk Modeling Solutions (RMS) team, focused on integrating Gen AI solutions into our risk management framework. The team is responsible for building and deploying practical, high\-impact applications that combine deep quantitative analysis with cutting\-edge AI. These solutions enhance analytical decision\-making, automate complex reporting, and create significant operational efficiencies for the business.
   

  

**The responsibility includes but not limited to the following activities:**
* Architect Agentic Systems: Design and lead the implementation of complex, multi\-agent AI workflows capable of advanced reasoning, planning, and autonomous execution using frameworks like LangGraph, CrewAI, and Google ADK.
* Solution Design \& Development: Translate complex business problems within the risk domain into well\-defined technical requirements, and develop robust, end\-to\-end AI solutions to address them.
* AI Workflow Development: Implement end\-to\-end agentic AI workflows using frameworks like LangGraph, CrewAI, and AutoGen, focusing on reasoning, tool use, and memory.
* LLM Orchestration: Build and optimize retrieval pipelines, memory layers, and tool\-use sequences using frameworks like LangChain.
* Backend \& API Engineering: Develop robust, scalable Python\-based microservices and REST APIs using FastAPI to expose AI capabilities.
* RAG Implementation: Construct and refine Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including document ingestion, embedding, and vector search integration with databases like Azure AI Search or Pinecone.
* Containerization \& Deployment: Package AI services using Docker and deploy them on Kubernetes, contributing to CI/CD pipelines for smooth and reliable releases.
* Observability \& Evaluation: Instrument AI workflows using platforms like Langfuse for tracing and debugging. Implement and maintain evaluation harnesses to ensure model quality and performance.


**Qualifications:**
* 6\+ years of professional experience in a role blending software development and data science/machine learning.
* Expert\-level Python development skills and a proven track record of designing and building scalable backend services and APIs (FastAPI preferred).
* Deep, hands\-on experience designing and building solutions with multiple agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel).
* Extensive experience architecting and optimizing RAG systems and integrating with vector databases (e.g., OpenSearch, Pinecone, Weaviate).
* Proven expertise in designing and deploying containerized (Docker/Kubernetes) AI systems on a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Strong experience implementing MLOps principles, including CI/CD, observability, and evaluation frameworks for LLM\-based systems.
* In\-depth understanding of AI risk, safety, and enterprise governance requirements.
* Strong background in ML, deep learning, and NLP, including Transformer architectures.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience leading the design of LLM evaluation harnesses for automated release validation.
* Deep experience with Langfuse or similar AI observability and tracing platforms.
* Hands\-on expertise with AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, or GCP Vertex AI.
* Knowledge of GraphRAG patterns and advanced multi\-hop retrieval strategies.
* AWS certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect, AI/ML Specialty) or equivalent.
* Background in financial services or another highly regulated industry.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
**Who are we?** 




 We at Epikindifi (Epik) are building a zero\-code platform that lets businesses build their own apps through a simple, intuitive interface. We're disruptive, hardworking, highly adaptable, and constantly evolving.
 



  





**Who would you be?** 




 You're a full\-stack engineer who lives in the MEAN stack and owns features from the Angular front end through to Node.js services and the data layer. You enjoy encoding real business logic in clean code, and you're not afraid to reach for new technologies when they're the right fit.
 



  





**What you get to do in this role** 




  




* Build and maintain internet\-scale applications and services to a high standard of engineering excellence, across the full stack.
* Own features end\-to\-end: scoping, technical design, implementation across front end and back end, testing, and production rollout.
* Independently deliver new integration frameworks, or extend existing ones, to implement features of medium to high complexity.
* Partner with Project Managers across the org on project and release planning.
* Deliver high\-quality, well\-written code that others can quickly understand, support, and maintain.
* Write automated test cases that plug into our Continuous Integration (CI) pipeline.
 
 Work within a Lean\-Agile / Scrum framework to ship features to production predictably.
* Build effective relationships with product management, technical teams, systems operations, and service and support.
* Present and communicate complex ideas and features clearly to a broad audience.



  





**What you should have** 



* 3–5 years in software development, with a minimum of 3\+ years on the MEAN stack.
* Deep understanding of JavaScript, and hands\-on experience with TypeScript.
* Strong command of Node.js and its ecosystem, including Express (or similar frameworks).
* Solid experience with Angular (recent versions) and modern front\-end JavaScript.
* Deep understanding of HTML, CSS, and SCSS.
* Confident with asynchronous programming and how to apply it pragmatically.
* Production experience with MongoDB and MySQL, including data modelling and schema design that maps cleanly to business processes.
* Deep understanding of MongoDB and query optimization.
* Working knowledge of caching mechanisms (Redis).
* **Experience with message queues — ideally RabbitMQ** 
 — and event\-driven patterns (publish/subscribe, work queues, retries, dead\-letter, idempotency).
* Ability to model and apply authorization and permission control across users, systems, and services.
* Ability to serve different data sources and databases to different client platforms (mobile vs desktop) with optimal output.
* Familiarity with building scalable Node.js applications.
* Strong testing discipline — unit and integration — integrated into CI.
* Comfort with Docker and containerized deployment; exposure to a cloud platform (Azure/AWS/GCP) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Fluent with Git\-based workflows (GitLab).



  





**Nice to have** 



* Working experience with Web Components.
* Working experience with React.
* GraphQL.
* **Experience building no\-code / low\-code platforms** 
 or highly configurable, metadata\-driven systems — a strong plus given Epik's zero\-code product.
* Prior work on developer platforms or complex web applications.



  





**What you get** 




 Competitive compensation, generous benefits, and a collaborative, inclusive environment. Individuals strong on aptitude and attitude will get to grow their careers working on advanced technology alongside talented developers, and help shape a product from an early stage.

title: Full stack Engineer
description:
**Overview**
 We’re looking for a Full Stack Developer skilled in building scalable web applications using React / Next.js on the frontend
   

  

 and Python frameworks (Django and FastAPI) on the backend. You’ll work closely with product, design, and DevOps teams
   

  

 to deliver reliable, high\-performing applications hosted on AWS, backed by PostgreSQL and Snowflake. We value
   

  

 developers who leverage modern AI\-assisted development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code to accelerate delivery
   

  

 and maintain code quality.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain full\-stack web applications using React / Next.js on the frontend and Django or


 FastAPI on the backend.
   

  

* Build secure, scalable RESTful and async APIs; integrate with third\-party services as needed.
* Manage PostgreSQL databases with efficient schema design, migrations, and optimized queries.
* Work with Snowflake for data warehousing needs – build and maintain data models, write performant queries, and


 integrate warehouse data into application layers.
   

  

* Translate UI/UX wireframes into responsive, accessible, high\-quality frontend components.
* Implement authentication, authorization, and session management (JWT, OAuth2\).
* Set up and manage AWS infrastructure for deployments, CI/CD pipelines, and horizontal scalability.
* Leverage AI\-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code) to accelerate coding workflows, generate


 boilerplate, write tests, and improve code reviews.
   

  

* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code with comprehensive test coverage.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize performance across the entire stack.


 Technical Skills
   

  

 Frontend
   

  

* React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
* State management (Redux, Context API, Zustand)
* Responsive and accessible UI design principles
* Component\-driven architecture and design systems


 Backend
   

  

* Python (Django / Django REST Framework / FastAPI)
* REST and async API design; WebSocket support
* Authentication and authorization (JWT, OAuth2, session\-based)
* ORM and data modeling (Django ORM, SQLAlchemy, Tortoise ORM)
* Task queues and background processing (Celery, Redis)


 Database \& Data Warehousing
   

  

* PostgreSQL – schema design, migrations, indexing, and performance tuning
* Snowflake – data warehousing, writing optimized SQL queries, managing schemas, stages, and pipes for data


 ingestion
   

  

* Experience connecting application backends to Snowflake using Python connectors (snowflake\-connector\-python,


 SQLAlchemy with Snowflake dialect)
   

  

* Experience with Redis or other caching layers


 Cloud \& DevOps
   

  

* AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, CloudFront, API Gateway)
* Docker and container\-based deployment
* CI/CD with GitHub Actions / AWS CodePipeline
* Basic server and infrastructure management


 AI\-Assisted Development
   

  

* Hands\-on experience with Cursor IDE for AI\-powered code editing, multi\-file refactoring, and inline code generation
* Proficiency in Claude Code (CLI) for agentic coding tasks – scaffolding projects, writing tests, debugging, and


 automating repetitive workflows
   

  

* Ability to write effective prompts and system instructions to get high\-quality outputs from AI coding assistants
* Familiarity with integrating AI tools into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., automated code review, PR summarization)


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 2\+ years of hands\-on full\-stack development experience with React and Python\-based backend frameworks.
* Demonstrated experience using AI\-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) in production


 workflows.
   

  

* Strong understanding of API\-driven architectures, microservices patterns, and cloud\-native environments.
* Excellent problem\-solving, debugging, and cross\-team collaboration skills.
* Familiarity with version control best practices (Git, branching strategies, code reviews).


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience with GraphQL or gRPC.
* Knowledge of serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, Step Functions).
* Contributions to open\-source projects.
* Experience building or consuming AI/ML APIs and LLM\-powered features.
* Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code tools (Terraform, CDK).
* Experience with Snowflake performance tuning, materialized views, and data pipeline orchestration (dbt, Airflow).

title: Staff Software Engineer – Full Stack | Node.js, TypeScript, React | Multi-Tenant B2B SaaS
description:
📍
 **Remote – India** 




**💰 ₹25–50 LPA total CTC, depending on experience and scope** 




**🕒 Full\-time** 




  





**Staff Engineer \| Node.js \| TypeScript \| React \| Multi\-Tenant SaaS \| Software Architecture \| Technical Leadership**



 Shape the architecture. Control the quality. Stay hands\-on.
 
 Script Assist is looking for a hands\-on
 **Staff Software Engineer** 
 with deep production experience in
 **Node.js, TypeScript and React** 
 to help shape the architecture and technical direction of a complex multi\-tenant healthcare SaaS platform.
 



 We are looking for someone who has already worked on a substantial
 **enterprise B2B SaaS product** 
 and understands what happens as that product becomes large:
 


* More modules
* More integrations
* More customer configuration
* More workflow variation
* More roles and permissions
* More historical data
* More dependencies
* More engineers
* More opportunities for seemingly small changes to have unexpected consequences



 You may currently be a:
 


* Staff Software Engineer
* Staff Engineer
* Staff Full Stack Engineer
* Lead Software Engineer
* Principal\-level IC
* Senior Technical Lead
* Experienced Senior Software Engineer already operating beyond your formal title



 This is
 **not** 
 an Engineering Manager position.
 



 It is also not an architect role where you stop working in production code.
 



 You will remain technically hands\-on while influencing the quality and direction of engineering well beyond your own implementation work.
   




 About Script Assist
 
 Script Assist is a UK healthcare technology company providing the technology and operating infrastructure behind complex private clinical and pharmacy services.
 



 Our platform connects clinics, pharmacies, prescribers, patients and operational teams.
 



 It supports substantial functionality across:
 


* Clinical workflows
* Prescribing
* Medication management
* Pharmacy workflows
* Inventory
* Dispensing
* Payments
* Subscriptions
* Fulfilment
* Communications
* Reporting
* Permissions
* Customer configuration
* Third\-party integrations



 The difficult engineering problem is not any one of these features.
 



 It is
 **how they interact** 
 .
 



 A workflow may behave differently depending on:
 


* Customer
* Clinical service
* User role
* Pharmacy
* Medication
* Configuration
* Integration
* Payment status
* Previous actions
* Operational exceptions



 The product therefore needs engineers who can understand local implementation details while simultaneously protecting the coherence of the wider platform.
   




 🧭 Your role
 
 You will take deep technical ownership of a substantial part of Script Assist while helping establish engineering patterns that scale beyond it.
 



 You will move comfortably between:
 


* Architecture
* Product behaviour
* Node.js services
* React applications
* Databases
* Integrations
* Code review
* Production incidents
* Mentoring
* Technical strategy



 You should be able to understand the hardest parts of the codebase without becoming the only person capable of changing them.
   




 Architecture and system design
 
 You will:
 


* Define domain and module boundaries
* Design backend services and APIs
* Define data ownership
* Review database models
* Design integration patterns
* Establish appropriate shared abstractions
* Improve configuration architecture
* Challenge unnecessary coupling
* Reduce fragile customer\-specific behaviour
* Lead important technical migrations
* Help simplify accumulated complexity



 You should understand when to introduce:
 


* Configuration
* Shared services
* Events
* Queues
* Transactions
* APIs
* Feature flags
* Migration layers



 and equally importantly, when
 **not** 
 to introduce them.
   




 Hands\-on engineering
 
 You will remain capable of personally implementing difficult production changes.
 



 That includes:
 


* **Node.js / TypeScript backend development**
* **React / TypeScript frontend development**
* **API design**
* **Database work**
* **Integration development**
* **Debugging**
* **Performance investigation**
* **Refactoring**
* **Testing**
* **Production incident investigation**



 You should still enjoy working directly with code.
   




 Multi\-tenant SaaS complexity
 
 The strongest candidates will have experience with products where many customers share the same platform while behaving differently.
 



 Relevant problems include:
 


 Tenant architecture
 * Tenant isolation
* Tenant\-aware data models
* Customer\-specific configuration
* Organisations and sub\-organisations
* Entitlements
* Feature flags


 Workflow complexity
 * Workflow engines
* State machines
* Rules engines
* Configurable business logic
* Approval flows
* Long\-running workflows
* Versioned workflows
* Exception handling


 Permissions
 * RBAC
* User roles
* Organisation\-level access
* Fine\-grained permissions
* Auditability


 Integrations
 * REST APIs
* GraphQL
* Webhooks
* Public APIs
* External systems
* Background jobs
* Asynchronous processing
* Event\-driven architecture


 Distributed\-system behaviour
 * Idempotency
* Retries
* Partial failures
* Transactions
* Outbox patterns
* Queues
* Dead\-letter handling
* Concurrency
* Reconciliation
* Correlation IDs


 Product evolution
 * Schema changes
* Data migrations
* Backward compatibility
* Safe rollouts
* Feature flags
* Progressive migrations
* Production monitoring
* Incident recovery



 You do not need to have implemented every specific pattern.
 



 We care about whether you have
 **actually solved these kinds of problems** 
 .
   




 Technical leadership
 
 A Staff Engineer at Script Assist should improve the work of other engineers.
 



 You will:
 


* Lead important design reviews
* Review difficult code
* Challenge poor technical decisions
* Establish engineering patterns
* Mentor Senior and mid\-level engineers
* Help engineers decompose complex problems
* Document major technical decisions
* Improve testing strategy
* Improve observability
* Help identify technical debt worth solving
* Resolve architectural disagreements
* Work with Product on technical trade\-offs
* Raise the quality of engineering across your area



 We do not want someone who responds to every difficult problem by saying:
 


 “I'll just build it myself.”
 
 You should be capable of solving the hardest problems while making the people around you increasingly capable of solving them too.
   




 Production ownership
 
 You will take responsibility beyond merge and deployment.
 



 You should care about:
 


* What happened in production
* Whether customers are seeing unexpected behaviour
* Performance
* Errors
* Failed integrations
* Operational recovery
* Logging
* Monitoring
* Reconciliation
* Incident prevention



 A major production incident should result not merely in a patch, but in a better system afterwards.
   




 Essential technical background
 
 We need substantial recent production experience with:
 


* **Node.js**
* **TypeScript**
* **React / React.js**
* **Backend systems**
* **API design**
* **Databases**
* **Distributed applications**
* **Automated testing**
* **Git**
* **Docker**
* **CI/CD**
* **Cloud environments**
* **Production observability**



 Particularly relevant:
 


* NestJS
* Express
* Fastify
* PostgreSQL
* MongoDB
* Redis
* GraphQL
* Kafka
* RabbitMQ
* SQS
* Kubernetes
* AWS / Azure / GCP
* Integration testing
* Event\-driven systems



 One particular database, message broker or cloud provider is
 **not** 
 mandatory.
 


 Node.js requirement
 
 We need genuine
 **backend Node.js ownership** 
 .
 



 Experience limited to:
 


* Front\-end build tooling
* Server\-side rendering
* Simple proxy services
* Thin BFF layers



 is insufficient unless you also have substantial Node.js backend experience elsewhere.
   




 Relevant product backgrounds
 
 The most interesting candidates will often come from mature enterprise SaaS products involving:
 


* Workflow management
* Automation
* CRM
* Identity
* Permissions
* Governance
* APIs
* Developer platforms
* Operational systems
* Enterprise configuration



 Potentially relevant engineering environments include:
 


* Okta / Auth0
* Blue Yonder / JDA Software
* Freshworks
* Diligent
* Postman
* LeadSquared
* Comparable enterprise SaaS businesses



 These are examples only.
 



 We assess
 **your actual product ownership** 
 , not your employer's brand.
   




 How you should think
 
 We are interested in engineers who ask questions such as:
 


* What is the real domain boundary here?
* Is this customer\-specific or product behaviour?
* Should this become configuration?
* What happens to existing tenants?
* What happens to workflows already underway?
* What happens if the event arrives twice?
* How do we recover from partial failure?
* How do we prove this migration is safe?
* How will another engineer understand this in two years?
* How do we make this simpler rather than merely making it work?



 That style of reasoning matters enormously.
   




 Communication and judgement
 
 You will work directly with senior Product and Engineering colleagues across the UK and India.
 



 You should be able to:
 


* Explain difficult technical concepts clearly
* Challenge assumptions constructively
* Defend technical decisions with evidence
* Understand commercial/product constraints
* Avoid overengineering
* Make pragmatic trade\-offs
* Communicate clearly in written English
* Mentor without patronising or micromanaging


 Experience
 
 We expect strong candidates will typically have approximately
 **8–14\+ years of software engineering experience** 
 .
 



 However, Staff\-level scope matters more than calendar years.
 



 You do not necessarily need to hold a Staff title today.
 



 A Lead or exceptional Senior engineer who is already:
 


* Leading architecture
* Influencing several engineers
* Reviewing critical work
* Owning production behaviour
* Taking responsibility beyond individual features



 can absolutely be relevant.
   




 📈 Why join Script Assist?
 
 At a very large organisation, a Staff Engineer may own one layer or one subsystem of a much bigger machine.
 



 At Script Assist, you can have meaningful influence across a significant part of the product.
 



 You will help determine:
 


* How major areas are designed
* How the platform handles customer variation
* How engineers structure new functionality
* How code quality is maintained
* How technical debt is reduced
* How production issues are prevented
* How engineering scales as the company grows



 You will remain hands\-on.
 



 But the objective is not simply to become the person who can write the most difficult code.
 


* The objective is to make a substantial part of the platform — and the engineers responsible for it —
 **better because of your technical leadership** 
 .

title: Software Engineer-Full Stack Software Engineer (Java + Angular)
description:
**Company Overview**
 At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close\-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
   

  

**Department Overview**
 Software Engineering
   

  

**Job Description**
**We are looking for a highly skilled Full Stack Software Engineer to join our dynamic engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable enterprise web applications. The ideal candidate will have strong backend expertise in Java and Spring Boot, paired with robust front\-end development skills using Angular. You will collaborate closely with product, design, and QA teams in an Agile environment to deliver high\-quality, high\-performance software solutions.**
****Key Responsibilities****
* Full Stack Development: Design, code, test, and deploy responsive web applications using Java, Spring Boot, and Angular.
* Backend Engineering: Build and maintain scalable RESTful APIs and microservices using Spring Boot and related Java frameworks.
* Frontend Engineering: Develop dynamic, user\-friendly, and highly responsive UI components using modern Angular versions, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3/SASS.
* Database Management: Design database schemas, write optimized SQL queries, and manage data using relational (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) or NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB).
* Code Quality \& Testing: Write clean, maintainable code following SOLID principles. Implement unit and integration tests using JUnit/Mockito for the backend and Jasmine/Karma/Jest for the frontend.
* Collaboration: Participate actively in Agile/Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, retrospectives) and work closely with cross\-functional teams to define and ship new features.
* Optimization: Identify performance bottlenecks, debug complex issues, and optimize applications for speed, security, and scalability.
* Peer Review: Participate in code reviews to ensure coding standards, security, and best practices are maintained across the team.


**Preferred Qualifications (Nice To Have)**
* Experience deploying applications on Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Hands\-on experience with containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
* Exposure to integrating AI capabilities (such as OpenAI/LLMs) into enterprise applications.


 Basic Requirements
   

  

**Required Technical Skills**
* Backend: 3–6 years of strong hands\-on experience with Core Java (Java 8 or higher), OOP concepts, Collections, and Multithreading. Extensive experience with the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security).
* Frontend: Solid experience building SPAs (Single Page Applications) with Angular (v8 or higher). Proficiency in TypeScript, RxJS, and state management patterns (e.g., NgRx).
* Architecture: Deep understanding of microservices architecture and web service integration (REST/JSON).
* Version Control \& Tools: Strong proficiency with Git (GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket) and build tools like Maven or Gradle.
* Methodology: Proven experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.


 Travel Requirements
   

  

 Under 10%
   

  

 Relocation Provided
   

  

 None
   

  

 Position Type
   

  

 Experienced
   

  

 Referral Payment Plan
   

  

 Yes
   

  

***EEO Statement***
 Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally\-protected characteristic.
   

  

 We are proud of our people\-first and community\-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

title: Senior Software Engineer (3 - 6 years of experience in Java full-stack development, Angular / React, GenAI)
description:
**About Us**
 Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
   

  

 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
   

  

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be part of our development team to help design, enhance and build our HR platform in an agile development environment, you will work independently with minimal insight to develop software that conforms to Visa’s high standards. As part of this self\-driven team, you will have total ownership of the solutions we provide for our HR customers making availability, performance, security, and reliability critical to our success. You will work with colleagues, who will support and challenge you daily. You will play part of multiple teams tasked with multiple projects. **Full Stack Engineer (MEAN Stack)**
**About The Role**
 You''''ll be the person who builds the machinery behind our platform. Here that means the product our clients run their business on: the dashboard they use to configure their AI agents, the inbox where conversations land, the CRM that turns a conversation into a lead. It also means everything underneath it: the APIs, the real\-time services, the integrations, and the data models that hold it all together.
   

  

 This is not a feature\-ticket role. It''''s a build\-and\-own role. You''''ll own features end to end, from the database schema to the screen a client uses to change their agent''''s greeting. When something breaks, slows down, or silently fails in production, you''''re the one who finds out why — and fixes it.
   

  

**What You''ll Do**
 Platform \& full\-stack product
   

  

* Build the core product: agent configuration (tasks, behaviour, guardrails, AI config), conversation logs and history, analytics, and bulk campaign controls.
* Design and ship the Node.js/Express services and APIs — orchestration, queueing, webhooks, retries, file and data storage — that hold up as usage grows.
* Wire the platform together: CRM contacts and tickets, WhatsApp messaging and follow\-ups, calendar and booking integrations, Google Sheets and Meta lead\-form ingestion.
* Ship clean, usable Angular frontends for our team and for clients — the agent configurator, the inbox, the review and reporting screens.


 Real\-time systems \& integrations
   

  

* Build and harden real\-time features: live inbox updates, notifications, streaming data, and event\-driven workflows.
* Integrate third\-party APIs and providers — messaging, CRM, calendars, LLM providers — and handle their quirks, rate limits, and outages gracefully.
* Implement non\-blocking background jobs and integrations — lookups, bookings, CRM writes — so the product stays fast and never loses data.
* Evaluate tools, libraries, and providers, and help decide what we build on next.


 Reliability, cost \& scale
   

  

* Instrument everything: API latency, error rates, queue backlogs, integration failures, infra cost. Build the dashboards that tell us something''''s wrong before a client does.
* Bring down infra and third\-party costs without hurting quality — query optimisation, caching, smarter provider usage.
* Debug production incidents on live client accounts, reproduce them, and fix them at the root.


 Working with the team
   

  

* Pair with the prompt engineer and customer success on what the platform needs for agents and clients to succeed — new integrations, better fallbacks, better internal tooling.
* Turn what you learn from client deployments into reusable platform capability, so the next client takes hours to onboard, not days.


 Roughly 80% of your time is hands\-on engineering: writing code across the stack, debugging production issues, shipping. The other 20% is with the team and occasionally clients — understanding what''s breaking in the field and deciding what the platform should do about it.
   

  

**What We''re Looking For**
 Two things are non\-negotiable. Please apply only if you meet both — they''re the first thing we screen for.
   

  

* \*\* You''ve shipped production applications on the MEAN stack.\*\* Not a tutorial project, not a hackathon — a system real users depended on, built with MongoDB, Express, Angular, and Node.js, where you owned significant parts of it and kept it running.
* \*\* You''re a full\-stack engineer who can build the whole thing.\*\* Backend services, APIs, real\-time transport, databases, and a frontend a client can use without a walkthrough. You don''t need a separate team to ship a feature end to end.


 Beyond that, we don''t care much about degrees or years. We care that you can:
   

  

* Go deep in every layer of the MEAN stack, not just use it — with TypeScript throughout.
* Build and debug real\-time systems: WebSockets, event\-driven architectures, queues.
* Integrate with third\-party APIs and messaging platforms (WhatsApp Business API, CRMs, payment gateways) and handle their quirks in production.
* Design MongoDB data models and APIs for a multi\-tenant SaaS: contacts, conversations, tickets, workflows, role\-based access.
* Measure and profile before you optimise, write code others can read, and document what you built.


 Nice to have: experience with LLM APIs and tool/function calling, real\-time voice or telephony (OpenAI Realtime, LiveKit, Pipecat, SIP providers, or similar) GCP/AWS at scale.

description:
**About 4flow**
===============


4flow is a global leader in logistics optimization, with a team of over 1,500 professionals across more than 20 locations worldwide. Our unique business model integrates supply chain consulting, advanced logistics software, 4PL services, and cutting\-edge logistics research to deliver innovative and end\-to\-end solutions.


Our Bangalore office, located in Manyata Tech Park, is one of our newest and most dynamic hubs. Here, we are building a next\-generation, AI\-driven supply chain product from the ground up. Operating in a hybrid work model, this location offers a unique opportunity to join the development team at an early stage and play a key role in shaping the future of our product and technology landscape.

**Job description**
===================


We’re looking for a full\-stack engineer who enjoys solving real product problems—not just executing pre\-defined tasks. You’ll work in a cross\-functional team alongside Product Managers, UX designers, domain experts, and engineers, contributing early to problem framing, solution shaping, and trade\-off decisions in a Shape\-Up\-inspired environment.


This is a hands\-on role where you’ll design, build, test, deploy, and operate software across the full stack. You’ll take ownership from idea to production, working across application code, cloud infrastructure, and deployment pipelines.


The role suits someone who thrives in ambiguity, values autonomy, and is motivated to drive meaningful outcomes rather than simply completing assigned work.

**What your new challenge will look like**
==========================================

* Design, build, and deliver end\-to\-end product features spanning both frontend and backend systems.
* Collaborate closely with Product, UX, and domain experts to deeply understand challenges, explore options, and provide thoughtful, insight\-driven recommendations rather than rushing into solutions.
* Define technical approaches, assess trade\-offs, and make practical, well\-reasoned architectural decisions.
* Take full ownership of features from development through testing, deployment, monitoring, production support, and ongoing enhancements.
* Work hands\-on with cloud platforms, deployment pipelines, and operational tools as an integral part of the development lifecycle.

**Why you belong at 4flow**
===========================

* You bring 7\+ years of professional experience in software engineering.
* You have strong expertise across frontend, backend, and deployment technologies, and enjoy working across the full delivery lifecycle.
* You’ve built modern web applications and distributed backend systems at scale.
* You have hands\-on experience with AWS or similar cloud platforms.
* You’re familiar with infrastructure as code, ideally using Terraform or comparable tools.
* You have experience with CI/CD practices, deployment pipelines, and operating software in production environments.

**What we offer**
=================

* A stable role within a company rooted in strong German roots, backed by a clear vision and long\-term security.
* A dynamic, international work environment with excellent opportunities for rapid career growth.
* Extensive professional development support, including a dedicated training budget and access to internal learning programs.
* A permanent position with a competitive base salary, attractive bonus structure, and comprehensive benefits package.
* Hybrid work model
* Access to an Employee Assistance Program to support your mental well\-being.
* Regular sports activities, team events, and company getaways that foster connection and collaboration.
* Complimentary lunch, beverages, and coffee at all 4flow locations.
* Comprehensive health insurance coverage, including GMC, GPA, GTL, and OPD.

* Drive solution, and support business development efforts including proposals, presentations, and client workshops.

 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits**

**How to Apply:**

 A Senior Full Stack Developer is a key player in our software development process, responsible for designing, 
 implementing, and maintaining web and mobile applications across the full stack. We are seeking a highly skilled 
 Senior Full Stack Developer to join our dynamic and collaborative team. The ideal candidate has strong expertise 
 in front-end development with ReactJS, Next.js, TypeScript, and responsive CSS, along with hands-on 
 experience building cross-platform mobile apps in React Native (Expo). On the back end, they are proficient in 
 Node.js and TypeScript, and can design, develop, and deploy scalable, efficient services on AWS using both 
 containers (ECS Fargate) and serverless (AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB), backed by PostgreSQL 
 for relational data. 
 Responsibilities 
 Full Stack Development 
 
 
 Lead end-to-end development of web and mobile applications, from concept to deployment. 
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and deliver high-quality 
 solutions. 
 
 Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including planning, development, testing, and 
 deployment. 
 
 
 Troubleshoot and debug issues across the entire stack to ensure smooth functionality. 
 Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies to suggest improvements and innovations.. 
 Front-end Development 
 
 
 Develop and maintain user interfaces using ReactJS, Next.js, and TypeScript. 
 Build and maintain cross-platform mobile screens with React Native (Expo), sharing types and logic with 
 the web app. 
 
 Implement responsive CSS (Tailwind / NativeWind) to ensure an optimal experience across devices and 
 screen sizes. 
 
 
 Apply modern state management (React Query / Context / Redux) in complex applications. 
 Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement design specifications and enhance user interactions. 
 Back-end Development 
 
 
 Design, implement, and maintain scalable, efficient server-side services in Node.js and TypeScript. 
 Design, develop, and deploy services on AWS using both containers (ECS Fargate) and serverless (AWS 
 Lambda, API Gateway). 
 
 
 
 
 
 Model relational schemas in PostgreSQL and design DynamoDB access patterns; own migrations and 
 data integrity.

 About the Company Our client is a global technology consulting and engineering firm with delivery hubs in Canada and India, working as one global, local team. They partner with organizations across finance, insurance, utilities, technology, and the not-for-profit sector on cloud modernization, custom application development, data engineering, applied AI, and managed services. 
 They are a Certified Great Place to Work. Every engagement is led end-to-end by senior architects and technical leads, and the India engineering team works directly with the Canadian team rather than at arm's length. 
 About the Role We are looking for a Full Stack Developer (Intermediate/Senior) to design and build cloud-native applications and integrations that sit at the centre of client digital ecosystems. You will join a team of five in Kolkata and work across the stack, using modern JavaScript frameworks such as React and Angular on the front end, Node.js and PHP services on the back end, relational and NoSQL data stores underneath, and APIs and serverless technologies to connect applications with CRM, marketing technology, content management, and other business platforms. This is a hands-on engineering role with real technical ownership. You will translate business requirements into resilient technical solutions, write production-grade code, deploy through automated pipelines, and mentor less experienced engineers along the way. On a team this size, your work is visible. You will work with a high degree of independence in a fast-paced agile setting and be expected to raise the bar on quality and maintainability across the full software development lifecycle. 
 Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain full stack web applications using technologies such as React, Angular, Node.js, Next.js, NestJS, PHP, serverless functions, CRM and marketing technology platforms, and WordPress. Build and consume secure, well-documented RESTful APIs and lead integrations between custom applications and third-party platforms. Develop and support integrations with CRM, marketing automation, customer communications, and other business platforms. This may include HubSpot or comparable platforms, using APIs, webhooks, workflows, custom objects, serverless functions, and other integration patterns to connect customer and marketing data with business applications. Design and build serverless and event-driven solutions to support application workflows, integrations, automation, and data movement between systems. Model, query, and optimize data across relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQL Server and NoSQL stores such as MongoDB, DynamoDB, and Cosmos DB, including schema design, indexing, and migrations. Architect and deploy cloud-native solutions, with a strong preference for Microsoft Azure and services such as Azure Functions, API Management, Blob Storage, managed databases, and containerized workloads. Own CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or comparable tools, containerize services with Docker, and contribute to infrastructure automation and environment management. Work with product managers, designers, architects, and QA engineers to turn requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria into technical designs and delivery estimates. Write unit and integration tests, participate in code reviews, and uphold engineering standards for security, performance, scalability, and maintainability. Troubleshoot and resolve production issues and contribute to monitoring, logging, and observability practices that reduce mean time to resolution. Participate in all agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, and retrospectives. Mentor less experienced developers and contribute to engineering standards and continuous improvement across the team. 
 Required Skills & Experience Minimum 5 years of hands-on professional full stack development experience , including ownership of features from design through production release. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related technical field from an accredited university. Strong knowledge of Linux and Ubuntu environments . This is a working requirement of the role, and a Windows-only background will not be a fit. Strong backend engineering experience with Node.js frameworks and PHP frameworks , including modular architecture, authentication and authorization, API design, and third-party integrations. Production experience building modern front ends with React and/or Angular , with the ability to work confidently across modern JavaScript and TypeScript applications. Hands-on experience integrating CRM, marketing automation, customer communications, MarTech, or comparable business platforms . HubSpot experience is valuable but is not mandatory . Candidates with comparable platform experience or strong serverless and API integration experience will also be considered. Strong experience designing and building integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, workflows, serverless functions, event-driven services, or similar integration patterns . Solid database skills across at least one relational and one NoSQL platform, including query optimization and data modelling for transactional applications. Practical experience designing, deploying, and operating cloud-based workloads. Microsoft Azure is strongly preferred , although relevant cloud-native and serverless experience on platforms such as AWS will also be considered. Working DevOps capability, including Git-based workflows, CI/CD pipeline configuration, Docker, and environment and release management. Proven delivery experience in an agile environment alongside cross-functional teams. A self-starter with a strong sense of ownership who can drive work forward with minimal supervision. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to pick up unfamiliar platforms, technologies, and codebases quickly. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. 
 Nice to Have Hands-on HubSpot development , including HubSpot APIs, private apps, custom objects, workflows, webhooks, CMS, or HubSpot integrations. Experience with other CRM, marketing automation, MarTech, or customer communications platforms . Background in startups or product-based companies. Experience with Azure Functions, AWS Lambda, or other serverless technologies . Infrastructure as code using Terraform or Bicep. Test automation with Jest, Playwright, or Cypress. Exposure to data engineering pipelines, ETL, analytics, or BI tooling. Experience applying AI or LLM-based capabilities in production applications. Azure, HubSpot, or other relevant technical certifications. Familiarity with secure coding practices, including OWASP Top 10. Consulting or professional services experience working directly with clients across concurrent engagements. Understanding of enterprise SDLC and delivery governance. 
 What We Offer Senior-level technical mentorship on every engagement, with clear paths toward lead and architect roles. Varied, high-impact work across industries, including modernization programs, greenfield builds, integrations, cloud-native development, and applied AI initiatives. Direct collaboration with our Canada-based team, not siloed offshore delivery. A collaborative, globally local team culture recognized through our Great Place to Work certification. Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and support for professional development and certification. 
 Location This is an on-site position in Kolkata, West Bengal, 5 days per week . Candidates must currently be based in Kolkata or be willing and able to relocate. **Application Engineering Senior Developer – .NET Full Stack \& Integrations**

  


**Application Engineer Lead**

  


**Job Summary:**



The Application Engineering Lead is responsible for designing, building, and owning complex full stack applications and enterprise integrations. This role requires deep technical expertise across .NET, API integrations, databases, and data pipelines, along with strong ownership of production systems, migration activities, and critical cutovers. The role operates with minimal supervision and serves as a key technical decision maker and escalation point.

  


**Roles \& Responsibilities**


**Application Development \& Integrations**


* Lead the design and implementation of **API integrations** using **REST, JSON**, and industry standard authentication mechanisms (OAuth2, JWT, API keys, etc.).
* Lead the design and Implementation of Front end applications using Angular/HTML/Typescript
* Build and maintain **robust, secure, and scalable integrations** with structured error handling, logging, and retry mechanisms.
* Design and implement **reverse and batch integrations** across internal and external systems.
* Act as the **technical authority** for complex integration patterns, data flows, and migration solutions.


**Database \& Data Engineering**


* Design and develop **SQL Server solutions**, including complex queries, stored procedures, performance tuning, and indexing strategies.
* Perform **production data fixes** with strong governance, validation, and audit controls.
* Implement and manage **ETL and data pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF) and/or SSIS**.
* Handle **large scale, high volume data processing**, ensuring data accuracy, reconciliation, and integrity across systems.


**Production Ownership \& Reliability**


* Own **end to end accountability** for critical production systems and integrations.
* Lead **production issue triage, root cause analysis, and remediation,** maintaining composure and sound judgment during high severity incidents.
* Serve as a **trusted escalation point** during production issues, migration waves, and release cutovers.
* Ensure system stability, observability, and operational readiness across environments.


**Leadership \& Stakeholder Management**


* Operate independently with **minimal guidance**, making informed technical and delivery decisions.
* Act as a **subject matter expert (SME)** for integration and migration initiatives.
* Collaborate effectively with **business stakeholders, architects, and delivery teams** to translate requirements into technical solutions.
* Coordinate across multiple teams during migrations and production cutovers, ensuring aligned execution and clear communication.
* Mentor and guide engineers on integration patterns, coding standards, and operational best practices.

  


**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**


**Frontend \& UI Engineering (Angular)**


* **Strong hands on experience with Angular (version 20\+) for enterprise grade web applications.**
* **Expertise in TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6\+).**
* **Experience designing and implementing component based architectures, reusable modules, and shared UI libraries.**
* **Strong understanding of Angular lifecycle hooks, dependency injection, routing, and state management.**
* **Experience with RxJS and reactive programming, including observables, subjects, and subscription management.**
* **Ability to consume and integrate REST APIs into Angular applications with proper error handling and retry logic.**
* **Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms on the UI (token handling, role based access, guards).**
* **Proficiency in frontend performance optimization, change detection strategies, and lazy loading.**
* **Familiarity with responsive design and enterprise UI standards.**
* **Experience troubleshooting and resolving production UI issues with minimal supervision.**


**Core Technology Stack**


* Strong hands on experience with **.NET / .NET Core,** C\#, and full stack application development.
* Extensive experience with **RESTful API design and integration**, including:
	+ JSON payloads and schema validation
	+ Authentication and authorization mechanisms
	+ Structured error handling and resiliency patterns

**Databases \& Data Processing**


* Advanced expertise in **SQL Server**, including:
	+ Complex query design
	+ Stored procedures and performance optimization
	+ Controlled production data fixes
* Strong understanding of **data reconciliation, validation, and high volume data handling.**


**ETL \& Integration Platforms**


* Hands on experience with **Azure Data Factory (ADF)** and/or **SSIS**.
* Knowledge of batch processing, scheduling, and dependency management.
* Experience designing **scalable data pipelines** for enterprise integrations.

  


**Supervision Responsibilities:**


* Direct reports
* Working relationships (daily) with EY ITSD and AMS Lead
* Working relationships (daily) with TCS AMS team
* Liaison to the Business for that Portfolio / App

  


**Job Requirements:**


**Experience:**


* 6\+ years of experience in **application engineering / full stack development,** with significant exposure to enterprise integrations.
* Prior experience in **lead or senior technical roles** with ownership of production systems.
* Experience supporting **large migrations, platform transitions, or enterprise cutovers** is highly desirable.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

title: Full stack AI Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 About the job What you’ll actually do Build real things. You’ll write production code across the full stack — React frontends, Python/Node backends, ClickHouse queries, Kafka event pipelines, LangGraph agent workflows, and YAML\-driven process definitions. Not prototypes. Not demos. Stuff that runs in production for real companies moving real cargo across real oceans. Talk to enterprise clients. You’ll sit across from logistics managers, freight forwarders, and operations leads. You’ll listen to their messy, exception\-filled processes — 6 approval levels, 4 document types, 3 systems that don’t talk to each other — and turn that chaos into structured workflows they can actually use. This isn’t optional. It’s the job. Think AI\-first. Every problem you encounter, your first question should be: “Can an agent handle this?” Not “let me build a CRUD app.” You’ll design agents that extract fields from Bills of Lading, validate invoices against purchase orders, auto\-route approvals based on business rules, and flag exceptions before humans even notice them. You’ll work with LLMs, RAG pipelines, document parsers, and agent orchestration frameworks daily. Own problems end\-to\-end. You won’t hand off a spec and wait. You’ll identify the problem, design the solution, build it, configure it for the client, deploy it, watch it in production, and fix what breaks. The FDE model means you own outcomes, not tasks. The tech you’ll work with Frontend: React, React Flow (node\-based graph editors) Backend: Python, Node.js, FastAPI Data: ClickHouse, Kafka (event streaming), Debezium (CDC) AI/ML: LangGraph (agent orchestration), LLMs (prompt engineering, RAG, tool use), DPT\-2 (document extraction), PageIndex (long\-document reasoning), Weaviate (vector search) Permissions: OpenFGA (Zanzibar\-based relationship access control) Observability: Langfuse (LLM tracing), OpenTelemetry Cost control: LiteLLM (gateway \+ budgets), Orkestra (model routing) Infrastructure: dbt (semantic layer / MetricFlow), Temporal (scheduling), DataHub / OpenMetadata (catalog) You don’t need to know all of this on day one. You need to be the kind of person who can pick up any of it in a week. What we’re looking for The non\-negotiables You can code. Full\-stack, independently, at production quality. You’ve built things — not just assignments, but projects, tools, systems that other people actually used. You’re comfortable across the stack and you don’t need hand\-holding to ship a feature. You can communicate. You can explain a technical architecture to a non\-technical client. You can run a discovery call. You can write a clear document. You can present without slides being your crutch. This is not a “nice to have.” Half the job is translating between the worlds of technology and business. You can think. When someone describes a messy process, you don’t just nod — you ask why before how. You spot patterns underneath apparent chaos. You push back on unnecessary complexity. You can hold a system in your head and reason about what happens when things go wrong. You learn fast. You don’t need to know logistics. You need to be the kind of person who, after two client calls and a week of reading, can hold their own in a conversation about Bills of Lading, demurrage charges, and incoterm implications. Domain knowledge is teachable. Curiosity and raw learning speed are not. Strong signals You’ve built something with LLMs — not just used ChatGPT, but actually integrated an LLM into a working system. Prompt engineering, tool use, agents, RAG — any of it. You’ve worked on a side project or open\-source contribution that required you to understand a domain outside of CS. You can take a vague, messy brief and turn it into a structured plan without needing everything spelled out. You default to shipping over perfecting. You’d rather build a rough working version in 2 hours than spend 2 days on a flawless spec. You’ve done consulting, client\-facing work, or been in a situation where you had to understand someone else’s world to solve their problem. What this role is NOT It’s not a pure backend/frontend engineering job where you write code in isolation. It’s not a PM role where you make decks and write tickets but never ship code. It’s not a consulting gig where you give advice but don’t build. It’s not a support role where you configure existing products without understanding the architecture. \* About GoComet GoComet is a supply chain visibility and automation platform used by enterprises across 30\+ countries. We track shipments across ocean, air, road, and rail. We manage procurement, contracts, invoices, and compliance. And now, with Nova, we’re building the AI\-native operating layer that ties it all together. Logistics moves $12 trillion in goods every year. Most of it still runs on spreadsheets, email chains, and phone calls. We’re fixing that — not with another dashboard, but with intelligent, governed, agent\-driven automation.

title: Member of Technical Staff - Fullstack
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3\.7 billion in revenue, its first billion\-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27\. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology \- hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.
   

  

 This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 Join the Pipeline Engineering team at Everpure™ as a Full Stack Software Engineer to build and scale the pipeline visibility layer for FlashArray, FlashBlade, and Hyperscale — the core platform through which engineers and customers understand and act on CI results. In this high\-impact position, you will own responsive web interfaces, API gateway architecture, and AI\-assisted workflows that convert raw pipeline data into actionable signal, eliminating operational toil across our engineering organization.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Build the Pipeline Visibility Layer: Architect and ship high\-performance web applications using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks to deliver real\-time pipeline status, test results, and failure analytics at enterprise scale.
* Own Gateway \& Backend Services: Develop and operate low\-latency API gateways and backend microservices using typed systems languages (such as Go or Rust) to aggregate data across systems, enforce strict multi\-tenant boundaries, and maintain reliable system contracts.
* Deliver Secure Access Controls: Implement robust authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth2/OIDC, SSO, RBAC) to ensure internal teams and external customers experience seamlessly scoped and fully audited access.
* Integrate AI Triage Workflows: Engineer retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and LLM integrations over test metadata and failure logs to automate root\-cause summaries, flake classification, and developer triage.
* Drive Observability \& Systems Ownership: Instrument end\-to\-end frontend and backend telemetry to continuously improve time\-to\-insight, API latency, and UI performance while directly operating services in production.


**What You Bring**
* Frontend Architecture: Deep technical mastery of JavaScript/TypeScript and modern web frameworks (React.js or Vue.js), including state management, component architecture, and web performance optimization.
* Backend Systems \& API Design: Strong proficiency in a typed systems language (Go or Rust) alongside Python for service orchestration, paired with proven experience designing resilient REST or GraphQL APIs, concurrency patterns, and idempotent workflows.
* Identity \& Security Engineering: Solid expertise implementing secure, multi\-tenant authentication patterns (OIDC, OAuth2, SAML/SSO) and role\-based access control systems.
* AI \& Retrieval Systems: Applied experience designing prompt workflows, integrating vector databases, and implementing RAG patterns using LLM APIs to surface contextual data.
* Infrastructure \& Data Foundations: Practical experience containerizing production workloads with Kubernetes, debugging complex Linux environments, and querying distributed data stores to drive performance outcomes.


**Location Requirements:** 
 We are primarily an in\-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bangalore office in compliance with Everpure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.
   

  

**What You Can Expect From Us**
* Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
* Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
* Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.


 And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company\-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.
   

  

**Accommodations And Accessibility**
 Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA\-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.
   

  

**Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team**
 We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.
   

  

 Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.
   

  

**Join us and bring your best.**
**Bring your bold.**
**Pure and simple.**

title: Workflow Engineer
description:
**About the Company** 




**Join the Rocketship 🚀** 




 We’re building
 **ShopOS** 
 —
 **AI agents powering the entire ecommerce stack.** 
 Already past PMF, we’re scaling fast and shaping the future of how online brands are built with AI. Co\-founded by seasoned builders with multiple successful exits to companies like
 **Flipkart** 
 and
 **Polygon Labs** 
 — and
 **backed by Binny Bansal** 
 — this isn’t just another start\-up. It’s your
 **front\-row seat to the next big shift in ecommerce.** 




  





**Watch** 
 :
 **What is ShopOS (from the founders’ lens \- Click here)** 




  





**About the Role** 




 As a Workflow Engineer at ShopOS, you'll be responsible for building the backbone of automation that powers our AI\-native commerce stack — and then owning it. That means designing and implementing modular, node\-based workflow systems that integrate across catalog management, creative tools, personalization engines, and fulfillment systems, but it also means being the person who fixes them when they break, upgrades them as we scale, and documents them well enough that anyone on the team can pick them up.
 



 This role is for engineers who enjoy solving complex logic puzzles, who think in flows and systems rather than one\-off deliverables, and who want to make things smarter, faster, and more reliable — not just build them once and move on. You'll work closely with product, AI, and design teams to turn business rules into reusable, low\-code/no\-code automations that deliver outsized leverage to our users.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 



* Build node\-based, rule\-driven workflows that support eCommerce operations and AI agent interactions
* Develop modular workflow components that can be composed into reusable, logic\-driven flows
* Integrate with APIs, data systems, and 3rd\-party services (Shopify, Stripe, Zapier, etc.)
* Diagnose and fix bugs in live workflows — including ones you didn't originally build
* Upgrade and refactor existing workflows for better reliability, speed, and cost
* Audit workflows on a regular cadence — flag fragile, redundant, or failure\-prone flows before they cause problems
* Maintain clear documentation for every workflow: what it does, what it depends on, what breaks it, how to fix it
* Set up admin interfaces and audit tools to monitor workflow health and performance
* Partner with product managers and designers to make workflows intuitive, testable, and transparent to end\-users
* Collaborate with AI/ML engineers to embed intelligence into decision points
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of key internal or external workflows (e.g. onboarding, content pipelines, personalization loops)
* Bring creative, non\-obvious solutions to recurring operational problems — not just the standard fix



**What We're Looking For** 



* CS background, with solid coding fundamentals
* Proficient in JavaScript and TypeScript
* Comfortable with Python for scripting and automation logic
* Hands\-on experience with node\-based / visual workflow builders (we currently run on Make; familiarity with n8n, Zapier, or similar counts too)
* Familiarity with Figma, Weavy, and ComfyUI
* Thinks in frameworks and systems rather than one\-off deliverables
* Strong debugging discipline — able to trace a failure across multiple connected systems, not just one node
* Comfortable with API integration (REST/GraphQL) and external services
* 2–4 years of experience — we're actively open to junior CS grads. Regardless of experience level, everyone gets trained on our systems, so raw fundamentals and problem\-solving instinct matter more than years on a resume



**Bonus Points** 



* Deep understanding of workflow engines, state machines, or rule engines
* Experience with event\-driven architectures and queueing systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS)
* Working knowledge of Postgres and Redis
* Comfortable with infra\-as\-code (Docker, Terraform), monitoring, and CI/CD
* Experience with other low\-code/no\-code or visual workflow tools (Temporal, Langchain, Camunda, Retool)
* Exposure to AI/LLM systems and how workflows interface with prompt generation, chaining, etc.
* Previous experience in commerce, logistics, or creative ops automation
* Built internal ops tools or dashboards from scratch in a fast\-moving startup
* Familiarity with configuration\-driven or metadata\-driven engineering



**You'll Thrive If You Are…** 



* A builder who thinks in flows, states, and transitions
* Obsessed with making systems smarter, faster, and self\-healing
* Pragmatic about complexity — knowing when to write code and when to wire blocks
* Solution\-first — you show up with fixes, not just problem reports
* A team player who enjoys working across product, design, and AI teams
* Excited by the idea of creating leverage and automation for every human in the loop
