title: Job Posting Title Senior Software Engineer - Liquidity Book- Java Fullstack
description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.
   

  

 At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision\-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.
   

  

**Your Team's Impact**
 LiquidityBook is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our engineering team in Hyderabad, focusing on the development and improvement of our Order Management System (OMS) platform. This role involves hands\-on work across backend Java systems and frontend applications, collaborating with team members to deliver reliable and effective solutions.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Participate in the design and development of OMS features for both new initiatives and existing products.
* Contribute to backend service and frontend application development using established technologies.
* Support team code reviews, technical discussions, and troubleshooting.
* Help maintain engineering best practices and code quality.
* Assist with platform improvements, including refactoring and performance enhancements.
* Make hands\-on technical contributions to software development projects.


**What We're Looking For**
* 5\+ years of experience in programming in Java and frontend frameworks like reactjs, angular or Vue.
* Experience working with distributed systems or large\-scale applications.
* Solid foundation in software architecture, design patterns, algorithms, and data structures.
* Should be comfortable with using AI coding assistance like Claude.
* Experience with testing frameworks like JUnit, Vitest/Jest/Mocha, Playwright etc.
* Exposure to CI/CD workflows (GitHub Actions, Jenkins) or automation tools.
* Effective problem\-solving and communication skills.
* Willingness to learn and support team growth.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience or knowledge of financial trading applications, especially OMS, EMS, or related systems.
* Familiarity with multi\-threaded programming and scalable frontend solutions.
* Understanding of trading workflows, FIX protocol, or market data integration.
* Experience taking part in system upgrades or technology improvements.


**Company Overview**
 FactSet (NYSE:FDS \| NASDAQ:FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy\-side and sell\-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next\-generation workflow solutions, and client\-centric specialized support. As a member of the S\&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn.
   

  

 At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

title: Fullstack Developer
description:
The Applications Development Senior Programmer Analyst is an intermediate level position responsible for participation in the establishment and implementation of new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to contribute to applications systems analysis and programming activities.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Conduct tasks related to feasibility studies, time and cost estimates, IT planning, risk technology, applications development, model development, and establish and implement new or revised applications systems and programs to meet specific business needs or user areas
* Monitor and control all phases of development process and analysis, design, construction, testing, and implementation as well as provide user and operational support on applications to business users
* Utilize in\-depth specialty knowledge of applications development to analyze complex problems/issues, provide evaluation of business process, system process, and industry standards, and make evaluative judgement
* Recommend and develop security measures in post implementation analysis of business usage to ensure successful system design and functionality
* Consult with users/clients and other technology groups on issues, recommend advanced programming solutions, and install and assist customer exposure systems
* Ensure essential procedures are followed and help define operating standards and processes
* Serve as advisor or coach to new or lower level analysts
* Has the ability to operate with a limited level of direct supervision.
* Can exercise independence of judgement and autonomy.
* Acts as SME to senior stakeholders and /or other team members.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.


**Recommended Qualifications:**
* 5\-8 years of relevant experience
* Experience in systems analysis and programming of software applications

title: Full Stack Developer - R&D
description:
**Full Stack Developer – R\&D** 




 Naatscorp is looking for a Full Stack Developer with strong R\&D and product development experience to build innovative solutions at the intersection of medical devices, AI/ML, robotics, IoT, HMI, and cloud technologies.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Drive R\&D, PoC, prototype development, system integration, and productization of software solutions.
* Develop scalable frontend, backend, and HMI applications using React.js, Flutter, Kotlin, Python/FastAPI, Django, and Node.js.
* Integrate embedded hardware, IoT devices, AI/ML models, robotics, and cloud platforms.
* Develop real\-time communication using MQTT, WebSockets, and RESTful APIs.
* Design and manage cloud\-based platforms for remote device monitoring, data analysis, and IoT device management.
* Optimize data flow between medical devices, cloud storage, and relational/NoSQL databases, including MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Firebase.
* Develop edge\-computing and AI\-enabled applications for medical and assistive technologies.
* Deploy applications using AWS/Azure/GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Implement secure software aligned with medical\-device cybersecurity and data privacy requirements.
* Collaborate with Hardware, Embedded, AI/ML, Robotics, Mechanical, and Product R\&D teams.
* Troubleshoot complex hardware\-software integration issues and support system testing and validation.



  





**Required Tech Skills \& Experience** 




 Frontend \& HMI
 


* React.js, Flutter, Kotlin
* HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript



 Backend \& AI Integration
 


* Python, Django, FastAPI, and/or Node.js
* Experience integrating AI/ML models into applications
* WebSockets, MQTT, and RESTful APIs



 Database \& Cloud
 


* Relational databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL
* NoSQL databases: MongoDB, Firebase
* Cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, and/or GCP
* Experience with cloud\-based data storage, processing, remote monitoring, and IoT device management



 Security \& Compliance
 


* Understanding of medical\-device cybersecurity best practices
* Knowledge of ISO 13485, HIPAA, and GDPR is desirable



 Containerization \& DevOps
 


* Docker and Kubernetes
* CI/CD pipelines
* Git and version\-control workflows



 R\&D \& Product Development
 


* Experience developing PoCs, prototypes, technology demonstrators, and integrated systems
* Ability to research and evaluate new technologies and convert concepts into working solutions
* Experience working with AI/ML, embedded systems, IoT, robotics, or medical devices is highly desirable



  





**Soft Skills** 



* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills, particularly for hardware\-software integration
* Good time management and ability to work in an Agile R\&D environment
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills
* Ability to work effectively with interdisciplinary engineering and R\&D teams



**Experience** 



* 3\+ years of experience in Full Stack Development with strong R\&D/product development exposure.
* Experience in medical devices, healthcare, assistive technology, robotics, IoT, or deep\-tech R\&D is an added advantage.
